Stafford38.Characteristic.PhaseVar.doc: Indices for base and cotangent variables.
Stafford38.Characteristic.PhaseVar.source:
/-- Indices for base and cotangent variables. -/
abbrev PhaseVar (n : ℕ) := Stafford38Challenge.PhaseVar n

Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExte.doc:
The Gabber-shaped bracket condition: both bracket entries lie in the
ideal.  This is weaker than the project predicate `IsPoisson`.
Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExte.signature:
Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExtensionPoisson.IsInvolutive.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (J : Ideal (SymbolRing k n)) : Prop
Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExte.source:
/-- The Gabber-shaped bracket condition: both bracket entries lie in the
ideal.  This is weaker than the project predicate `IsPoisson`. -/
def IsInvolutive (J : Ideal (SymbolRing k n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ f ∈ J, ∀ g ∈ J, poissonBracket f g ∈ J

Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.doc: Coordinate ring of affine cotangent space.
Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.signature: Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.{u_1} (k : Type u_1) [CommRing k] (n : ℕ) : Type u_1
Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.source:
/-- Coordinate ring of affine cotangent space. -/
abbrev SymbolRing (k : Type*) [CommRing k] (n : ℕ) :=
  MvPolynomial (PhaseVar n) k

Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.doc: The standard Poisson bracket on affine cotangent space.
Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.signature:
Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [CommRing k] {n : ℕ}
  (f g : SymbolRing k n) : SymbolRing k n
Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.source:
/-- The standard Poisson bracket on affine cotangent space. -/
noncomputable def poissonBracket
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n : ℕ}
    (f g : SymbolRing k n) : SymbolRing k n :=
  ∑ i : Fin n,
    (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i : PhaseVar n) f *
        MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i : PhaseVar n) g -
      MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i : PhaseVar n) f *
        MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i : PhaseVar n) g)

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineComponentCoord.doc:
The image of an affine coordinate in the fraction field of a prime
component.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineComponentCoord.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineComponentCoordinateSplit.componentCoordinate.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k]
  {m : ℕ} (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (i : Fin m) :
  FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal)
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineComponentCoord.source:
/-- The image of an affine coordinate in the fraction field of a prime
component. -/
def componentCoordinate
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (i : Fin m) :
    FractionRing
      (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) :=
  algebraMap
      (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal)
      (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal))
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (MvPolynomial.X i))

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalClosur.doc:
Phase points whose base coordinate lies in `V(I)` and whose fibre
coordinate belongs to the equation-defined embedded conormal at that point.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalClosur.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalClosure.equationConormalLocus.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k]
  {n : ℕ} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar n → k)
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalClosur.source:
/-- Phase points whose base coordinate lies in `V(I)` and whose fibre
coordinate belongs to the equation-defined embedded conormal at that point. -/
def equationConormalLocus (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Set (PhaseVar n → k) :=
  {q | (∀ f ∈ I,
      MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) f = 0) ∧
    coordinateCovector (fun i => q (Sum.inr i)) ∈
      affineConormalSpace (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) I}

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.A.source: abbrev AffineTangentVector (k : Type*) (n : ℕ) := Fin n → k

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.a.doc:
The embedded conormal space, defined as the annihilator of the embedded
Zariski tangent space.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.a.source:
/-- The embedded conormal space, defined as the annihilator of the embedded
Zariski tangent space. -/
def affineConormalSpace (y : Fin n → k)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Submodule k (Module.Dual k (AffineTangentVector k n)) :=
  (zariskiTangentSpace y I).dualAnnihilator

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.c.doc: The coordinate covector associated with a fibre coordinate `xi`.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.c.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.coordinateCovector.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (xi : Fin n → k) : Module.Dual k (AffineTangentVector k n)
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.c.source:
/-- The coordinate covector associated with a fibre coordinate `xi`. -/
def coordinateCovector (xi : Fin n → k) :
    Module.Dual k (AffineTangentVector k n) where
  toFun v := ∑ i, xi i * v i
  map_add' u v := by simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a v := by simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, Finset.mul_sum]

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.d.doc:
The differential of `f` at `y`, viewed as a linear functional on the
ambient affine tangent space.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.d.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.differentialCovector.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (y : Fin n → k) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) : Module.Dual k (AffineTangentVector k n)
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.d.source:
/-- The differential of `f` at `y`, viewed as a linear functional on the
ambient affine tangent space. -/
def differentialCovector (y : Fin n → k) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) :
    Module.Dual k (AffineTangentVector k n) where
  toFun v := ∑ i, differentialAt y f i * v i
  map_add' u v := by simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a v := by simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, Finset.mul_sum]

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.e.doc: Covectors generated by the differentials of all equations in `I`.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.e.source:
/-- Covectors generated by the differentials of all equations in `I`. -/
def equationCovectorSpan (y : Fin n → k)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Submodule k (Module.Dual k (AffineTangentVector k n)) :=
  Submodule.span k (Set.range fun f : I ↦ differentialCovector y f.1)

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.z.doc:
The embedded Zariski tangent space cut out by the first-order parts of all
equations in `I`.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.z.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.zariskiTangentSpace.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (y : Fin n → k) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) : Submodule k (AffineTangentVector k n)
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.z.source:
/-- The embedded Zariski tangent space cut out by the first-order parts of all
equations in `I`. -/
def zariskiTangentSpace (y : Fin n → k)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Submodule k (AffineTangentVector k n) :=
  (equationCovectorSpan y I).dualCoannihilator

Stafford38.Geometry.AsymptoticDivisorExi.doc: The local ring of the affine line at the origin.
Stafford38.Geometry.AsymptoticDivisorExi.source:
/-- The local ring of the affine line at the origin. -/
abbrev CoordinateZeroLocalRing := Localization.AtPrime (coordinateZeroPrime k)

Stafford38.Geometry.AsymptoticDivisorExi.doc: The prime ideal `(X)` in the one-variable polynomial ring.
Stafford38.Geometry.AsymptoticDivisorExi.source:
/-- The prime ideal `(X)` in the one-variable polynomial ring. -/
def coordinateZeroPrime : Ideal (Polynomial k) := Ideal.span {Polynomial.X}

Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.doc:
The polynomial obtained by evaluating a phase-space polynomial along the
arbitrary affine fibre line `(y, xi + t v)`.
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslation.affineFibreLinePolynomial.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k]
  {n : ℕ} (y xi v : Fin n → k) (g : Characteristic.SymbolRing k n) : Polynomial k
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.source:
/-- The polynomial obtained by evaluating a phase-space polynomial along the
arbitrary affine fibre line `(y, xi + t v)`. -/
def affineFibreLinePolynomial
    (y xi v : Fin n → k) (g : SymbolRing k n) : Polynomial k :=
  MvPolynomial.aeval
    (Sum.elim (fun i => Polynomial.C (y i))
      (fun i => Polynomial.C (xi i) + Polynomial.C (v i) * Polynomial.X)) g

Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.doc: Embed a polynomial in the base coordinates into the phase-space ring.
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslation.baseLift.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ} :
  MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Characteristic.SymbolRing k n

Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.doc: Evaluate the differential of a base polynomial at a base point.
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslation.differentialAt.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (y : Fin n → k) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (i : Fin n) : k

Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.doc:
The polynomial line `t ↦ g(y, t v)` in the fibre over `y`, the
zero-fibre specialization of `affineFibreLinePolynomial`.
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslation.fibreLinePolynomial.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k]
  {n : ℕ} (y v : Fin n → k) (g : Characteristic.SymbolRing k n) : Polynomial k
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.source:
/-- The polynomial line `t ↦ g(y, t v)` in the fibre over `y`, the
zero-fibre specialization of `affineFibreLinePolynomial`. -/
abbrev fibreLinePolynomial
    (y v : Fin n → k) (g : SymbolRing k n) : Polynomial k :=
  affineFibreLinePolynomial y (fun _ => 0) v g

Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.doc: Iteration of bracketing on the left by one base equation.
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslation.hamiltonIter.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) : ℕ → Characteristic.SymbolRing k n → Characteristic.SymbolRing k n
Stafford38.Geometry.CoisotropicTranslati.source:
/-- Iteration of bracketing on the left by one base equation. -/
def hamiltonIter (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) : ℕ → SymbolRing k n → SymbolRing k n
  | 0, g => g
  | m + 1, g => poissonBracket (baseLift f) (hamiltonIter f m g)

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.doc: The positive `n`-th nilpotent quotient of the local ring.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.AdicJet.{u} (V : Type u) [CommRing V]
  [IsLocalRing V] (n : ℕ) : Type u
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.source:
/-- The positive `n`-th nilpotent quotient of the local ring. -/
abbrev AdicJet (n : ℕ) := V ⧸ ((m V) ^ (n + 1))

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K.{u} (V : Type u) [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] :
  Type u

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.doc: The unique coefficient section in the positive `n`-th adic jet.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.adicJetCoefficientSection.{u} (E V : Type u)
  [Field E] [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] [Algebra E V] (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V))
  (n : ℕ) : K V →ₐ[E] AdicJet V n
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.source:
/-- The unique coefficient section in the positive `n`-th adic jet. -/
def adicJetCoefficientSection
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V)) (n : ℕ) :
    K V →ₐ[E] AdicJet V n :=
  finiteSeparableSection E (K V) (AdicJet V n) hsep
    (adicJetResidue E V n) (adicJetResidue_surjective E V n)
    (adicJetResidue_kernel_isNilpotent E V n)

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.doc: Reduction of a positive adic jet to the residue field.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.adicJetResidue.{u} (E V : Type u) [Field E]
  [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] [Algebra E V] (n : ℕ) : AdicJet V n →ₐ[E] K V
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.source:
/-- Reduction of a positive adic jet to the residue field. -/
def adicJetResidue (n : ℕ) : AdicJet V n →ₐ[E] K V :=
  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ ((m V) ^ (n + 1))
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom E V (K V)) (by
      intro x hx
      change residue V x = 0
      rw [residue_eq_zero_iff]
      exact Ideal.pow_le_self (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) hx)

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.doc:
The coefficient section in every coordinate of Mathlib's adic inverse
limit.  Coordinate zero is trivial; coordinate `n+1` is the formally etale
section in `V / m^(n+1)`.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.completionCoordinateSection.{u} (E V : Type u)
  [Field E] [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] [Algebra E V] (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V))
  (n : ℕ) : K V →ₐ[E] V ⧸ m V ^ n • ⊤
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.source:
/-- The coefficient section in every coordinate of Mathlib's adic inverse
limit.  Coordinate zero is trivial; coordinate `n+1` is the formally etale
section in `V / m^(n+1)`. -/
def completionCoordinateSection
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, K V →ₐ[E] V ⧸ ((m V) ^ n • ⊤ : Ideal V)
  | 0 => zeroCompletionCoordinateSection E V
  | n + 1 =>
      (exactQuotientToCompletionCoordinate E V (n + 1)).toAlgHom.comp
        (adicJetCoefficientSection E V hsep n)

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.doc:
Convert the usual quotient by `m^n` to the coordinate quotient used in
the definition of `AdicCompletion`.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.source:
/-- Convert the usual quotient by `m^n` to the coordinate quotient used in
the definition of `AdicCompletion`. -/
def exactQuotientToCompletionCoordinate (n : ℕ) :
    (V ⧸ ((m V) ^ n)) ≃ₐ[E]
      V ⧸ ((m V) ^ n • ⊤ : Ideal V) := by
  have h : ((m V) ^ n • ⊤ : Ideal V) = (m V) ^ n := by
    ext x
    simp
  exact (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq V h).symm.restrictScalars E

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.m.{u} (V : Type u) [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] :
  Ideal V
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.source: abbrev m : Ideal V := maximalIdeal V

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.doc:
The zeroth completion coordinate is the zero quotient, so it has a unique
`E`-algebra map from the residue field.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.zeroCompletionCoordinateSection.{u}
  (E V : Type u) [Field E] [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] [Algebra E V] : K V →ₐ[E] V ⧸ m V ^ 0 • ⊤
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRCoeffici.source:
/-- The zeroth completion coordinate is the zero quotient, so it has a unique
`E`-algebra map from the residue field. -/
def zeroCompletionCoordinateSection :
    K V →ₐ[E] V ⧸ ((m V) ^ 0 • ⊤ : Ideal V) := by
  have htop : ((m V) ^ 0 • ⊤ : Ideal V) = ⊤ := by simp
  letI : Subsingleton (V ⧸ ((m V) ^ 0 • ⊤ : Ideal V)) := by
    rw [htop]
    infer_instance
  exact {
    toFun := fun _ ↦ 0
    map_one' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _
    map_zero' := rfl
    map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _
    commutes' := fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _ }

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.doc:
Every compatible adic family admits an expansion in the chosen
uniformizer with coefficients in the completed residue-field section.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.CompletedDVRPowerSeriesSurjectivity.{u} (E V : Type u)
  [Field E] [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] [Algebra E V]
  (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K V)) : Prop
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.source:
/-- Every compatible adic family admits an expansion in the chosen
uniformizer with coefficients in the completed residue-field section. -/
def CompletedDVRPowerSeriesSurjectivity
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V)) : Prop :=
  Function.Surjective (completedDVRPowerSeriesMap E V hsep)

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.doc: A fixed genuine uniformizer of the DVR.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.chosenUniformizer.{u} (V : Type u) [CommRing V]
  [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] : V

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.doc:
A supplied surjectivity proof turns the constructed map into the literal
power-series equivalence.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.completedDVRPowerSeriesEquivOfSurjective.{u}
  (E V : Type u) [Field E] [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
  [Algebra E V] (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K V))
  (hsurj : CompletedDVRPowerSeriesSurjectivity E V hsep) :
  PowerSeries (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K V) ≃+*
    AdicCompletion (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.m V) V
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.source:
/-- A supplied surjectivity proof turns the constructed map into the literal
power-series equivalence. -/
def completedDVRPowerSeriesEquivOfSurjective
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V))
    (hsurj : CompletedDVRPowerSeriesSurjectivity E V hsep) :
    PowerSeries (K V) ≃+* AdicCompletion (m V) V :=
  RingEquiv.ofBijective (completedDVRPowerSeriesMap E V hsep)
    ⟨completedDVRPowerSeriesMap_injective E V hsep, hsurj⟩

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.doc:
The actual chosen-coordinate power-series map to the maximal-ideal adic
completion.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.completedDVRPowerSeriesMap.{u} (E V : Type u) [Field E]
  [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] [Algebra E V]
  (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K V)) :
  PowerSeries (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K V) →+*
    AdicCompletion (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.m V) V
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.source:
/-- The actual chosen-coordinate power-series map to the maximal-ideal adic
completion. -/
def completedDVRPowerSeriesMap
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V)) :
    PowerSeries (K V) →+* AdicCompletion (m V) V where
  toFun f :=
    ⟨fun n ↦ powerSeriesCoordinateMap E V hsep n f,
      fun hab ↦ powerSeriesCoordinateMap_compatible E V hsep hab f⟩
  map_zero' := AdicCompletion.ext fun n ↦
    (powerSeriesCoordinateMap E V hsep n).map_zero
  map_one' := AdicCompletion.ext fun n ↦
    (powerSeriesCoordinateMap E V hsep n).map_one
  map_add' f g := AdicCompletion.ext fun n ↦
    (powerSeriesCoordinateMap E V hsep n).map_add f g
  map_mul' f g := AdicCompletion.ext fun n ↦
    (powerSeriesCoordinateMap E V hsep n).map_mul f g

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.doc:
Evaluation of a power series at an `n`-nilpotent element, using its
degree-`< n` truncation.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.nilpotentPowerSeriesEval.{u} {K S : Type u} [CommRing K]
  [CommRing S] (c : K →+* S) (x : S) (n : ℕ) (hx : x ^ n = 0) : PowerSeries K →+* S
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.source:
/-- Evaluation of a power series at an `n`-nilpotent element, using its
degree-`< n` truncation. -/
def nilpotentPowerSeriesEval
    (c : K →+* S) (x : S) (n : ℕ) (hx : x ^ n = 0) :
    PowerSeries K →+* S where
  toFun f := Polynomial.eval₂ c x (PowerSeries.trunc n f)
  map_zero' := by simp
  map_add' f g := by simp
  map_one' := by
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        have hsub : Subsingleton S := by
          apply subsingleton_iff_zero_eq_one.mp
          simpa using hx.symm
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    | succ n => simp
  map_mul' f g := by
    rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_mul]
    apply eval₂_eq_of_coeff_eq_of_pow_eq_zero c x n hx
    intro d hd
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_trunc, if_pos hd]
    calc
      (PowerSeries.coeff d) (f * g) =
          (PowerSeries.coeff d)
            ((PowerSeries.trunc n f : PowerSeries K) *
              (PowerSeries.trunc n g : PowerSeries K)) :=
        PowerSeries.coeff_mul_eq_coeff_trunc_mul_trunc f g hd
      _ = (PowerSeries.trunc n f * PowerSeries.trunc n g).coeff d := by
        rw [← Polynomial.coe_mul]
        exact Polynomial.coeff_coe
          (PowerSeries.trunc n f * PowerSeries.trunc n g) d

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.doc: Evaluation of a power series in one coordinate of the completed DVR.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.powerSeriesCoordinateMap.{u} (E V : Type u) [Field E]
  [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] [Algebra E V]
  (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K V)) (n : ℕ) :
  PowerSeries (CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.K V) →+*
    V ⧸ CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.m V ^ n • ⊤
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.source:
/-- Evaluation of a power series in one coordinate of the completed DVR. -/
def powerSeriesCoordinateMap
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E (K V)) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries (K V) →+* V ⧸ ((m V) ^ n • ⊤ : Ideal V) :=
  nilpotentPowerSeriesEval
    (completionCoordinateSection E V hsep n).toRingHom
    (uniformizerCoordinate V n) n
    (uniformizerCoordinate_pow_eq_zero V n)

Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.doc: The chosen uniformizer in the `n`-th raw completion coordinate.
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.uniformizerCoordinate.{u} (V : Type u) [CommRing V]
  [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] (n : ℕ) :
  V ⧸ CompletedDVRCoefficientSection.m V ^ n • ⊤
Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSer.source:
/-- The chosen uniformizer in the `n`-th raw completion coordinate. -/
def uniformizerCoordinate (n : ℕ) :

/-- The coefficient map from the ground field into a retained component

    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)

    (algebraMap k W.coefficientField)

Stafford38.Geometry.ContinuousPowerSerie.doc: Apply a derivation to every coefficient of a formal power series.
Stafford38.Geometry.ContinuousPowerSerie.source:
/-- Apply a derivation to every coefficient of a formal power series. -/
noncomputable def coefficientwiseDerivation (D : Derivation k K K) :
    Derivation k (PowerSeries K) (PowerSeries K) where
  toLinearMap := coefficientwiseLinearMap D
  map_one_eq_zero' := by
    ext n
    by_cases hn : n = 0 <;>
      simp [hn, D.map_one_eq_zero]
  leibniz' f g := by
    ext n
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, coeff_coefficientwiseLinearMap]
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_add,
      PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp_rw [D.leibniz]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [coeff_coefficientwiseLinearMap, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    simpa only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap] using
      (Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap (n := n)
        (f := fun p ↦ PowerSeries.coeff p.1 g *
          D (PowerSeries.coeff p.2 f)))

/-- The `k`-linear coefficientwise action underlying the extended
derivation. -/
noncomputable def coefficientwiseLinearMap (D : Derivation k K K) :
    PowerSeries K →ₗ[k] PowerSeries K where
  toFun f := PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ D (PowerSeries.coeff n f)
  map_add' f g := by
    ext n
    simp
  map_smul' a f := by
    ext n
    simp

Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorTangentLattic.doc:
Normalized divisor-frame data for the lattice lemma.  All coordinates
are elements of `V`.  The lattice `W` is any finitely generated `V`-submodule
containing the differentials of `t`, `u`, `w` and the `Q j`; in the geometric
application it is the image of `Ω_{V/k}`.  The visibility field is the only
non-algebraic hypothesis: modulo `t`, the lattice `W` is spanned by `d t` and
the `d (Q j)`.
Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorTangentLattic.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorTangentLattice.VisibleDivisorFrame.{u, v, w, x, y} {k : Type u}
  {V : Type v} {F : Type w} {Ω : Type x} [CommRing k] [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] [Field F]
  [Algebra k F] [Algebra V F] [AddCommGroup Ω] [Module k Ω] [Module F Ω] [Module V Ω]
  (d : Derivation k F Ω) (ι : Type y) [Fintype ι] : Type (max (max v x) y)
Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorTangentLattic.source:
/-- Normalized divisor-frame data for the lattice lemma.  All coordinates
are elements of `V`.  The lattice `W` is any finitely generated `V`-submodule
containing the differentials of `t`, `u`, `w` and the `Q j`; in the geometric
application it is the image of `Ω_{V/k}`.  The visibility field is the only
non-algebraic hypothesis: modulo `t`, the lattice `W` is spanned by `d t` and
the `d (Q j)`. -/
structure VisibleDivisorFrame (d : Derivation k F Ω) (ι : Type y) [Fintype ι] where
  Q₀ : V
  Q₁ : V
  t : V
  u : V
  w : V
  Q : ι → V
  a : ℕ
  e : ℕ
  j₀ : ι
  W : Submodule V Ω
  t_mem : t ∈ maximalIdeal V
  t_ne : t ≠ 0
  u_unit : IsUnit u
  a_unit : IsUnit (a : V)
  one_le_a : 1 ≤ a
  one_le_e : 1 ≤ e
  Q₀_eq : Q₀ = t ^ a * u
  Q₁_eq : Q₁ = t ^ (a + e) * w
  Q_j₀ : Q j₀ = 1
  W_fg : W.FG
  dt_mem : d (algebraMap V F t) ∈ W
  du_mem : d (algebraMap V F u) ∈ W
  dw_mem : d (algebraMap V F w) ∈ W
  dQ_mem : ∀ j, d (algebraMap V F (Q j)) ∈ W
  visible : W ≤ coordinateFrame d t Q ⊔ Ideal.span {t} • W

Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorTangentLattic.doc:
The `V`-lattice spanned by `d t` and the differentials of the
homogeneous coordinates.
Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorTangentLattic.source:
/-- The `V`-lattice spanned by `d t` and the differentials of the
homogeneous coordinates. -/
def coordinateFrame (t : V) (Q : ι → V) : Submodule V Ω :=
  Submodule.span V {d (algebraMap V F t)} ⊔
    Submodule.span V (Set.range fun j ↦ d (algebraMap V F (Q j)))

Stafford38.Geometry.FibreConicalVanishin.doc: Stability under every nonzero scalar dilation in each cotangent fibre.
Stafford38.Geometry.FibreConicalVanishin.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (W : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar n → k)) : Prop
Stafford38.Geometry.FibreConicalVanishin.source:
/-- Stability under every nonzero scalar dilation in each cotangent fibre. -/
def IsFibreConical (W : Set (PhaseVar n → k)) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ W, ∀ a : k, a ≠ 0 →
    Sum.elim (fun i => q (.inl i)) (fun i => a * q (.inr i)) ∈ W

Stafford38.Geometry.FiniteSeparableDVRCh.doc:
The canonical coefficient-field lift through a nilpotent thickening.

The construction uses only the formal smoothness of the separable field
extension `K/E`; in particular it does not assume a coefficient field in `R`.
Stafford38.Geometry.FiniteSeparableDVRCh.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.FiniteSeparableDVRChartFoundation.finiteSeparableSection.{u} (E K R : Type u)
  [Field E] [Field K] [CommRing R] [Algebra E K] [Algebra E R] (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E K)
  (residue : R →ₐ[E] K) (hsurj : Function.Surjective ⇑residue)
  (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker residue.toRingHom)) : K →ₐ[E] R
Stafford38.Geometry.FiniteSeparableDVRCh.source:
/-- The canonical coefficient-field lift through a nilpotent thickening.

The construction uses only the formal smoothness of the separable field
extension `K/E`; in particular it does not assume a coefficient field in `R`.
-/
def finiteSeparableSection
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable E K)
    (residue : R →ₐ[E] K)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective residue)
    (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker residue.toRingHom)) :
    K →ₐ[E] R := by
  letI : Algebra.IsSeparable E K := hsep
  letI : Algebra.FormallyEtale E K :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable E K
  exact Algebra.FormallySmooth.liftOfSurjective
    (AlgHom.id E K) residue hsurj hnil

Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVis.doc:
The normalized Lane-C projective column and the actual retained ground
coefficient map.
Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVis.source:
/-- The normalized Lane-C projective column and the actual retained ground
coefficient map. -/
structure GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameColumn
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) where
  W : Data k (ComponentFractionField P) (componentCoordinate P ⟨0, hm⟩)
  chart : Fin (m + 1)
  q :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    Fin (m + 1) → W.place.valuation.toSubring
  scale : ComponentFractionField P
  scale_ne : scale ≠ 0
  chart_one :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    q chart = 1
  q0_ne :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    q 0 ≠ 0
  q_commonScale : ∀ a,
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    (q a : ComponentFractionField P) = scale * componentProjectivePoint P a
  q_parameter :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = q 0 * W.place.parameter
  groundCoeff :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    k →+* W.place.valuation.toSubring
  groundCoeff_commutes :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    W.place.valuation.toSubring.subtype.comp groundCoeff =
      algebraMap k (ComponentFractionField P)
  groundCoeff_eq_retained :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    groundCoeff = retainedComponentCoefficientMap P ⟨0, hm⟩ W
  groundTower :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : Algebra k V := groundCoeff.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra V (ComponentFractionField P) := V.subtype.toAlgebra
    IsScalarTower k V (ComponentFractionField P)

Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVis.source:
/-- The actual visible differential frame on the normalized column. -/
structure GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameCore
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (C : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameColumn hm P) where
  D : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameCoreFieldType.frame hm P C
  D_Q0 : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameCoreFieldType.q0 hm P C D
  D_Q1 : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameCoreFieldType.q1 hm P C D
  D_Q : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameCoreFieldType.q hm P C D
  D_maximalIdeal :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing C.W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := C.W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := C.W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := C.W.place.isDiscrete
    maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span {D.t}
  D_uniformizer : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameCoreFieldType.uniformizer hm P C D
  D_w_unit :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing C.W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := C.W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := C.W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsLocalRing V := C.W.place.isDiscrete.toIsLocalRing
    IsUnit D.w

  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (C : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameColumn hm P) :
  Type u
Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVis.source:
abbrev frame
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (C : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameColumn hm P) :=
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing C.W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := C.W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := C.W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsLocalRing V := C.W.place.isDiscrete.toIsLocalRing
  letI : Algebra C.W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap C.W.coefficientField C.W.place).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra k V := C.groundCoeff.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra V (ComponentFractionField P) := V.subtype.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k V (ComponentFractionField P) := C.groundTower
  VisibleDivisorFrame (V := V)
    (KaehlerDifferential.D k (ComponentFractionField P)) (Fin m)

    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)

    (column : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameColumn hm P) :=
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing column.W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := column.W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := column.W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := column.W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra column.W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap column.W.coefficientField column.W.place).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra k (ResidueField V) :=
      retainedResidueGroundAlgebra P ⟨0, hm⟩ column.W
  Algebra.IsAlgebraic
    (IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range fun j : Fin m ↦ residue V (column.q (Fin.succ j))) :
      IntermediateField k (ResidueField V))
    (ResidueField V)

Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVis.source:
abbrev retainedGroundMap
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (column : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameColumn hm P) :=
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing column.W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := column.W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := column.W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := column.W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra column.W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap column.W.coefficientField column.W.place).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra k (ResidueField V) :=

Stafford38.Geometry.ProjectiveChartCoord.source:
/-- The canonical complementary ordering for the zeroth chart. -/
def zerothChartEquiv {m : ℕ} :
    Fin m ≃ ChartAffineIndex (Fin (m + 1)) (0 : Fin (m + 1)) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective
    (fun i ↦ (⟨i.succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero i⟩ :
      ChartAffineIndex (Fin (m + 1)) (0 : Fin (m + 1))))
    ⟨by
      intro i j h
      exact (Fin.succ_injective _ ) (congrArg Subtype.val h),
     by
      intro ⟨j, hj⟩
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with hzero | ⟨i, hi⟩
      · exact (hj hzero).elim
      · refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hi.symm⟩

Stafford38.Geometry.RelativeRetainedBoun.doc:
A retained boundary place for `x`, including the relative coefficient
field and the exact ambient algebra structure under which the local
coordinate maps to `x`.
Stafford38.Geometry.RelativeRetainedBoun.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.RelativeRetainedBoundaryPlace.Data.{u} (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] (x : K) : Type u
Stafford38.Geometry.RelativeRetainedBoun.source:
/-- A retained boundary place for `x`, including the relative coefficient
field and the exact ambient algebra structure under which the local
coordinate maps to `x`. -/
structure Data
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (x : K) where
  coefficientField : IntermediateField k K
  coordinate_transcendental : Transcendental coefficientField x
  ambientAlgebra : Algebra (SourceDVR coefficientField) K
  coefficientTower :
    letI : Algebra (SourceDVR coefficientField) K := ambientAlgebra
    IsScalarTower coefficientField (SourceDVR coefficientField) K
  coordinate_eq :
    letI : Algebra (SourceDVR coefficientField) K := ambientAlgebra
    algebraMap (SourceDVR coefficientField) K
        (algebraMap (Polynomial coefficientField)
          (SourceDVR coefficientField) Polynomial.X) = x
  place :
    letI : Algebra (SourceDVR coefficientField) K := ambientAlgebra
    RetainedDVRPlace (SourceDVR coefficientField) (L := K)
      (algebraMap (Polynomial coefficientField)
        (SourceDVR coefficientField) Polynomial.X)

Stafford38.Geometry.RelativeRetainedBoun.doc:
The completion of the retained component DVR is literally a power-series
ring over its residue field.  This is the completion, not the original DVR.
Stafford38.Geometry.RelativeRetainedBoun.source:
/-- The completion of the retained component DVR is literally a power-series
ring over its residue field.  This is the completion, not the original DVR. -/
def Data.completedPowerSeriesEquiv
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {x : K} (W : Data k K x) :
    letI : Algebra (SourceDVR W.coefficientField) K := W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
    letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
    PowerSeries (ResidueField V) ≃+*
      AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) V := by
  letI : Algebra (SourceDVR W.coefficientField) K := W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  exact completedDVRPowerSeriesEquivOfSurjective W.coefficientField
    V
    (relativeResidue_isSeparable W.coefficientField W.place)
    (completedDVRPowerSeriesMap_surjective W.coefficientField
      V
      (relativeResidue_isSeparable W.coefficientField W.place))

def ResidueExtensionFinite
    {A V : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing V] [IsLocalRing V] (factor : A →+* V)
    (hlocal : IsLocalHom factor) : Prop := by
  letI : Algebra A V := factor.toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A V) := hlocal
  exact Module.Finite (ResidueField A) (ResidueField V)

Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedDVR.Retained.doc: A divisorial place retaining its local source-DVR map.
Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedDVR.Retained.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedDVR.RetainedDVRPlace.{u, w} (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
  [IsLocalRing A] {L : Type w} [Field L] [Algebra A L] (a : A) : Type (max u w)
Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedDVR.Retained.source:
/-- A divisorial place retaining its local source-DVR map. -/
structure RetainedDVRPlace
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {L : Type w} [Field L] [Algebra A L] (a : A) where
  valuation : ValuationSubring L
  isDiscrete : IsDiscreteValuationRing valuation.toSubring
  parameter : valuation.toSubring
  parameter_eq : (parameter : L) = algebraMap A L a
  parameter_ne : parameter ≠ 0
  parameter_nonunit : ¬IsUnit parameter
  factor : A →+* valuation.toSubring
  factor_commutes :
    valuation.toSubring.subtype.comp factor = algebraMap A L
  factor_isLocal : IsLocalHom factor
  residue_finite : ResidueExtensionFinite factor factor_isLocal

The ground-field structure on the retained residue field induced by the
actual coefficient map through the valuation ring.
Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedGroundMapIde.signature:
Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedGroundMapIdentification.retainedResidueGroundAlgebra.{u} {k : Type u}
  [Field k] {m : ℕ} [CharZero k] (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (i : Fin m)
  (W :
    RelativeRetainedBoundaryPlace.Data k (ComponentProjectiveClosure.ComponentFractionField P)
      (AffineComponentCoordinateSplit.componentCoordinate P i)) :
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring;
  Algebra k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)
Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedGroundMapIde.source:
/-- The ground-field structure on the retained residue field induced by the
actual coefficient map through the valuation ring. -/
def retainedResidueGroundAlgebra
    [CharZero k]
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (i : Fin m)
    (W : Data k (ComponentFractionField P) (componentCoordinate P i)) :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
        (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
    letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
    Algebra k (ResidueField V) := by
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  exact ((residue V).comp (retainedComponentCoefficientMap P i W)).toAlgebra

Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedProjectiveCo.doc:
Map retained valuation-ring coordinates into the corresponding
power-series ring via the actual adic completion.
Stafford38.Geometry.RetainedProjectiveCo.source:
/-- Map retained valuation-ring coordinates into the corresponding
power-series ring via the actual adic completion. -/
def retainedToCompletedPowerSeries
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K] {x : K} (W : Data k K x) :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField) K :=
      W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
    letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
    V →+* PowerSeries (ResidueField V) := by
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField) K :=
    W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  exact W.completedPowerSeriesEquiv.symm.toRingHom.comp
    (algebraMap V (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal V) V))

    (y : Fin n → k) : Prop :=
  ∃ e : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I) →ₐ[k] k,
    (∀ p, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I p) = MvPolynomial.aeval y p) ∧
    let hprime : (RingHom.ker e.toRingHom).IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime e
    (⟨RingHom.ker e.toRingHom, hprime⟩ :
      PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I)) ∈
      Algebra.smoothLocus k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I)

/-- **Definition 2.9 (Poisson bracket).**
`{f, g} = ∑_i (∂f/∂x_i ∂g/∂ξ_i - ∂f/∂ξ_i ∂g/∂x_i)` on `k[x, ξ]`. -/
def poisson {n : ℕ} (f g : SymbolRing k n) : SymbolRing k n :=
  ∑ i : Fin n,
    (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i) f * MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i) g -
      MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i) f * MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i) g)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.IsIrreducibleC.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(a).** A closed set `Y` is irreducible if it is not a union of two
proper closed subsets. -/
def IsIrreducibleClosed (Y : Set (Fin n → k)) : Prop :=
  IsZariskiClosed Y ∧ ¬ ∃ Y₁ Y₂ : Set (Fin n → k), IsZariskiClosed Y₁ ∧ IsZariskiClosed Y₂ ∧
    Y₁ ⊂ Y ∧ Y₂ ⊂ Y ∧ Y = Y₁ ∪ Y₂

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.IsZariskiClose.doc: A Zariski-closed subset of `X = K^n`: `Y = V_K(J)` for an ideal `J ⊆ K[x]`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.IsZariskiClose.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.IsZariskiClosed.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (Y : Set (Fin n → k)) : Prop

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmooth.doc:
**Definition 5.4(b), the Jacobian smooth locus.** `y ∈ Y_sm` iff `y ∈ Y = V(𝔭)` and
the Jacobian matrix `(∂_i g_j(y))` of generators `g_1, …, g_s` of `I(Y) = 𝔭` has rank
`n - dim Y`, written `rank + dim Y = n` with `dim Y` the Krull dimension of `K[x]/𝔭`.
The rank does not depend on the generators
(`jacobian_rank_eq_finrank_differentialSpan`, `jacobianSmoothPoint_iff_span`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmooth.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmoothPoint.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y : Fin n → k) : Prop
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmooth.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(b), the Jacobian smooth locus.** `y ∈ Y_sm` iff `y ∈ Y = V(𝔭)` and
the Jacobian matrix `(∂_i g_j(y))` of generators `g_1, …, g_s` of `I(Y) = 𝔭` has rank
`n - dim Y`, written `rank + dim Y = n` with `dim Y` the Krull dimension of `K[x]/𝔭`.
The rank does not depend on the generators
(`jacobian_rank_eq_finrank_differentialSpan`, `jacobianSmoothPoint_iff_span`). -/
def JacobianSmoothPoint (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y : Fin n → k) : Prop :=
  y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k P.asIdeal ∧
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (g : Fin s → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = P.asIdeal ∧
      ((Matrix.of fun j i ↦ differentialAt y (g j) i).rank : WithBot ℕ∞) +
        ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) = n

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.doc:
The discrete valuation ring of Lemma 5.10 together with the construction
`V = A_{𝔭_D}` of its proof: `A` is the integral closure in `F` of
`C_0 = K[q_0, …, q_n, x̄_1]` and `𝔭_D` is a height-one prime of `A` containing
`x̄_1`.  The fields `isDVR`, `q_mem`, `x_mem_p`, `residue_algebraic` and
`kaehler_finite` are the conclusions (a)–(c) of the lemma; the clause `R ⊄ V`
of (a) is `lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.{u} (k : Type u) {F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F]
  [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : Type u
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.source:
/-- The discrete valuation ring of Lemma 5.10 together with the construction
`V = A_{𝔭_D}` of its proof: `A` is the integral closure in `F` of
`C_0 = K[q_0, …, q_n, x̄_1]` and `𝔭_D` is a height-one prime of `A` containing
`x̄_1`.  The fields `isDVR`, `q_mem`, `x_mem_p`, `residue_algebraic` and
`kaehler_finite` are the conclusions (a)–(c) of the lemma; the clause `R ⊄ V`
of (a) is `lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le`. -/
structure Lemma510Place (k : Type u) {F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) where
  A : Subalgebra k F
  [finiteType : Algebra.FiniteType k A]
  [fractionRing : IsFractionRing A F]
  p : Ideal A
  [isPrime : p.IsPrime]
  place : ∀ z : F, z ∈ (placeSubalgebra A p).toSubring ∨
    z⁻¹ ∈ (placeSubalgebra A p).toSubring
  isDVR : IsDiscreteValuationRing (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
  q_mem : ∀ a, homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j ∈ A
  x_mem : x i ∈ A
  x_mem_p : (⟨x i, x_mem⟩ : A) ∈ p
  residue_algebraic :
    letI : Algebra k (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring :=
      ((algebraMap k F).codRestrict (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
        (fun c ↦ ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p place (algebraMap k A c))).toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range fun a ↦ residue (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
          ⟨homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j,
            ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p place ⟨_, q_mem a⟩⟩) :
        IntermediateField k (ResidueField (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring))
      (ResidueField (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring)
  kaehler_finite :
    letI : Algebra k (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring :=
      ((algebraMap k F).codRestrict (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
        (fun c ↦ ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p place (algebraMap k A c))).toAlgebra
    Module.Finite (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
      (Ω[(placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring⁄k])

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.complementRow.doc: The row `u_υ`: the entries of `u` in the rows outside `ι`, and `0` on `ι`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.complementRow.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.complementRow.{u, u_1, u_2} {κ : Type u} [Field κ] {R : Type u_1}
  {ι : Type u_2} [DecidableEq R] [Fintype ι] (rowsι : ι ↪ R) (u : R → κ) : R → PowerSeries κ
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.complementRow.source:
/-- The row `u_υ`: the entries of `u` in the rows outside `ι`, and `0` on `ι`. -/
def complementRow {R ι : Type*} [DecidableEq R] [Fintype ι] (rowsι : ι ↪ R) (u : R → κ) :
    R → PowerSeries κ :=
  fun i ↦ if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalCone.doc:
**Definition 5.4(d), as printed.** The conormal cone
`N(Y) = ⋃_{y ∈ Y_sm} N*_y Y` over the Jacobian smooth locus, with
`N*_y Y = span_K {df_y : f ∈ I(Y)}`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalCone.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalCone.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) : Set (Fin n → k)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalDirect.doc:
**Definition 5.5, as printed.** `Dir(Y)` is the Zariski closure in `ℙ((K^n)^*)` of
`{[ξ] : 0 ≠ ξ ∈ N(Y)}`; projective Zariski closed sets are the common zero sets of
homogeneous polynomials.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalDirect.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalDirections.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) : Set (Projectivization k (Fin n → k))
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalDirect.source:
/-- **Definition 5.5, as printed.** `Dir(Y)` is the Zariski closure in `ℙ((K^n)^*)` of
`{[ξ] : 0 ≠ ξ ∈ N(Y)}`; projective Zariski closed sets are the common zero sets of
homogeneous polynomials. -/
def conormalDirections (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Set (Projectivization k (Fin n → k)) :=
  projectiveHomogeneousClosure (projectivizedDirectionSet (conormalCone P))

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.differentialRe.doc:
The relations of Definition 5.2(b) in the free `κ`-vector space `𝒢` on symbols
`⟨a⟩ = Finsupp.single a 1`: `⟨a+b⟩ - ⟨a⟩ - ⟨b⟩`, `⟨ab⟩ - a⟨b⟩ - b⟨a⟩`, `⟨c⟩` (`c ∈ K`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.differentialRe.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.differentialRelations.{u_4, u_5} (K : Type u_4) (κ : Type u_5) [Field K]
  [Field κ] [Algebra K κ] : Submodule κ (κ →₀ κ)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.differentialRe.source:
/-- The relations of Definition 5.2(b) in the free `κ`-vector space `𝒢` on symbols
`⟨a⟩ = Finsupp.single a 1`: `⟨a+b⟩ - ⟨a⟩ - ⟨b⟩`, `⟨ab⟩ - a⟨b⟩ - b⟨a⟩`, `⟨c⟩` (`c ∈ K`). -/
def differentialRelations (K κ : Type*) [Field K] [Field κ] [Algebra K κ] :
    Submodule κ (κ →₀ κ) :=
  Submodule.span κ
    (((Set.range fun x : κ × κ ↦
        Finsupp.single (x.1 + x.2) 1 - Finsupp.single x.1 1 - Finsupp.single x.2 1) ∪
      Set.range fun x : κ × κ ↦
        Finsupp.single (x.1 * x.2) 1 - x.1 • Finsupp.single x.2 1 -
          x.2 • Finsupp.single x.1 1) ∪
      Set.range fun c : K ↦ Finsupp.single (algebraMap K κ c) 1)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.exclusionBaseI.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.exclusionBaseIdeal.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {m : ℕ}
  (W : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar m → k)) : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.exclusionBaseI.source:
/-- `B = I(W) ∩ K[x]`. -/
abbrev exclusionBaseIdeal (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k)) :
    Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) :=
  (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W).comap (baseLift (k := k) (n := m))

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.homogeneousCoo.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.homogeneousCoordinates.{u_1} {F : Type u_1} [Field F] {n : ℕ}
  (x : Fin n → F) : Fin (n + 1) → F
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.homogeneousCoo.source:
/-- Homogeneous coordinates `(x̄_0, …, x̄_n) = (1, x̄_1, …, x̄_n)`. -/
abbrev homogeneousCoordinates {F : Type*} [Field F] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → F) :
    Fin (n + 1) → F :=
  Fin.cases 1 x

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.idealPoint.doc:
For nonempty irreducible closed `Y`, the prime `I(Y)` as a point of `Spec K[x]`;
Definitions 5.4(b)–(d) and 5.5 are stated in terms of it.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.idealPoint.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.idealPoint.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ} (Y : Set (Fin n → k))
  (hne : Y.Nonempty) (hY : IsIrreducibleClosed Y) : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.liftBlock.source:
/-- The block `ℓ_ι = −u_υ M_υ M_ι⁻¹`. -/
def liftBlock {R ι : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : Matrix R ι (PowerSeries κ)) (rowsι : ι ↪ R) (u : R → κ) : ι → PowerSeries κ :=
  -Matrix.vecMul (rowMul (complementRow rowsι u) M) (selectedMinor M rowsι)⁻¹

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.liftRow.doc: The paper's lift `ℓ` of `u`: `ℓ_υ = u_υ` and `ℓ_ι = −u_υ M_υ M_ι⁻¹`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.liftRow.source:
/-- The paper's lift `ℓ` of `u`: `ℓ_υ = u_υ` and `ℓ_ι = −u_υ M_υ M_ι⁻¹`. -/
def liftRow {R ι : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : Matrix R ι (PowerSeries κ)) (rowsι : ι ↪ R) (u : R → κ) : R → PowerSeries κ :=
  fun i ↦ complementRow rowsι u i + ∑ c, if rowsι c = i then liftBlock M rowsι u c else 0

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.rho.doc: The paper's `ρ : L^{n+1} → L^n`, `ρ(v)_i = (v_i q_0 - q_i v_0) / q_0²`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.rho.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.rho.{v} {L : Type v} [Field L] {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) :
  (Fin (n + 1) → L) →ₗ[L] Fin n → L
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.rho.source:
/-- The paper's `ρ : L^{n+1} → L^n`, `ρ(v)_i = (v_i q_0 - q_i v_0) / q_0²`. -/
def rho (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) : (Fin (n + 1) → L) →ₗ[L] (Fin n → L) where
  toFun v i := (v i.succ * q 0 - q i.succ * v 0) / q 0 ^ 2
  map_add' v w := by
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  map_smul' c v := by
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentCone.doc: The affine cone `𝒞 = ρ⁻¹(Θ_y)` over the projective tangent plane.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentCone.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentCone.{u, v} {k : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field k] [Field L]
  [Algebra k L] {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
  Submodule L (Fin (n + 1) → L)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentCone.source:
/-- The affine cone `𝒞 = ρ⁻¹(Θ_y)` over the projective tangent plane. -/
def tangentCone (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Submodule L (Fin (n + 1) → L) :=
  (tangentSpaceAt q I).comap (rho q)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentSpaceAt.doc: The tangent space `Θ_y` at `y = q_i / q_0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentSpaceAt.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentSpaceAt.{u, v} {k : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field k] [Field L]
  [Algebra k L] {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
  Submodule L (Fin n → L)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.tangentSpaceAt.source:
/-- The tangent space `Θ_y` at `y = q_i / q_0`. -/
def tangentSpaceAt (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Submodule L (Fin n → L) :=
  zariskiTangentSpace (dehomogenizedPoint q) (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k L)))

Stafford38Challenge.PhaseVar.doc: Index type of the coordinate and momentum generators.
Stafford38Challenge.PhaseVar.source:
/-- Index type of the coordinate and momentum generators. -/
abbrev PhaseVar (n : ℕ) := Fin n ⊕ Fin n

Algebra.IsAlgebraic.doc: An algebra is algebraic if all its elements are algebraic.
Algebra.IsAlgebraic.signature: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.{u, v} (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] : Prop
Algebra.IsAlgebraic.source:
/-- An algebra is algebraic if all its elements are algebraic. -/
@[stacks 09GC "Algebraic extensions"]
protected class Algebra.IsAlgebraic : Prop where
  isAlgebraic : ∀ x : A, IsAlgebraic R x

Algebra.trdeg.doc:
The transcendence degree of a commutative algebra `A` over a commutative ring `R` is
defined to be the maximal cardinality of an `R`-algebraically independent set in `A`.
Algebra.trdeg.signature:
Algebra.trdeg.{v, u_2} (R : Type u_2) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] :
  Cardinal.{v}
Algebra.trdeg.source:
/-- The transcendence degree of a commutative algebra `A` over a commutative ring `R` is
defined to be the maximal cardinality of an `R`-algebraically independent set in `A`. -/
@[stacks 030G] def Algebra.trdeg : Cardinal.{v} :=
  ⨆ ι : { s : Set A // AlgebraicIndepOn R _root_.id s }, Cardinal.mk ι.1

AlgebraicIndependent.doc:
`AlgebraicIndependent R x` states the family of elements `x`
is algebraically independent over `R`, meaning that the canonical
map out of the multivariable polynomial ring is injective.
AlgebraicIndependent.signature:
AlgebraicIndependent.{u_1, u_3, u_4} {ι : Type u_1} (R : Type u_3) {A : Type u_4} (x : ι → A)
  [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] : Prop
AlgebraicIndependent.source:
/-- `AlgebraicIndependent R x` states the family of elements `x`
  is algebraically independent over `R`, meaning that the canonical
  map out of the multivariable polynomial ring is injective. -/
@[stacks 030E "(1)"] def AlgebraicIndependent : Prop :=
  Injective (MvPolynomial.aeval x : MvPolynomial ι R →ₐ[R] A)

Derivation.doc:
`D : Derivation R A M` is an `R`-linear map from `A` to `M` that satisfies the `leibniz`
equality. We also require that `D 1 = 0`. See `Derivation.mk'` for a constructor that deduces this
assumption from the Leibniz rule when `M` is cancellative.

TODO: update this when bimodules are defined.
Derivation.signature:
Derivation.{u_1, u_2, u_3} (R : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (M : Type u_3) [CommSemiring R]
  [CommSemiring A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Algebra R A] [Module A M] [Module R M] : Type (max u_2 u_3)
Derivation.source:
/-- `D : Derivation R A M` is an `R`-linear map from `A` to `M` that satisfies the `leibniz`
equality. We also require that `D 1 = 0`. See `Derivation.mk'` for a constructor that deduces this
assumption from the Leibniz rule when `M` is cancellative.

TODO: update this when bimodules are defined. -/
structure Derivation (R : Type*) (A : Type*) (M : Type*)
    [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Algebra R A] [Module A M] [Module R M]
    extends A →ₗ[R] M where
  protected map_one_eq_zero' : toLinearMap 1 = 0
  protected leibniz' (a b : A) : toLinearMap (a * b) = a • toLinearMap b + b • toLinearMap a

IsAlgebraic.doc:
An element of an R-algebra is algebraic over R if it is a root of a nonzero polynomial
with coefficients in R.
IsAlgebraic.signature: IsAlgebraic.{u, v} (R : Type u) {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (x : A) : Prop
IsAlgebraic.source:
/-- An element of an R-algebra is algebraic over R if it is a root of a nonzero polynomial
with coefficients in R. -/
@[stacks 09GC "Algebraic elements"]
def IsAlgebraic (x : A) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : R[X], p ≠ 0 ∧ aeval x p = 0

IsDiscreteValuationRing.doc:
An integral domain is a *discrete valuation ring* (DVR) if it's a local PID which
is not a field.
IsDiscreteValuationRing.signature: IsDiscreteValuationRing.{u} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] : Prop
IsDiscreteValuationRing.source:
/-- An integral domain is a *discrete valuation ring* (DVR) if it's a local PID which
  is not a field. -/
class IsDiscreteValuationRing (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] : Prop
    extends IsPrincipalIdealRing R, IsLocalRing R where
  not_a_field' : maximalIdeal R ≠ ⊥

IsTranscendenceBasis.doc: A family is a transcendence basis if it is a maximal algebraically independent subset.
IsTranscendenceBasis.signature:
IsTranscendenceBasis.{u_1, u_3, u_4} {ι : Type u_1} (R : Type u_3) {A : Type u_4} [CommRing R]
  [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (x : ι → A) : Prop
IsTranscendenceBasis.source:
/-- A family is a transcendence basis if it is a maximal algebraically independent subset. -/
@[stacks 030E "(4)"] def IsTranscendenceBasis (x : ι → A) : Prop :=
  AlgebraicIndependent R x ∧
    ∀ (s : Set A) (_ : AlgebraicIndepOn R id s) (_ : range x ⊆ s), range x = s

Stafford38.Characteristic.PhaseVar.doc: Indices for base and cotangent variables.
Stafford38.Characteristic.PhaseVar.source:
/-- Indices for base and cotangent variables. -/
abbrev PhaseVar (n : ℕ) := Stafford38Challenge.PhaseVar n

Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExte.doc:
The Gabber-shaped bracket condition: both bracket entries lie in the
ideal.  This is weaker than the project predicate `IsPoisson`.
Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExte.signature:
Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExtensionPoisson.IsInvolutive.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (J : Ideal (SymbolRing k n)) : Prop
Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExte.source:
/-- The Gabber-shaped bracket condition: both bracket entries lie in the
ideal.  This is weaker than the project predicate `IsPoisson`. -/
def IsInvolutive (J : Ideal (SymbolRing k n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ f ∈ J, ∀ g ∈ J, poissonBracket f g ∈ J
Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExte.unfolded: {k : Type u} → [inst : Field k] → {n : ℕ} → Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k) → Prop

Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.doc: Coordinate ring of affine cotangent space.
Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.signature: Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.{u_1} (k : Type u_1) [CommRing k] (n : ℕ) : Type u_1
Stafford38.Characteristic.SymbolRing.source:
/-- Coordinate ring of affine cotangent space. -/
abbrev SymbolRing (k : Type*) [CommRing k] (n : ℕ) :=
  MvPolynomial (PhaseVar n) k

Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.doc: The standard Poisson bracket on affine cotangent space.
Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.signature:
Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [CommRing k] {n : ℕ}
  (f g : SymbolRing k n) : SymbolRing k n
Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.source:
/-- The standard Poisson bracket on affine cotangent space. -/
noncomputable def poissonBracket
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n : ℕ}
    (f g : SymbolRing k n) : SymbolRing k n :=
  ∑ i : Fin n,
    (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i : PhaseVar n) f *
        MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i : PhaseVar n) g -
      MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i : PhaseVar n) f *
        MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i : PhaseVar n) g)
Stafford38.Characteristic.poissonBracket.unfolded:
{k : Type u_1} →
  [inst : CommRing k] →
    {n : ℕ} →
      MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k →
        MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k → MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.A.source: abbrev AffineTangentVector (k : Type*) (n : ℕ) := Fin n → k

Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.a.doc:
The embedded conormal space, defined as the annihilator of the embedded
Zariski tangent space.
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.a.source:
/-- The embedded conormal space, defined as the annihilator of the embedded
Zariski tangent space. -/
def affineConormalSpace (y : Fin n → k)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Submodule k (Module.Dual k (AffineTangentVector k n)) :=
  (zariskiTangentSpace y I).dualAnnihilator
Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.a.unfolded:
{k : Type u_1} →

Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralConstantCoordinateAxis.exists_constant_coordinate_equation_and_pure_axis.{u}
  {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (halg : IsAlgebraic k (AffineComponentCoordinateSplit.componentCoordinate P ⟨0, hm⟩)) :
  ∃ c y,
    MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ - MvPolynomial.C c ∈ P.asIdeal ∧
      (∀ f ∈ P.asIdeal, (MvPolynomial.eval y) f = 0) ∧
        (Sum.elim y fun j => if j = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) ∈
          AffineConormalClosure.equationConormalLocus P.asIdeal
Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralConstantCoord.source:
theorem exists_constant_coordinate_equation_and_pure_axis
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (halg : IsAlgebraic k (componentCoordinate P ⟨0, hm⟩)) :
    ∃ (c : k) (y : Fin m → k),
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ - MvPolynomial.C c ∈ P.asIdeal ∧
      (∀ f ∈ P.asIdeal, MvPolynomial.eval y f = 0) ∧
      Sum.elim y (fun j ↦ if j = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) ∈
        Stafford38.Geometry.AffineConormalClosure.equationConormalLocus
          P.asIdeal := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ | htrans :=
    coordinate_constant_or_transcendental P ⟨0, hm⟩
  · obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hPM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal P.asIdeal P.isPrime.ne_top
    obtain ⟨y, hMy⟩ :=
      MvPolynomial.isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton.mp hMmax
    have hy : ∀ f ∈ P.asIdeal, MvPolynomial.eval y f = 0 := by
      intro f hf
      have hfM : f ∈ M := hPM hf
      rw [hMy, MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff] at hfM
      exact hfM
    refine ⟨c, y, hc, hy, ?_⟩
    exact constantCoordinate_phasePoint_mem_equationConormalLocus
      P.asIdeal y hy ⟨0, hm⟩ c hc
  · exact False.elim (htrans halg)
Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralConstantCoord.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)),
  IsAlgebraic k
      ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal)
          (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal)))
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal) (MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩))) →
    ∃ c y,
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ - MvPolynomial.C c ∈ P.asIdeal ∧
        (∀ f ∈ P.asIdeal, (MvPolynomial.eval y) f = 0) ∧
          (Sum.elim y fun j => if j = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) ∈
            {q |
              (∀ f ∈ P.asIdeal, (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) f = 0) ∧
                { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, q (Sum.inr i) * v i, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈
                  (Submodule.span k
                        (Set.range fun f =>
                          {
                            toFun := fun v =>
                              ∑ i,
                                (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inl i))
                                    ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f) *
                                  v i,
                            map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })).dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator}

Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralCoordinateAvo.source:
theorem exists_coordinate_inverse_of_avoidance
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {m : ℕ}
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (i : Fin m)
    (havoid : ∀ y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k I, y i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k, MvPolynomial.X i * g - 1 ∈ I := by
  classical
  let J := I ⊔ Ideal.span ({MvPolynomial.X i} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  have htop : J = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨M, hM, hJM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal J hne
    obtain ⟨y, hMy⟩ :=
      MvPolynomial.isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton.mp hM
    have hy : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k I := by
      intro p hp
      have hpM := hJM (show p ∈ J from Ideal.mem_sup_left hp)
      rw [hMy, MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff] at hpM
      exact hpM
    have hxM : MvPolynomial.X i ∈ M :=
      hJM (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
    rw [hMy, MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff] at hxM
    exact havoid y hy (by simpa using hxM)
  have hone : (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) ∈ J := by simp [htop]
  obtain ⟨b, hb, z, hz, hbz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hone
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have heq : MvPolynomial.X i * g - 1 = -b := by
    rw [← hg]
    rw [← hbz]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact I.neg_mem hb

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.IsIrreducibleC.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(a).** A closed set `Y` is irreducible if it is not a union of two
proper closed subsets. -/
def IsIrreducibleClosed (Y : Set (Fin n → k)) : Prop :=
  IsZariskiClosed Y ∧ ¬ ∃ Y₁ Y₂ : Set (Fin n → k), IsZariskiClosed Y₁ ∧ IsZariskiClosed Y₂ ∧
    Y₁ ⊂ Y ∧ Y₂ ⊂ Y ∧ Y = Y₁ ∪ Y₂

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmooth.doc:
**Definition 5.4(b), the Jacobian smooth locus.** `y ∈ Y_sm` iff `y ∈ Y = V(𝔭)` and
the Jacobian matrix `(∂_i g_j(y))` of generators `g_1, …, g_s` of `I(Y) = 𝔭` has rank
`n - dim Y`, written `rank + dim Y = n` with `dim Y` the Krull dimension of `K[x]/𝔭`.
The rank does not depend on the generators
(`jacobian_rank_eq_finrank_differentialSpan`, `jacobianSmoothPoint_iff_span`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmooth.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmoothPoint.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y : Fin n → k) : Prop
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.JacobianSmooth.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(b), the Jacobian smooth locus.** `y ∈ Y_sm` iff `y ∈ Y = V(𝔭)` and
the Jacobian matrix `(∂_i g_j(y))` of generators `g_1, …, g_s` of `I(Y) = 𝔭` has rank
`n - dim Y`, written `rank + dim Y = n` with `dim Y` the Krull dimension of `K[x]/𝔭`.
The rank does not depend on the generators
(`jacobian_rank_eq_finrank_differentialSpan`, `jacobianSmoothPoint_iff_span`). -/
def JacobianSmoothPoint (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y : Fin n → k) : Prop :=
  y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k P.asIdeal ∧
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (g : Fin s → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = P.asIdeal ∧
      ((Matrix.of fun j i ↦ differentialAt y (g j) i).rank : WithBot ℕ∞) +
        ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) = n

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.doc:
The discrete valuation ring of Lemma 5.10 together with the construction
`V = A_{𝔭_D}` of its proof: `A` is the integral closure in `F` of
`C_0 = K[q_0, …, q_n, x̄_1]` and `𝔭_D` is a height-one prime of `A` containing
`x̄_1`.  The fields `isDVR`, `q_mem`, `x_mem_p`, `residue_algebraic` and
`kaehler_finite` are the conclusions (a)–(c) of the lemma; the clause `R ⊄ V`
of (a) is `lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.{u} (k : Type u) {F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F]
  [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : Type u
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.Lemma510Place.source:
/-- The discrete valuation ring of Lemma 5.10 together with the construction
`V = A_{𝔭_D}` of its proof: `A` is the integral closure in `F` of
`C_0 = K[q_0, …, q_n, x̄_1]` and `𝔭_D` is a height-one prime of `A` containing
`x̄_1`.  The fields `isDVR`, `q_mem`, `x_mem_p`, `residue_algebraic` and
`kaehler_finite` are the conclusions (a)–(c) of the lemma; the clause `R ⊄ V`
of (a) is `lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le`. -/
structure Lemma510Place (k : Type u) {F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) where
  A : Subalgebra k F
  [finiteType : Algebra.FiniteType k A]
  [fractionRing : IsFractionRing A F]
  p : Ideal A
  [isPrime : p.IsPrime]
  place : ∀ z : F, z ∈ (placeSubalgebra A p).toSubring ∨
    z⁻¹ ∈ (placeSubalgebra A p).toSubring
  isDVR : IsDiscreteValuationRing (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
  q_mem : ∀ a, homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j ∈ A
  x_mem : x i ∈ A
  x_mem_p : (⟨x i, x_mem⟩ : A) ∈ p
  residue_algebraic :
    letI : Algebra k (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring :=
      ((algebraMap k F).codRestrict (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
        (fun c ↦ ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p place (algebraMap k A c))).toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range fun a ↦ residue (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
          ⟨homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j,
            ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p place ⟨_, q_mem a⟩⟩) :
        IntermediateField k (ResidueField (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring))
      (ResidueField (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring)
  kaehler_finite :
    letI : Algebra k (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring :=
      ((algebraMap k F).codRestrict (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
        (fun c ↦ ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p place (algebraMap k A c))).toAlgebra
    Module.Finite (placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring
      (Ω[(placeValuationSubring A p place).toSubring⁄k])

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaeh.doc:
**`dim Ω_{F/k} = trdeg_k F`.**  For a field `F` generated over `k` by
finitely many elements, in characteristic zero, the Kähler rank is the
transcendence degree (Matsumura, Thm. 26.5), which is finite.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaeh.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaehler_finrank_eq_trdeg.{u} {k F : Type u} [Field k]
  [CharZero k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] {m : ℕ} (y : Fin m → F)
  (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range y) = ⊤) :
  ↑(Module.finrank F Ω[F⁄k]) = Algebra.trdeg k F ∧
    Module.finrank F Ω[F⁄k] = Cardinal.toNat (Algebra.trdeg k F)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaeh.source:
/-- **`dim Ω_{F/k} = trdeg_k F`.**  For a field `F` generated over `k` by
finitely many elements, in characteristic zero, the Kähler rank is the
transcendence degree (Matsumura, Thm. 26.5), which is finite. -/
theorem component_kaehler_finrank_eq_trdeg
    {k F : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    {m : ℕ} (y : Fin m → F)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range y) = ⊤) :
    (Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]) : Cardinal) = Algebra.trdeg k F ∧
      Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]) = (Algebra.trdeg k F).toNat := by
  classical
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range y)) F := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_top, hgen,
      Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral]
    exact Algebra.isIntegral_of_surjective IntermediateField.topEquiv.surjective
  obtain ⟨t, hts, ht⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_subset (R := k) (Set.range y)
  have htfin : t.Finite := (Set.finite_range y).subset hts
  let : Fintype t := htfin.fintype
  have hrank : Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]) = Fintype.card t :=
    kaehlerFinrankOfTranscendenceBasis k F t (↑) ht
  have hcard : (Fintype.card t : Cardinal) = Algebra.trdeg k F := by
    rw [← Cardinal.mk_fintype]
    exact (definition_5_1_g_h ht).2
  refine ⟨by rw [hrank, hcard], ?_⟩
  rw [← hcard, Cardinal.toNat_natCast, hrank]

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaeh.doc:
**Lemma 5.12(a), lower bound.**  The tangent space `Θ_y` at the generic
point, with coefficients extended to `E`, has dimension at least
`dim_F Ω_{F/k}`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaeh.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaehler_finrank_le_generic_tangent_finrank.{u} {k F E : Type u}
  [Field k] [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra k F] [Algebra k E] [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower k F E]
  {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)} [I.IsPrime] [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
  [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F] [IsFractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
  (hgen :
    IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Geometry.GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F)) =
      ⊤) :
  Module.finrank F Ω[F⁄k] ≤
    Module.finrank E
      ↥(Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.zariskiTangentSpace
          (fun i => (algebraMap F E) (Geometry.GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F i))
          (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) I))
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaeh.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.12(a), lower bound.**  The tangent space `Θ_y` at the generic
point, with coefficients extended to `E`, has dimension at least
`dim_F Ω_{F/k}`. -/
theorem component_kaehler_finrank_le_generic_tangent_finrank
    {k F E : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Field E]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k E] [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower k F E]
    {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)} [I.IsPrime]
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
    [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
    [IsFractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range (GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F)) = ⊤) :
    Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]) ≤
      Module.finrank E
        (zariskiTangentSpace
          (fun i ↦ algebraMap F E
            (GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F i))
          (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)))) := by
  classical
  let yF := GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F
  let yE : Fin m → E := fun i ↦ algebraMap F E (yF i)
  let IE : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) E) :=
    I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))
  have hspan : Submodule.span F
      (Set.range fun i ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k F (yF i)) = ⊤ :=
    Stafford38.Geometry.KaehlerSpanSeparableAdjoin.kaehler_span_of_intermediateField_adjoin_eq_top
      (k := k) (E := F) yF hgen
  have : FiniteDimensional F (Ω[F⁄k]) := by
    have : FiniteDimensional F
        (Submodule.span F
          (Set.range fun i ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k F (yF i))) :=
      FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite F (Set.finite_range _)
    have : FiniteDimensional F (⊤ : Submodule F (Ω[F⁄k])) :=
      (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hspan).finiteDimensional
    exact Submodule.topEquiv.finiteDimensional
  -- `Φ ψ = (ψ (d y_i))_i`: the Jacobian-dual coordinates of a form on `Ω`.
  let Φ : Module.Dual F (Ω[F⁄k]) →ₗ[F] (Fin m → F) :=
    { toFun := fun ψ i ↦ ψ (KaehlerDifferential.D k F (yF i))
      map_add' := by intro ψ χ; rfl
      map_smul' := by intro a ψ; rfl }
  have hΦ : LinearMap.ker Φ = ⊥ := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro ψ hψ
    apply LinearMap.ext_on_range hspan
    intro i
    simpa [Φ] using congrFun hψ i
  let b := (Module.finBasis F (Ω[F⁄k])).dualBasis
  let z : Fin (Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k])) → Fin m → F := fun j ↦ Φ (b j)
  have hliF : LinearIndependent F z := b.linearIndependent.map' Φ hΦ
  have hliE : LinearIndependent E (fun j i ↦ algebraMap F E (z j i)) :=
    (linearIndependent_algebraMap_comp_iff (R := F) (S := E)
      (ι' := Fin m)).2 hliF
  have htan (j : Fin (Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]))) :
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap F E (z j i)) ∈ zariskiTangentSpace yE IE := by
    let D : Derivation k F F := (b j).compDer (KaehlerDifferential.D k F)
    have hzD : ∀ i, z j i = D (yF i) := fun i ↦ rfl
    have hcomp : algebraMap k E = (algebraMap F E).comp (algebraMap k F) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k F E
    have hevalE : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k E) yE p =
          algebraMap F E (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k F) yF p) := by
      intro p
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp_left, ← hcomp]
      rfl
    apply mem_zariskiTangentSpace_map_of_forall_mem
    · intro g hg
      rw [hevalE, eval₂_genericPoint_eq_zero hg, map_zero]
    · intro g hg
      have hchain :=
        Stafford38.Geometry.PowerSeriesArcTangency.derivation_eval₂ D g yF
      rw [show yF = GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F from rfl,
        eval₂_genericPoint_eq_zero hg, map_zero] at hchain
      simp_rw [hevalE, hzD, ← map_mul, ← map_sum]
      rw [← hchain, map_zero]
  have hle : Submodule.span E
      (Set.range fun j i ↦ algebraMap F E (z j i)) ≤ zariskiTangentSpace yE IE := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact htan j
  have hrank := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  rw [finrank_span_eq_card hliE, Fintype.card_fin] at hrank
  simpa [yE, IE] using hrank
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.component_kaeh.unfolded:
∀ {k F E : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Field E] [inst_3 : Algebra k F]
  [inst_4 : Algebra k E] [inst_5 : Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower k F E] {m : ℕ}
  {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)} [I.IsPrime] [inst_8 : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
  [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F] [IsFractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F],
  IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
      ⊤ →
    Module.finrank F Ω[F⁄k] ≤
      Module.finrank E
        ↥(Submodule.span E
              (Set.range fun f =>
                {
                  toFun := fun v =>
                    ∑ i,
                      (MvPolynomial.eval fun i =>
                            (algebraMap F E)
                              ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F)
                                ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (MvPolynomial.X i))))
                          ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f) *
                        v i,
                  map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })).dualCoannihilator

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalCone.doc:
**Definition 5.4(d), as printed.** The conormal cone
`N(Y) = ⋃_{y ∈ Y_sm} N*_y Y` over the Jacobian smooth locus, with
`N*_y Y = span_K {df_y : f ∈ I(Y)}`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalCone.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
