**`N(Y)` as printed is the Lean conormal cone**: the Jacobian smooth locus is Mathlib's
smooth locus (`definition_5_4_b_iff`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalCone_p.source:
/-- **`N(Y)` as printed is the Lean conormal cone**: the Jacobian smooth locus is Mathlib's
smooth locus (`definition_5_4_b_iff`). -/
theorem conormalCone_paper_eq [CharZero k] (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    conormalCone P = smoothConormalFibreProjection P.asIdeal := by
  ext ξ
  rw [definition_5_4_d]
  simp only [conormalCone, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, definition_5_4_b_iff]
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.conormalCone_p.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {n : ℕ} [CharZero k]
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)),
  {ξ |
      ∃ y,
        (y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k P.asIdeal ∧
            ∃ s g,
              Ideal.span (Set.range g) = P.asIdeal ∧
                ↑(Matrix.of fun j i => (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (g j))).rank +
                    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) =
                  ↑n) ∧
          ξ ∈
            Submodule.span k
              (Set.range fun f i => (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f))} =
    {ξ |
      ∃ y,
        (∃ e,
            (∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k),
                e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal) p) = (MvPolynomial.aeval y) p) ∧
              have hprime := ⋯;
              { asIdeal := RingHom.ker e.toRingHom, isPrime := hprime } ∈
                Algebra.smoothLocus k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ P.asIdeal)) ∧
          { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, ξ i * v i, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈
            (Submodule.span k
                  (Set.range fun f =>
                    {
                      toFun := fun v =>
                        ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f) * v i,
                      map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })).dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator}

`{[ξ] : 0 ≠ ξ ∈ N(Y)}`; projective Zariski closed sets are the common zero sets of
homogeneous polynomials.

/-- **Definition 5.5, as printed.** `Dir(Y)` is the Zariski closure in `ℙ((K^n)^*)` of

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1.doc:
**Definition 5.1, closing sentence.** The elements of `L` that are algebraic over
`K` form a subfield, and every finite set generating `L` over `K` contains a
transcendence basis ([Lang, Thm. VIII.1.1]).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1_closing.{u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [Field K]
  [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
  (∃ E, ∀ (z : L), z ∈ E ↔ IsAlgebraic K z) ∧
    ∀ (S : Set L),
      S.Finite → IntermediateField.adjoin K S = ⊤ → ∃ B ⊆ S, IsTranscendenceBasis K Subtype.val
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1.source:
/-- **Definition 5.1, closing sentence.** The elements of `L` that are algebraic over
`K` form a subfield, and every finite set generating `L` over `K` contains a
transcendence basis ([Lang, Thm. VIII.1.1]). -/
theorem definition_5_1_closing :
    (∃ E : IntermediateField K L, ∀ z : L, z ∈ E ↔ IsAlgebraic K z) ∧
      ∀ S : Set L, S.Finite → IntermediateField.adjoin K S = ⊤ →
        ∃ B ⊆ S, IsTranscendenceBasis K ((↑) : B → L) := by
  refine ⟨⟨algebraicClosure K L, fun z => mem_algebraicClosure_iff⟩, fun S _ hS => ?_⟩
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin K S) L := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_top, hS]
    exact ⟨fun z => ⟨Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ⟨z, trivial⟩, Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _,
      by simp [Polynomial.aeval_def]⟩⟩
  exact exists_isTranscendenceBasis_subset S

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1.doc:
**Definition 5.1(g)–(h).** For a transcendence basis `B` of `L/K`, `L` is algebraic
over `K(B)`, and `|B| = trdeg_K L`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1_g_h.{u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [Field K]
  [Field L] [Algebra K L] {B : Set L} (hB : IsTranscendenceBasis K Subtype.val) :
  Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range Subtype.val))) L ∧
    Cardinal.mk ↑B = Algebra.trdeg K L
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_1.source:
/-- **Definition 5.1(g)–(h).** For a transcendence basis `B` of `L/K`, `L` is algebraic
over `K(B)`, and `|B| = trdeg_K L`. -/
theorem definition_5_1_g_h {B : Set L} (hB : IsTranscendenceBasis K ((↑) : B → L)) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range ((↑) : B → L))) L ∧
      Cardinal.mk B = Algebra.trdeg K L :=
  ⟨hB.isAlgebraic_field, hB.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.doc:
**Definition 5.2(b).** `Ω_{κ/K}`, the quotient of the free module `𝒢` by the printed
relations, is Mathlib's `Ω[κ⁄K]`, with the class of `⟨a⟩` going to `da`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2_b.{u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [Field K]
  [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
  ∃ e, ∀ (a : L), e (Submodule.Quotient.mk fun₀ | a => 1) = (KaehlerDifferential.D K L) a
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.source:
/-- **Definition 5.2(b).** `Ω_{κ/K}`, the quotient of the free module `𝒢` by the printed
relations, is Mathlib's `Ω[κ⁄K]`, with the class of `⟨a⟩` going to `da`. -/
theorem definition_5_2_b :
    ∃ e : ((L →₀ L) ⧸ differentialRelations K L) ≃ₗ[L] Ω[L⁄K],
      ∀ a : L, e (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single a 1)) = KaehlerDifferential.D K L a := by
  refine ⟨(Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ differentialRelations_eq_kerTotal).trans
    (KaehlerDifferential.quotKerTotalEquiv K L), fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  simp [KaehlerDifferential.quotKerTotalEquiv]

∀ {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L],
  ∃ e, ∀ (a : L), e (Submodule.Quotient.mk fun₀ | a => 1) = (KaehlerDifferential.D K L) a

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.doc:
**Definition 5.2(c).** A basis `dβ_1, …, dβ_d` of `Ω_{κ/K}` has dual derivations
`D_k` with `D_k(β_l) = δ_{kl}`, namely `D_k = (dβ_k)^* ∘ d`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2_c.{u_2, u_3, u_4} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [Field K]
  [Field L] [Algebra K L] {ι : Type u_4} [DecidableEq ι] (β : ι → L) (b : Module.Basis ι L Ω[L⁄K])
  (hb : ∀ (l : ι), b l = (KaehlerDifferential.D K L) (β l)) :
  ∃ D, ∀ (k' l : ι), (D k') (β l) = if k' = l then 1 else 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.source:
/-- **Definition 5.2(c).** A basis `dβ_1, …, dβ_d` of `Ω_{κ/K}` has dual derivations
`D_k` with `D_k(β_l) = δ_{kl}`, namely `D_k = (dβ_k)^* ∘ d`. -/
theorem definition_5_2_c {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (β : ι → L)
    (b : Module.Basis ι L Ω[L⁄K]) (hb : ∀ l, b l = KaehlerDifferential.D K L (β l)) :
    ∃ D : ι → Derivation K L L, ∀ k' l, D k' (β l) = if k' = l then 1 else 0 := by
  -- `dβ_l` is the class of `⟨β_l⟩` (Definition 5.2(b)); `D_k` is the derivation
  -- of the coordinate functional `(dβ_k)^*` on `Ω_{κ/K}`.
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := definition_5_2_b (K := K) (L := L)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, -⟩ := definition_5_2_c_correspondence (K := K) (L := L)
  refine ⟨fun k' ↦ c (b.coord k'), fun k' l ↦ ?_⟩
  have hb' : ∀ l, b l = e (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single (β l) 1)) :=
    fun l ↦ (hb l).trans (he _).symm
  rw [hc, ← he, ← hb', Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : k' = l
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.doc:
**Definition 5.2(c), first sentences.** A `K`-derivation `D` of `κ` induces the
`κ`-linear map `Ω_{κ/K} → κ`, `da ↦ D(a)`, and conversely a `κ`-linear map
`φ : Ω_{κ/K} → κ` gives the `K`-derivation `a ↦ φ(da)`; the two constructions are
inverse (`KaehlerDifferential.linearMapEquivDerivation`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2_c_correspondence.{u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3}
  [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
  ∃ e,
    (∀ (φ : Ω[L⁄K] →ₗ[L] L) (a : L), (e φ) a = φ ((KaehlerDifferential.D K L) a)) ∧
      ∀ (D : Derivation K L L) (a : L), (e.symm D) ((KaehlerDifferential.D K L) a) = D a
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_2.source:
/-- **Definition 5.2(c), first sentences.** A `K`-derivation `D` of `κ` induces the
`κ`-linear map `Ω_{κ/K} → κ`, `da ↦ D(a)`, and conversely a `κ`-linear map
`φ : Ω_{κ/K} → κ` gives the `K`-derivation `a ↦ φ(da)`; the two constructions are
inverse (`KaehlerDifferential.linearMapEquivDerivation`). -/
theorem definition_5_2_c_correspondence :
    ∃ e : (Ω[L⁄K] →ₗ[L] L) ≃ₗ[L] Derivation K L L,
      (∀ (φ : Ω[L⁄K] →ₗ[L] L) (a : L), e φ a = φ (KaehlerDifferential.D K L a)) ∧
        ∀ (D : Derivation K L L) (a : L), e.symm D (KaehlerDifferential.D K L a) = D a :=
  ⟨KaehlerDifferential.linearMapEquivDerivation K L, fun _ _ => rfl,
    fun D a => D.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D a⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_3.doc:
**Definition 5.3.** Let `F` be a field.
(a) A subring `W ⊆ F` is a valuation ring of `F` iff `a ∈ W` or `a⁻¹ ∈ W` for
every `a ∈ F^×`; it is a local ring with maximal ideal `𝔪_W = W ∖ W^×`.
(b) A valuation ring `V` is a discrete valuation ring iff it is Noetherian and
`V ≠ F`; then `𝔪_V` is generated by some `ϖ ∈ V`, and every `f ∈ F^×` is
`f = ϖ^k u` with `u ∈ V^×` and a unique `k = ord_V(f) ∈ ℤ`.
(c) For a field `κ`, `κ((t))` (`LaurentSeries κ`) is the fraction field of
`κ[[t]]` (`PowerSeries κ`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_3.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_3.{u} {F : Type u} [Field F] :
  (∀ (S : Subring F), (∀ (a : F), a ≠ 0 → a ∈ S ∨ a⁻¹ ∈ S) ↔ ∃ W, W.toSubring = S) ∧
    (∀ (W : ValuationSubring F),
        IsLocalRing ↥W.toSubring ∧
          ∀ (w : ↥W.toSubring), w ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥W.toSubring ↔ ¬IsUnit w) ∧
      (∀ (V : ValuationSubring F),
          IsDiscreteValuationRing ↥V.toSubring ↔ IsNoetherianRing ↥V.toSubring ∧ V ≠ ⊤) ∧
        (∀ (V : ValuationSubring F),
            IsDiscreteValuationRing ↥V.toSubring →
              ∃ ϖ,
                IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V.toSubring = Ideal.span {ϖ} ∧
                  ∀ (f : F), f ≠ 0 → ∃! k, ∃ u, f = ↑ϖ ^ k * ↑↑u) ∧
          ∀ (κ : Type u) [inst : Field κ], IsFractionRing (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_3.source:
/-- **Definition 5.3.** Let `F` be a field.
(a) A subring `W ⊆ F` is a valuation ring of `F` iff `a ∈ W` or `a⁻¹ ∈ W` for
every `a ∈ F^×`; it is a local ring with maximal ideal `𝔪_W = W ∖ W^×`.
(b) A valuation ring `V` is a discrete valuation ring iff it is Noetherian and
`V ≠ F`; then `𝔪_V` is generated by some `ϖ ∈ V`, and every `f ∈ F^×` is
`f = ϖ^k u` with `u ∈ V^×` and a unique `k = ord_V(f) ∈ ℤ`.
(c) For a field `κ`, `κ((t))` (`LaurentSeries κ`) is the fraction field of
`κ[[t]]` (`PowerSeries κ`). -/
theorem definition_5_3 {F : Type u} [Field F] :
    (∀ S : Subring F,
        (∀ a : F, a ≠ 0 → a ∈ S ∨ a⁻¹ ∈ S) ↔ ∃ W : ValuationSubring F, W.toSubring = S) ∧
      (∀ W : ValuationSubring F,
        IsLocalRing W.toSubring ∧ ∀ w : W.toSubring, w ∈ maximalIdeal W.toSubring ↔ ¬ IsUnit w) ∧
      (∀ V : ValuationSubring F,
        IsDiscreteValuationRing V.toSubring ↔ IsNoetherianRing V.toSubring ∧ V ≠ ⊤) ∧
      (∀ V : ValuationSubring F, IsDiscreteValuationRing V.toSubring →
        ∃ ϖ : V.toSubring, maximalIdeal V.toSubring = Ideal.span {ϖ} ∧
          ∀ f : F, f ≠ 0 → ∃! k : ℤ, ∃ u : V.toSubringˣ,
            f = (ϖ : F) ^ k * ((u : V.toSubring) : F)) ∧
      ∀ (κ : Type u) [Field κ], IsFractionRing (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ) := by
  refine ⟨fun S => ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩, fun W => ⟨inferInstance, fun w => ?_⟩,
    fun V => ⟨fun hV => ?_, fun ⟨hN, hV⟩ => ?_⟩, fun V hV => ?_, fun κ _ => inferInstance⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨S, fun a => ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · exact Or.inl (ha ▸ S.zero_mem)
    · exact h a ha
  · rintro ⟨W, rfl⟩ a _
    exact W.mem_or_inv_mem a
  · rw [mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  · refine ⟨inferInstance, fun hVtop => IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField V.toSubring ?_⟩
    exact (step_5_3_isField_iff V).2 hVtop
  · have hfield : ¬ IsField V.toSubring := fun h => hV ((step_5_3_isField_iff V).1 h)
    have := step_5_3_valuationRing V
    exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE V.toSubring hfield).out 1 2).2 this
  · obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible V.toSubring
    refine ⟨ϖ, hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, fun f hf => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨k, u, hku⟩ := step_5_3_ord_exists V hϖ hf
    exact ⟨k, ⟨u, hku⟩, fun l ⟨u', hl⟩ => step_5_3_ord_unique V hϖ (hl.symm.trans hku)⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.doc:
**Definition 5.4(a), "equivalently if `I(Y)` is prime"** ([Hartshorne, Cor. I.1.4]).
As there, `Y` is nonempty (the empty set has `I(∅) = K[x]`, which is not prime).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(a), "equivalently if `I(Y)` is prime"** ([Hartshorne, Cor. I.1.4]).
As there, `Y` is nonempty (the empty set has `I(∅) = K[x]`, which is not prime). -/
theorem definition_5_4_a {Y : Set (Fin n → k)} (hne : Y.Nonempty) (hY : IsZariskiClosed Y) :
    IsIrreducibleClosed Y ↔ (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k Y).IsPrime := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hirr⟩
    refine ⟨fun htop => ?_, fun {f g} hfg => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
      have h1 : (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k Y :=
        htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
      have := MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.mp h1 y hy
      simp at this
    · by_contra h
      push Not at h
      obtain ⟨hf, hg⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨J, rfl⟩ := hY
      apply hirr
      have hproper : ∀ e : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k, e ∉ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k
          (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k J) →
          MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (J ⊔ Ideal.span {e}) ⊂ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k J := by
        intro e he
        refine ⟨MvPolynomial.zeroLocus_anti_mono le_sup_left, fun hsub => he ?_⟩
        rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
        intro y hy
        exact ((mem_zeroLocus_sup_span_singleton J e y).mp (hsub hy)).2
      refine ⟨_, _, ⟨_, rfl⟩, ⟨_, rfl⟩, hproper f hf, hproper g hg, ?_⟩
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_union, mem_zeroLocus_sup_span_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have h0 := MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.mp hfg y hy
        rw [map_mul] at h0
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h0 | h0
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, h0⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, h0⟩
      · rintro (⟨hy, -⟩ | ⟨hy, -⟩) <;> exact hy
  · intro hP
    refine ⟨hY, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨Y₁, Y₂, hY₁, hY₂, h₁, h₂, hU⟩
    -- a proper closed `Y_i` is cut out inside `Y` by some `f_i ∈ I(Y_i) ∖ I(Y)`
    have hsep : ∀ Z : Set (Fin n → k), IsZariskiClosed Z → Z ⊂ Y →
        ∃ f ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k Z, f ∉ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k Y := by
      intro Z hZ hZY
      obtain ⟨y, hyY, hyZ⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset hZY
      rw [← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_of_isZariskiClosed hZ, MvPolynomial.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at hyZ
      push Not at hyZ
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfy⟩ := hyZ
      exact ⟨f, hf, fun hfY => hfy (MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.mp hfY y hyY)⟩
    obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, hf₁Y⟩ := hsep Y₁ hY₁ h₁
    obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂, hf₂Y⟩ := hsep Y₂ hY₂ h₂
    have hprod : f₁ * f₂ ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k Y := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
      intro y hy
      rw [hU] at hy
      rw [map_mul]
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.mp hf₁ y hy, zero_mul]
      · rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.mp hf₂ y hy, mul_zero]
    rcases hP.mem_or_mem hprod with h | h
    · exact hf₁Y h
    · exact hf₂Y h

∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ} {Y : Set (Fin n → k)},
  Y.Nonempty →
    (∃ J, Y = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k J) →
      (((∃ J, Y = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k J) ∧
          ¬∃ Y₁ Y₂,
              (∃ J, Y₁ = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k J) ∧
                (∃ J, Y₂ = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k J) ∧ Y₁ ⊂ Y ∧ Y₂ ⊂ Y ∧ Y = Y₁ ∪ Y₂) ↔
        (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k Y).IsPrime)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.doc:
**Definition 5.4(b), the Jacobian criterion.** `y` lies in Mathlib's smooth locus of
`K[x]/𝔭` iff the Jacobian of `𝔭` has rank `n - dim Y` at `y ∈ Y`.  The converse direction
picks equations `f_1, …, f_c ∈ 𝔭` with independent differentials at `y` and applies
`smoothAffinePoint_of_jacobian`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4_b_iff.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} [IsAlgClosed k]
  [CharZero k] (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y : Fin n → k) :
  Geometry.SmoothAffineConormal.SmoothAffinePoint P.asIdeal y ↔ JacobianSmoothPoint P y
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(b), the Jacobian criterion.** `y` lies in Mathlib's smooth locus of
`K[x]/𝔭` iff the Jacobian of `𝔭` has rank `n - dim Y` at `y ∈ Y`.  The converse direction
picks equations `f_1, …, f_c ∈ 𝔭` with independent differentials at `y` and applies
`smoothAffinePoint_of_jacobian`. -/
theorem definition_5_4_b_iff [CharZero k]
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y : Fin n → k) :
    SmoothAffinePoint P.asIdeal y ↔ JacobianSmoothPoint P y := by
  classical
  refine ⟨definition_5_4_b P, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have hle := componentDimension_le P
  rw [jacobianSmoothPoint_iff_trdeg] at h
  obtain ⟨hy, hr⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨s, hsub, hspan, hli⟩ :=
    exists_linearIndependent k (Set.range fun f : P.asIdeal ↦ differentialAt y f.1)
  have : Fintype s := (hli.setFinite).fintype
  have hcard : Fintype.card s = Module.finrank k
      (Submodule.span k (Set.range fun f : P.asIdeal ↦ differentialAt y f.1)) := by
    rw [← hspan, ← finrank_span_eq_card hli, Subtype.range_coe]
  have hg : ∀ v : s, ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k, g ∈ P.asIdeal ∧ differentialAt y g = v :=
    fun v ↦ by
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hsub v.2
      exact ⟨g.1, g.2, hg⟩
  choose g hgP hgd using hg
  have hli' : LinearIndependent k fun v : s ↦ differentialAt y (g v) := by
    convert hli using 1
    funext v
    exact hgd v
  exact smoothAffinePoint_of_jacobian P hy g hgP hli' (by
    change Fintype.card s + componentDimension P = n
    omega)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ} [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y : Fin n → k),
  (∃ e,
      (∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k),
          e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal) p) = (MvPolynomial.aeval y) p) ∧
        have hprime := ⋯;
        { asIdeal := RingHom.ker e.toRingHom, isPrime := hprime } ∈
          Algebra.smoothLocus k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ P.asIdeal)) ↔
    y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k P.asIdeal ∧
      ∃ s g,
        Ideal.span (Set.range g) = P.asIdeal ∧
          ↑(Matrix.of fun j i => (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (g j))).rank +
              ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) =
            ↑n

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.doc:
**Definition 5.4(c).** `N*_y Y = span_K {df_y : f ∈ I}`, with covectors in
coordinates.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4_c.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y ξ : Fin n → k) :
  Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.coordinateCovector ξ ∈
      Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.affineConormalSpace y I ↔
    ξ ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun f => Geometry.CoisotropicTranslation.differentialAt y ↑f)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(c).** `N*_y Y = span_K {df_y : f ∈ I}`, with covectors in
coordinates. -/
theorem definition_5_4_c
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y ξ : Fin n → k) :
    coordinateCovector ξ ∈ affineConormalSpace y I ↔
      ξ ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun f : I => differentialAt y f.1) := by
  have hspan : equationCovectorSpan y I =
      (Submodule.span k (Set.range fun f : I => differentialAt y f.1)).map
        (coordinateCovectorLinear (k := k) (n := n)) := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [affineConormalSpace_eq_equationCovectorSpan, hspan]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨η, hη, hηξ⟩
    have : η = ξ := coordinateCovector_injective hηξ
    exact this ▸ hη
  · intro hξ
    exact ⟨ξ, hξ, rfl⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (y ξ : Fin n → k),
  { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, ξ i * v i, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈
      (Submodule.span k
            (Set.range fun f =>
              { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f) * v i,
                map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })).dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator ↔
    ξ ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun f i => (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f))

**Definition 5.4(d).** `N(Y) = ⋃_{y ∈ Y_sm} N*_y Y`, in the paper's form of
`N*_y Y`.

  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (ξ : Fin n → k) :
  ξ ∈ Geometry.ProjectiveConormalDirections.smoothConormalFibreProjection I ↔

      Geometry.SmoothAffineConormal.SmoothAffinePoint I y ∧

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_4.source:
/-- **Definition 5.4(d).** `N(Y) = ⋃_{y ∈ Y_sm} N*_y Y`, in the paper's form of
`N*_y Y`. -/
theorem definition_5_4_d
    [IsAlgClosed k] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (ξ : Fin n → k) :
    ξ ∈ smoothConormalFibreProjection I ↔
      ∃ y, SmoothAffinePoint I y ∧
        ξ ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range fun f : I => differentialAt y f.1) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hξ⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, (definition_5_4_c I y ξ).1 hξ⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hξ⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, (definition_5_4_c I y ξ).2 hξ⟩

    ∃ y,

/-- **Definition 5.5.** The printed `Dir(Y)` is the Lean direction closure used in
Theorem 5.7(ii). -/
theorem definition_5_5 [CharZero k] (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    conormalDirections P = projectiveHomogeneousClosure
      (projectivizedDirectionSet (smoothConormalDirectionSet P.asIdeal)) := by
  rw [projectivizedDirectionSet_smoothConormalDirectionSet, conormalDirections,
    conormalCone_paper_eq]

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_6.doc:
**Definition 5.6.** `W` is fibre-conical iff it is stable under the
fibrewise scaling `(y, ξ) ↦ (y, tξ)`, `t ∈ K^×`: the scaling maps
`W ∩ T*_y X` into `W ∩ T*_y X` for every fibre `T*_y X = π⁻¹(y)`
(`Section2.fibre`, Definition 2.5).
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_6.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_6.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {n : ℕ} [IsAlgClosed k]

  Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical W ↔

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.definition_5_6.source:
/-- **Definition 5.6.** `W` is fibre-conical iff it is stable under the
fibrewise scaling `(y, ξ) ↦ (y, tξ)`, `t ∈ K^×`: the scaling maps
`W ∩ T*_y X` into `W ∩ T*_y X` for every fibre `T*_y X = π⁻¹(y)`
(`Section2.fibre`, Definition 2.5). -/
theorem definition_5_6
    [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] (W : Set (PhaseVar n → k)) :
    Stafford38.Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical W ↔
      ∀ y ξ : Fin n → k, Sum.elim y ξ ∈ W ∩ Stafford38.Paper.Section2.fibre y →
        ∀ t : k, t ≠ 0 → Sum.elim y (t • ξ) ∈ W ∩ Stafford38.Paper.Section2.fibre y := by
  constructor
  · intro hW y ξ hq t ht
    exact ⟨by simpa [Pi.smul_def] using hW _ hq.1 t ht, rfl⟩
  · intro hW q hq t ht
    have hsplit : q = Sum.elim (fun i => q (.inl i)) (fun i => q (.inr i)) := by
      funext i; cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hsplit] at hq
    simpa [Pi.smul_def] using (hW _ _ ⟨hq, rfl⟩ t ht).1

∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ} [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
  (W : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n → k)),
  (∀ q ∈ W, ∀ (a : k), a ≠ 0 → (Sum.elim (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) fun i => a * q (Sum.inr i)) ∈ W) ↔
    ∀ (y ξ : Fin n → k),
      Sum.elim y ξ ∈ W ∩ (fun z i => z (Sum.inl i)) ⁻¹' {y} →
        ∀ (t : k), t ≠ 0 → Sum.elim y (t • ξ) ∈ W ∩ (fun z i => z (Sum.inl i)) ⁻¹' {y}

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.differentialRe.doc:
The relations of Definition 5.2(b) in the free `κ`-vector space `𝒢` on symbols
`⟨a⟩ = Finsupp.single a 1`: `⟨a+b⟩ - ⟨a⟩ - ⟨b⟩`, `⟨ab⟩ - a⟨b⟩ - b⟨a⟩`, `⟨c⟩` (`c ∈ K`).

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.differentialRelations.{u_4, u_5} (K : Type u_4) (κ : Type u_5) [Field K]
  [Field κ] [Algebra K κ] : Submodule κ (κ →₀ κ)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.differentialRe.source:
/-- The relations of Definition 5.2(b) in the free `κ`-vector space `𝒢` on symbols
`⟨a⟩ = Finsupp.single a 1`: `⟨a+b⟩ - ⟨a⟩ - ⟨b⟩`, `⟨ab⟩ - a⟨b⟩ - b⟨a⟩`, `⟨c⟩` (`c ∈ K`). -/
def differentialRelations (K κ : Type*) [Field K] [Field κ] [Algebra K κ] :
    Submodule κ (κ →₀ κ) :=
  Submodule.span κ
    (((Set.range fun x : κ × κ ↦
        Finsupp.single (x.1 + x.2) 1 - Finsupp.single x.1 1 - Finsupp.single x.2 1) ∪
      Set.range fun x : κ × κ ↦
        Finsupp.single (x.1 * x.2) 1 - x.1 • Finsupp.single x.2 1 -
          x.2 • Finsupp.single x.1 1) ∪
      Set.range fun c : K ↦ Finsupp.single (algebraMap K κ c) 1)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.eval_residue_e.doc:
The closing computation of the final paragraph for a phase point of the
equation conormal: a polynomial vanishing on `N(Y)` vanishes at the residue of
a regular fibre coordinate `ξ(t)` attached to a Laurent point `y` of `Y`.

  [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] {m : ℕ}
  (I : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (Pol : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
  (hPol :
    Pol ∈
      MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k
        (Geometry.ProjectiveConormalDirections.smoothConormalFibreProjection I.asIdeal))
  (y : Fin m → LaurentSeries K) (xi : Fin m → PowerSeries K)
  (hgeneric :
    (Sum.elim y fun i => (algebraMap (PowerSeries K) (LaurentSeries K)) (xi i)) ∈
      Geometry.LaurentConormalResidueExtension.groundEquationConormalLocus I.asIdeal) :
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k K) (GeometryRetractionSpecialization.residueColumn xi) Pol = 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.eval_residue_e.source:
/-- The closing computation of the final paragraph for a phase point of the
equation conormal: a polynomial vanishing on `N(Y)` vanishes at the residue of
a regular fibre coordinate `ξ(t)` attached to a Laurent point `y` of `Y`. -/
theorem eval_residue_eq_zero_of_mem_groundEquationConormalLocus
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] {m : ℕ}
    (I : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (Pol : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (hPol : Pol ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (smoothConormalFibreProjection I.asIdeal))
    (y : Fin m → LaurentSeries K) (xi : Fin m → PowerSeries K)
    (hgeneric : Sum.elim y
        (fun i ↦ algebraMap (PowerSeries K) (LaurentSeries K) (xi i)) ∈
      groundEquationConormalLocus (k := k) (K := K) I.asIdeal) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k K) (residueColumn xi) Pol = 0 := by
  have hfull := fibreLift_mem_vanishingIdeal_equationConormal I.asIdeal I.isPrime Pol hPol
  -- `Φ(x, μ) = P(Σ μ_k ∇g_k(x))` has coefficients in `𝔭`, so it vanishes at `y`.
  have hvan : ∀ q ∈ groundEquationConormalLocus (k := k) (K := K) I.asIdeal,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ (groundLaurentMap (k := k) (K := K)) q (fibreLift Pol) = 0 := by
    letI : Algebra k (LaurentSeries K) :=
      (groundLaurentMap (k := k) (K := K)).toAlgebra
    intro q hq
    exact scalarExtension_vanishing I.asIdeal (fibreLift Pol) hfull q hq
  have hpoly := residueFibreLift_mem_extensionValuedVanishingIdeal_of_ground_vanishing
    I.asIdeal Pol hvan
  -- `P(ξ(t)) = 0` in `κ[[t]]`, so its constant term `P(ξ(0))` vanishes.
  have hclosure := residue_mem_residueExtensionFibreClosure_of_laurent_generic
    (K := K) (groundEquationConormalLocus (k := k) (K := K) I.asIdeal) y xi hgeneric
  have hzero := hclosure _ hpoly
  simpa [residuePolynomialMap, scalarPolynomialMap] using hzero
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.eval_residue_e.unfolded:
∀ {k K : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra k K] {m : ℕ}
  (I : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)),
  ∀
    Pol ∈
      MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k
        {ξ |
          ∃ y,
            (∃ e,
                (∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
                    e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I.asIdeal) p) = (MvPolynomial.aeval y) p) ∧
                  have hprime := ⋯;
                  { asIdeal := RingHom.ker e.toRingHom, isPrime := hprime } ∈
                    Algebra.smoothLocus k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I.asIdeal)) ∧
              { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, ξ i * v i, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈
                (Submodule.span k
                      (Set.range fun f =>
                        {
                          toFun := fun v =>
                            ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f) * v i,
                          map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })).dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator},
    ∀ (y : Fin m → LaurentSeries K) (xi : Fin m → PowerSeries K),
      (Sum.elim y fun i => (algebraMap (PowerSeries K) (LaurentSeries K)) (xi i)) ∈
          {q |
            (∀ f ∈ Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries K))) I.asIdeal,
                (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) f = 0) ∧
              { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, q (Sum.inr i) * v i, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈
                (Submodule.span (LaurentSeries K)
                      (Set.range fun f =>
                        {
                          toFun := fun v =>
                            ∑ i,
                              (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inl i))
                                  ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f) *
                                v i,
                          map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })).dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator} →
        MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k K) (fun i => PowerSeries.constantCoeff (xi i)) Pol = 0

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.exists_kaehler.source:
/-- **Nakayama's lemma for `Ω_{V/K}`.**  A finitely generated `Ω_{V/K}` is
generated by `dim_κ (κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K})` elements. -/
theorem exists_kaehler_generators [Module.Finite V (Ω[V⁄k])] :
    ∃ f : Fin (Module.finrank (ResidueField V) (ResidueField V ⊗[V] Ω[V⁄k])) → Ω[V⁄k],
      Submodule.span V (Set.range f) = ⊤ := by
  let b := Module.finBasis (ResidueField V) (ResidueField V ⊗[V] Ω[V⁄k])
  have hmk := TensorProduct.mk_surjective V (Ω[V⁄k]) (ResidueField V)
    (residue_surjective (R := V))
  choose f hf using fun i ↦ hmk (b i)
  exact ⟨f, IsLocalRing.span_eq_top_of_tmul_eq_basis f b hf⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_fracti.doc:
**`F ⊗_V Ω_{V/K} = Ω_{F/K}`.**  Generators of `Ω_{V/K}` span `Ω_{F/K}`
over the fraction field `F`, so `dim_F Ω_{F/K}` is at most their number.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_fracti.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_fraction_kaehler_le_of_span.{u, u_1} {k V : Type u} [Field k]
  [CommRing V] [Algebra k V] {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra V F] [IsFractionRing V F] [Algebra k F]
  [IsScalarTower k V F] {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Ω[V⁄k])
  (hf : Submodule.span V (Set.range f) = ⊤) : Module.finrank F Ω[F⁄k] ≤ Fintype.card ι
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_fracti.source:
/-- **`F ⊗_V Ω_{V/K} = Ω_{F/K}`.**  Generators of `Ω_{V/K}` span `Ω_{F/K}`
over the fraction field `F`, so `dim_F Ω_{F/K}` is at most their number. -/
theorem finrank_fraction_kaehler_le_of_span
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra V F] [IsFractionRing V F] [Algebra k F]
    [IsScalarTower k V F] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Ω[V⁄k])
    (hf : Submodule.span V (Set.range f) = ⊤) :
    Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]) ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
  have : Algebra.FormallyEtale V F := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization (nonZeroDivisors V)
  let e := KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k V F
  let g : ι → Ω[F⁄k] := fun i ↦ KaehlerDifferential.map k k V F (f i)
  have hmap : ∀ ω : Ω[V⁄k], KaehlerDifferential.map k k V F ω ∈
      (Submodule.span F (Set.range g)).restrictScalars V := by
    intro ω
    have hω : ω ∈ Submodule.span V (Set.range f) := by rw [hf]; trivial
    have h := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := KaehlerDifferential.map k k V F) hω
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at h
    exact Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars V F _ h
  have hspan : Submodule.span F (Set.range g) = ⊤ := by
    suffices h : ∀ x, e x ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range g) by
      rw [eq_top_iff]
      intro y _
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := e.surjective y
      exact h x
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a ω =>
        rw [KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale_apply,
          KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange_tmul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a (hmap ω)
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  have h := finrank_range_le_card (R := F) g
  rwa [Set.finrank, hspan, finrank_top] at h

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_residu.doc:
**Second fundamental exact sequence for `V → κ`.**  Since
`𝔪_V/𝔪_V² → κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K} → Ω_{κ/K} → 0` is exact and `𝔪_V = (ϖ)`, the
kernel of `κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K} → Ω_{κ/K}` is spanned by `1 ⊗ dϖ`, so
`dim_κ (κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K}) ≤ dim_κ Ω_{κ/K} + 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_residu.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_residue_tensor_kaehler_le.{u} {k V : Type u} [Field k]
  [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] [Algebra k V] [Module.Finite V Ω[V⁄k]] :
  Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)
      (TensorProduct V (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) Ω[V⁄k]) ≤
    Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) Ω[IsLocalRing.ResidueField V⁄k] + 1
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.finrank_residu.source:
/-- **Second fundamental exact sequence for `V → κ`.**  Since
`𝔪_V/𝔪_V² → κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K} → Ω_{κ/K} → 0` is exact and `𝔪_V = (ϖ)`, the
kernel of `κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K} → Ω_{κ/K}` is spanned by `1 ⊗ dϖ`, so
`dim_κ (κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K}) ≤ dim_κ Ω_{κ/K} + 1`. -/
theorem finrank_residue_tensor_kaehler_le [Module.Finite V (Ω[V⁄k])] :
    Module.finrank (ResidueField V) (ResidueField V ⊗[V] Ω[V⁄k]) ≤
      Module.finrank (ResidueField V) (Ω[ResidueField V⁄k]) + 1 := by
  classical
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap V (ResidueField V)) := residue_surjective
  let φ := KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange k V (ResidueField V)
  obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible V
  -- Exactness at `κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K}`: the kernel is the image of `𝔪_V/𝔪_V²`.
  have hker : LinearMap.ker φ ≤ Submodule.span (ResidueField V)
      {(1 : ResidueField V) ⊗ₜ KaehlerDifferential.D k V ϖ} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ LinearMap.range
        (KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor k V (ResidueField V)) := by
      rw [KaehlerDifferential.range_kerCotangentToTensor k V (ResidueField V) hsurj]
      exact hx
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx'
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.toCotangent_surjective _ c
    rw [KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor_toCotangent]
    have hz : (z : V) ∈ maximalIdeal V := by
      rw [← ker_residue]
      exact z.2
    rw [hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hz
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hz
    have hres : (algebraMap V (ResidueField V) ϖ) = 0 := by
      rw [← RingHom.mem_ker]
      change ϖ ∈ RingHom.ker (residue V)
      rw [ker_residue]
      exact hϖ.not_isUnit
    rw [← hv, Derivation.leibniz, tmul_add, tmul_smul, tmul_smul, smul_tmul', smul_tmul',
      Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one, mul_one, hres, zero_tmul, add_zero]
    have : algebraMap V (ResidueField V) v ⊗ₜ[V] KaehlerDifferential.D k V ϖ =
        algebraMap V (ResidueField V) v •
          ((1 : ResidueField V) ⊗ₜ[V] KaehlerDifferential.D k V ϖ) := by
      rw [smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span rfl)
  have hrange : LinearMap.range φ = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr
      (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange_surjective k V (ResidueField V) hsurj)
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker φ
  rw [hrange, finrank_top] at hrn
  have hk : Module.finrank (ResidueField V) (LinearMap.ker φ) ≤ 1 := by
    refine (Submodule.finrank_mono hker).trans ?_
    simpa using finrank_span_le_card (R := ResidueField V)
      ({(1 : ResidueField V) ⊗ₜ[V] KaehlerDifferential.D k V ϖ} :
        Set (ResidueField V ⊗[V] Ω[V⁄k]))
  omega

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.generic_tangen.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.12(a), `dim Θ_y = dim Ω_{F/k}`.**  The tangent space at the
generic point, with coefficients extended to `E ⊇ F`, has the Kähler rank of
the component function field as its dimension. -/
theorem generic_tangent_finrank_eq_component_kaehler_finrank
    {k F E : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Field E]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k E] [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower k F E]
    {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)} [I.IsPrime]
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
    [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
    [IsFractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range (GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F)) = ⊤) :
    Module.finrank E
        (zariskiTangentSpace
          (fun i ↦ algebraMap F E
            (GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F i))
          (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)))) =
      Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]) :=
  le_antisymm
    (PaperGenericTangentRank.generic_tangent_finrank_le_component_kaehler_finrank
      (E := E) hgen)
    (component_kaehler_finrank_le_generic_tangent_finrank (E := E) hgen)

∀ {k F E : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Field E] [inst_3 : Algebra k F]
  [inst_4 : Algebra k E] [inst_5 : Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower k F E] {m : ℕ}
  {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)} [I.IsPrime] [inst_8 : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F]
  [IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F] [IsFractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F],
  IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (MvPolynomial.X i))) =
      ⊤ →
    Module.finrank E
        ↥(Submodule.span E
              (Set.range fun f =>
                {
                  toFun := fun v =>
                    ∑ i,
                      (MvPolynomial.eval fun i =>
                            (algebraMap F E)
                              ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I) F)
                                ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (MvPolynomial.X i))))
                          ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ↑f) *
                        v i,
                  map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })).dualCoannihilator =
      Module.finrank F Ω[F⁄k]

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.ker_rho.source:
/-- The kernel of `ρ` is the line `L q`. -/
theorem ker_rho (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (hq0 : q 0 ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.ker (rho q) = Submodule.span L {q} := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
    refine ⟨v 0 / q 0, ?_⟩
    funext a
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) a
    · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    · have hi := congrFun hv i
      simp only [rho_apply, Pi.zero_apply, div_eq_zero_iff, pow_eq_zero_iff, ne_eq,
        OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, hq0, or_false, sub_eq_zero] at hi
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff hq0]
      linear_combination -hi
  · rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    funext i
    simp
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.ker_rho.unfolded:
∀ {L : Type v} [inst : Field L] {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n + 1) → L),
  q 0 ≠ 0 →
    { toFun := fun v i => (v i.succ * q 0 - q i.succ * v 0) / q 0 ^ 2, map_add' := ⋯,
          map_smul' := ⋯ }.ker =
      L ∙ q

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_10.doc:
**Lemma 5.10.**  For `q_i = x̄_i / x̄_j` from Lemma 5.9 there is a discrete
valuation ring `K ⊆ V ⊊ F` (`Frac V = F` holds for every valuation subring) with
(a) `q_i ∈ V` and `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`, (b) `κ` algebraic over `K(res q_0, …, res q_n)`,
(c) `Ω_{V/K}` finitely generated; the conclusions are the fields of
`Lemma510Place`, which also records `V = A_{𝔭_D}` from the proof.  The clause
`R ⊄ V` of (a) is `lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le`, stated for every valuation ring with
`x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`, which is how the proof of Theorem 5.7 uses it.

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_10.{u} {k F : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Field F]
  [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n)
  (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range x) = ⊤) (htrans : Transcendental k (x i))
  (W : ValuationSubring F) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (hkW : ∀ (c : k), (algebraMap k F) c ∈ W)
  (hxW : ∃ (hx : x i ∈ W), ⟨x i, hx⟩ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥W.toSubring)
  (hj : homogeneousCoordinates x j ≠ 0)
  (hqW : ∀ (a : Fin (n + 1)), homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j ∈ W) :
  Nonempty (Lemma510Place k x i j)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_10.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.10.**  For `q_i = x̄_i / x̄_j` from Lemma 5.9 there is a discrete
valuation ring `K ⊆ V ⊊ F` (`Frac V = F` holds for every valuation subring) with
(a) `q_i ∈ V` and `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`, (b) `κ` algebraic over `K(res q_0, …, res q_n)`,
(c) `Ω_{V/K}` finitely generated; the conclusions are the fields of
`Lemma510Place`, which also records `V = A_{𝔭_D}` from the proof.  The clause
`R ⊄ V` of (a) is `lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le`, stated for every valuation ring with
`x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`, which is how the proof of Theorem 5.7 uses it. -/
theorem lemma_5_10 {k F : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    (htrans : Transcendental k (x i))
    (W : ValuationSubring F) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (hkW : ∀ c : k, algebraMap k F c ∈ W)
    (hxW : ∃ hx : x i ∈ W, (⟨x i, hx⟩ : W.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal W.toSubring)
    (hj : homogeneousCoordinates x j ≠ 0)
    (hqW : ∀ a, homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j ∈ W) :
    Nonempty (Lemma510Place k x i j) := by
  classical
  let Y := homogeneousCoordinates x
  obtain ⟨hxiW, hxmW⟩ := hxW
  have hy0 : x i ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htrans (h ▸ isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hxiInvW : (x i)⁻¹ ∉ W := by
    intro h
    rw [(definition_5_3.2.1 W).2] at hxmW
    apply hxmW
    refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (⟨(x i)⁻¹, h⟩ : W.toSubring) ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [hy0]
  let s : F := (Y j)⁻¹
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hj
  have hjs : Y j * s = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hj
  have hYsW : ∀ a, Y a * s ∈ W := fun a ↦ by simpa [s, div_eq_mul_inv] using hqW a
  -- `C_0 = K[q_0, …, q_n, x̄_1] ⊆ W`, and `A` is its integral closure in `F`.
  let C₀ : Subalgebra k F :=
    Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i})
  let SW : Subalgebra k F := { W.toSubring with algebraMap_mem' := hkW }
  have hC₀W : C₀ ≤ SW := by
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro z (⟨a, rfl⟩ | hz)
    · exact hYsW a
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz]
      exact hxiW
  have htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i}) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hgen]
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.2
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    apply IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_iff_div.mpr
    refine ⟨Y (Fin.succ a) * s, ?_, s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (R := k) (A := F)
        (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self _))
    · have h0 : Y 0 * s ∈ C₀ := Algebra.subset_adjoin (R := k) (A := F)
        (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self (0 : Fin (n + 1))))
      simpa only [Y, homogeneousCoordinates, Fin.cases_zero, one_mul] using h0
    · simp only [Y, Fin.cases_succ]
      exact (eq_div_iff hs).2 rfl
  letI : IsFractionRing C₀ F := IsFractionRing.of_field C₀ F fun z ↦ by
    have hz : z ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i}) := by
      rw [htop]
      exact Set.mem_univ z
    rw [IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_iff_div] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, hab⟩
  let A₀ : Subalgebra C₀ F := integralClosure C₀ F
  let A : Subalgebra k F := A₀.restrictScalars k
  have hC₀A : C₀ ≤ A := fun z hz ↦ A₀.algebraMap_mem ⟨z, hz⟩
  -- `W` is integrally closed, so `A ⊆ W` (Atiyah–Macdonald, Prop. 5.18).
  letI : IsIntegrallyClosedIn W.toSubring F := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn W F)
  have hA₀W : A₀.toSubring ≤ W.toSubring := by
    change (integralClosure C₀ F).toSubring ≤ W.toSubring
    apply (Subring.integralClosure_subring_le_iff (S := C₀) (T := W.toSubring)).2
    exact hC₀W
  have hyA : x i ∈ A := A₀.algebraMap_mem
    ⟨x i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton _))⟩
  have hnormA : ∀ a, Y a * s ∈ A := fun a ↦ A₀.algebraMap_mem
    ⟨Y a * s, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self a))⟩
  have hinvA : (x i)⁻¹ ∉ A := fun h ↦ hxiInvW (hA₀W h)
  -- `A` is a finite `C_0`-module (Hartshorne, Thm. I.3.9A).
  haveI hC₀ft : Algebra.FiniteType k C₀ := Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite
    (Set.Finite.union (Set.finite_range _) (Set.finite_singleton _))
  let D : Subalgebra C₀ (FractionRing C₀) := integralClosure C₀ (FractionRing C₀)
  haveI : Module.Finite C₀ D := finite_normalization_of_fg_domain k C₀ D
  let e : FractionRing C₀ ≃ₐ[C₀] F := IsLocalization.algEquiv C₀⁰ (FractionRing C₀) F
  haveI : Module.Finite C₀ A₀ := Module.Finite.equiv e.mapIntegralClosure.toLinearEquiv
  have hsub : A.toSubring = A₀.toSubring := rfl
  let er : A ≃+* A₀ := RingEquiv.subringCongr hsub
  letI : Algebra C₀ A := (er.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap C₀ A₀)).toAlgebra
  let ea : A₀ ≃ₐ[C₀] A := AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := er.symm) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  letI : IsScalarTower k C₀ A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  letI : IsScalarTower C₀ A F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  haveI : Module.Finite C₀ A := Module.Finite.equiv ea.toLinearEquiv
  haveI hAft : Algebra.FiniteType k A :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans hC₀ft (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType C₀ A)
  have hAic : IsIntegrallyClosedIn A F := by
    apply Subring.isIntegrallyClosedIn_iff.mpr
    intro z hz
    change z ∈ integralClosure C₀ F
    exact isIntegral_trans (R := C₀) (A := A) z hz
  letI : IsFractionRing A F := IsFractionRing.of_field A F fun z ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective C₀ z
    refine ⟨⟨a, hC₀A a.2⟩, ⟨b, hC₀A b.2⟩, ?_⟩
    change z = (a : F) / (b : F)
    exact hab.symm
  have haint : ∀ a : A, IsIntegral C₀ (a : F) := fun a ↦ a.2
  letI : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k A
  letI : IsIntegrallyClosed A := (isIntegrallyClosed_iff_isIntegrallyClosedIn F).mpr hAic
  -- `x̄_1` is a nonzero nonunit of `A`; a minimal prime over it has height one (Krull).
  let xA : A := ⟨x i, hyA⟩
  have hxA0 : xA ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hy0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hxAu : ¬ IsUnit xA := by
    intro hu
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mp hu
    have hzK : x i * (z : F) = 1 := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    apply hinvA
    rw [show (x i)⁻¹ = (z : F) by simpa using congrArg Inv.inv (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hzK)]
    exact z.2
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpheight, hxp, hplace⟩ := stage3_exists_height_one_prime_valuation A xA hxA0 hxAu
  letI : p.IsPrime := hp
  let V : ValuationSubring F := placeValuationSubring A p hplace
  letI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (placeSubalgebra A p) p := by
    unfold placeSubalgebra
    infer_instance
  have hAV : ∀ a : A, (a : F) ∈ V.toSubring := fun a ↦ ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p hplace a
  have hpV : ∀ a : A, (⟨a, hAV a⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal V.toSubring ↔ a ∈ p :=
    fun a ↦ ofField_mem_maximalIdeal_iff_v A p hplace a
  have hsurj : ∀ z : ResidueField V.toSubring, ∃ (a b : A), b ∉ p ∧
      z = residue V.toSubring ⟨a, hAV a⟩ / residue V.toSubring ⟨b, hAV b⟩ :=
    fun z ↦ ofField_residue_surjective_v A p hplace z
  have hkV : ∀ c : k, algebraMap k F c ∈ V.toSubring := fun c ↦ by
    rw [show algebraMap k F c = algebraMap A F (algebraMap k A c) from
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k A F c)]
    exact hAV (algebraMap k A c)
  have hqV : ∀ a, Y a / Y j ∈ V.toSubring := fun a ↦ by
    simpa [s, div_eq_mul_inv] using hAV ⟨Y a * s, hnormA a⟩
  letI : Algebra k V.toSubring := ((algebraMap k F).codRestrict V.toSubring hkV).toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k V.toSubring F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hxV : x i ∈ V.toSubring := hAV xA
  have hxm : (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal V.toSubring := (hpV xA).2 hxp
  -- `V = A_{𝔭_D}` is a Noetherian valuation ring, and `V ≠ F` because `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`;
  -- by Definition 5.3(b) it is a discrete valuation ring.
  have hVdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing V.toSubring := by
    have hN : IsNoetherianRing (placeSubalgebra A p) :=
      IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing p.primeCompl (placeSubalgebra A p) inferInstance
    refine (definition_5_3.2.2.1 V).2 ⟨hN, fun htop => ?_⟩
    have hinvV : (x i)⁻¹ ∈ V.toSubring := by
      change (x i)⁻¹ ∈ V
      rw [htop]
      exact ValuationSubring.mem_top _
    rw [(definition_5_3.2.1 V).2] at hxm
    apply hxm
    refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (⟨(x i)⁻¹, hinvV⟩ : V.toSubring) ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [hy0]
  have hqA : ∀ a, Y a / Y j ∈ A := fun a ↦ by simpa [s, div_eq_mul_inv] using hnormA a
  refine ⟨Lemma510Place.mk A p hplace hVdvr hqA hyA hxp ?_ ?_⟩
  · -- (b) `A/𝔭_D` is integral over the image of `C_0`, whose residues are `res q_i`.
    let c' : (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Unit) → F := fun a ↦
      match a with
      | Sum.inl b => Y b * s
      | Sum.inr _ => x i
    have hc'A : ∀ a, c' a ∈ A := fun a ↦ by
      cases a with
      | inl b => exact hnormA b
      | inr _ => exact hyA
    have hset : Set.range c' = Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i} := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
        cases a with
        | inl b => exact Or.inl ⟨b, rfl⟩
        | inr u => exact Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton _)
      · rintro (⟨b, rfl⟩ | hz)
        · exact ⟨Sum.inl b, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨Sum.inr (), (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz).symm⟩
    have hBig := Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorialVisibleFrameStage4.stage4_residueField_isAlgebraic_of_isIntegral
      A p V hAV hpV hsurj c' hc'A (fun a ↦ by
      rw [hset]
      exact haint a)
    have hyres : residue V.toSubring (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) = 0 :=
      (residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hxm
    have hEq : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun a ↦
          residue V.toSubring ⟨c' a, hAV ⟨c' a, hc'A a⟩⟩) =
        IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun a ↦
          residue V.toSubring ⟨Y a / Y j, hqV a⟩) := by
      have hcoord : ∀ b, (⟨c' (Sum.inl b), hAV ⟨c' (Sum.inl b), hc'A (Sum.inl b)⟩⟩ :
          V.toSubring) = ⟨Y b / Y j, hqV b⟩ := fun b ↦
        Subtype.ext (by simp [c', s, div_eq_mul_inv])
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
        rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
        cases a with
        | inl b =>
          dsimp only
          rw [hcoord b]
          exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
        | inr _ =>
          change residue V.toSubring (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ _
          rw [hyres]
          exact zero_mem _
      · apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
        rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
        dsimp only
        rw [← hcoord b]
        exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl b, rfl⟩
    rw [← hEq]
    convert hBig using 3
  · -- (c) `Ω_{A/K}` is finite and localizes to `Ω_{V/K}` (Hartshorne, Prop. II.8.2A).
    exact stage7_kaehler_finite_ofField A p hkV

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_10_a_n.doc:
**Lemma 5.10(a), `R ⊄ V`.**  For any valuation ring `V` of `F` with
`x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`: `x̄_1 ∈ R^×` since `1 = ḡ x̄_1` with `ḡ ∈ R`, while `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`, so
`R ⊄ V`.  The paper derives `1 = ḡ x̄_1` from `Y ∩ H = ∅` by the
Nullstellensatz.

  (hxV : x i ∈ V.toSubring) (hxm : ⟨x i, hxV⟩ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V.toSubring)

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_10_a_n.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.10(a), `R ⊄ V`.**  For any valuation ring `V` of `F` with
`x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`: `x̄_1 ∈ R^×` since `1 = ḡ x̄_1` with `ḡ ∈ R`, while `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`, so
`R ⊄ V`.  The paper derives `1 = ḡ x̄_1` from `Y ∩ H = ∅` by the
Nullstellensatz. -/
theorem lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le {k F : Type*} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (V : ValuationSubring F) (hxV : x i ∈ V.toSubring)
    (hxm : (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal V.toSubring)
    (hunit : ∃ g ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x), x i * g = 1) :
    ¬ (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x)).toSubring ≤ V.toSubring := by
  obtain ⟨g, hgR, hxg⟩ := hunit
  have hy0 : x i ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hxg
  have hinvR : (x i)⁻¹ ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x) := by
    rw [← eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hxg]
    exact hgR
  intro hRV
  rw [mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hxm
  apply hxm
  refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (⟨(x i)⁻¹, hRV hinvR⟩ : V.toSubring) ?_
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [hy0]

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_11.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_11.{u} {k κ : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Field κ]
  [Algebra k κ] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (r : Fin (m + 1) → κ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
  (hr1 : r ⟨0, hm⟩.succ = 0) (hrj : r j = 1)
  (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range r))) κ) :
  ∃ d' rows,
    Function.Injective rows ∧
      (∀ (l : Fin d'), rows l ≠ 0 ∧ rows l ≠ ⟨0, hm⟩.succ ∧ rows l ≠ j) ∧
        (LinearIndependent κ fun l => (KaehlerDifferential.D k κ) (r (rows l))) ∧
          Submodule.span κ (Set.range fun l => (KaehlerDifferential.D k κ) (r (rows l))) = ⊤ ∧
            d' = Module.finrank κ Ω[κ⁄k]
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_11.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.11.** -/
theorem lemma_5_11
    {k κ : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (r : Fin (m + 1) → κ) (j : Fin (m + 1))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (hr1 : r (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0) (hrj : r j = 1)
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range r) : IntermediateField k κ) κ) :
    ∃ (d' : ℕ) (rows : Fin d' → Fin (m + 1)),
      Function.Injective rows ∧
      (∀ l, rows l ≠ 0 ∧ rows l ≠ Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩ ∧ rows l ≠ j) ∧
      LinearIndependent κ (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) ∧
      Submodule.span κ
          (Set.range fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) = ⊤ ∧
      d' = Module.finrank κ (Ω[κ⁄k]) := by
  classical
  let axis : Fin (m + 1) := Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩
  let good : Set (Fin (m + 1)) := {a | a ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ axis ∧ a ≠ j}
  let S : Set κ := r '' good
  -- The excluded residues are `0` and `1`, so `L` is generated by `S`.
  have hL : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range r) = IntermediateField.adjoin k S := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
      rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
      by_cases ha : a ∈ good
      · exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k S ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      · simp only [good, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_and_or, not_not] at ha
        rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · rw [hr0]; exact zero_mem _
        · rw [hr1]; exact zero_mem _
        · rw [hrj]; exact one_mem _
    · apply IntermediateField.adjoin.mono
      rintro _ ⟨a, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  -- `L` is generated by the finite set `S`, which therefore contains a transcendence
  -- basis `B` of `L/K` (Definition 5.1, closing sentence; Lang, Thm. VIII.1.1).
  let SL : Set (IntermediateField.adjoin k S) := Subtype.val ⁻¹' S
  have hSL : IntermediateField.adjoin k SL = ⊤ := by
    apply IntermediateField.lift_injective (IntermediateField.adjoin k S)
    rw [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin, IntermediateField.lift_top]
    congr 1
    change Subtype.val '' (Subtype.val ⁻¹' S) = S
    ext z
    refine ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ => hwz ▸ hw, fun hz => ?_⟩
    exact ⟨⟨z, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k S hz⟩, hz, rfl⟩
  have hSLfin : SL.Finite :=
    ((Set.toFinite good).image r).preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  obtain ⟨BL, hBLS, hBL⟩ := (definition_5_1_closing (K := k)
    (L := IntermediateField.adjoin k S)).2 SL hSLfin hSL
  -- `κ/L` is algebraic (Lemma 5.10(b)), so `B` is a transcendence basis of `κ/K`.
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin k S) κ := hL ▸ halg
  let t : Set κ := Set.range (algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k S) κ ∘ ((↑) : BL → _))
  have ht : IsTranscendenceBasis k ((↑) : t → κ) := hBL.algebraMap_comp.to_subtype_range
  have htS : t ⊆ S := by
    rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hBLS b.2
  have htfin : t.Finite := (Set.toFinite good |>.image r).subset htS
  let : Fintype t := htfin.fintype
  -- Matsumura, Thm. 26.5: the transcendence basis is a differential basis.
  have hrank : Module.finrank κ (Ω[κ⁄k]) = Fintype.card t :=
    Stafford38.Geometry.kaehlerFinrankOfTranscendenceBasis k κ t (↑) ht
  have hspanT : Submodule.span κ
      (Set.range fun x : t ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (x : κ)) = ⊤ :=
    Stafford38.Geometry.KaehlerDVRVisibility.kaehler_span_of_isAlgebraic_adjoin
      (fun x : t ↦ (x : κ)) (by simpa using (definition_5_1_g_h ht).1)
  -- Index the basis elements by residues `q_i(0)` with `i ∉ {0, 1, j}`.
  have hpre : ∀ x : t, ∃ a ∈ good, r a = x := fun x ↦ htS x.2
  choose idx hidx hridx using hpre
  let e := Fintype.equivFin t
  let rows : Fin (Fintype.card t) → Fin (m + 1) := fun l ↦ idx (e.symm l)
  have hrows : ∀ l, r (rows l) = (e.symm l : κ) := fun l ↦ hridx _
  have hfam : (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) =
      (fun x : t ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (x : κ)) ∘ e.symm := by
    funext l
    simp [hrows]
  have hspan : Submodule.span κ
      (Set.range fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hfam, Set.range_comp, e.symm.surjective.range_eq, Set.image_univ, hspanT]
  have hli : LinearIndependent κ (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) :=
    linearIndependent_of_top_le_span_of_card_eq_finrank hspan.ge
      (by rw [Fintype.card_fin, hrank])
  refine ⟨Fintype.card t, rows, ?_, fun l ↦ hidx _, hli, hspan, hrank.symm⟩
  intro l l' h
  apply e.symm.injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← hrows, ← hrows, h]

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_12_a_b.doc:
**Lemma 5.12(a), `dim_F Ω_{F/K} ≤ d' + 1`.**  For a discrete valuation ring
`V ⊇ K` with fraction field `F`, residue field `κ` and `Ω_{V/K}` finitely
generated: the second fundamental exact sequence for `V → κ` gives
`dim_κ (κ ⊗_V Ω_{V/K}) ≤ d' + 1`, Nakayama's lemma gives that many generators
of `Ω_{V/K}`, and `F ⊗_V Ω_{V/K} = Ω_{F/K}` bounds `dim_F Ω_{F/K}`.

/-- **Lemma 5.12(a), cone part.** `dim 𝒞 = dim Θ_y + 1`. -/
theorem lemma_5_12_a_cone (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (hq0 : q 0 ≠ 0)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) :
    Module.finrank L (tangentCone q I) = Module.finrank L (tangentSpaceAt q I) + 1 := by
  classical
  let f : tangentCone q I →ₗ[L] tangentSpaceAt q I :=
    (rho q).restrict (p := tangentCone q I) (q := tangentSpaceAt q I) (fun v hv ↦ hv)
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := rho_surjective q hq0 w
    exact ⟨⟨v, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  have hq : q ∈ tangentCone q I := by
    change rho q q ∈ tangentSpaceAt q I
    have : rho q q = 0 := by
      rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, ker_rho q hq0]
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self q
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _
  have hker : Module.finrank L (LinearMap.ker f) = 1 := by
    have hq' : (⟨q, hq⟩ : tangentCone q I) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      exact hq0 (congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) 0)
    rw [finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' (⟨⟨q, hq⟩, ?_⟩ : LinearMap.ker f) ?_]
    · rintro ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hvk⟩
      have hv0 : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (rho q) := by
        rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hvk)
      rw [ker_rho q hq0, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hv0
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hv0
      exact ⟨c, rfl⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change rho q q = 0
      rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, ker_rho q hq0]
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self q
    · intro h
      exact hq' (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hf, finrank_top, hker] at this
  omega

/-- **Lemma 5.12(b).** If the equations vanish at `y`, then `δq ∈ 𝒞` for every
`K`-derivation `δ` of `L`, and `q ∈ 𝒞`. -/
theorem lemma_5_12_b (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (hq0 : q 0 ≠ 0)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))
    (hbase : ∀ f ∈ I,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k L) (dehomogenizedPoint q) f = 0) :
    (∀ δ : Derivation k L L, (fun a ↦ δ (q a)) ∈ tangentCone q I) ∧
      q ∈ tangentCone q I := by
  constructor
  · intro δ
    -- `δ(f(y)) = df_y · δy`, so `δy ∈ Θ_y`.
    have htan := Stafford38.Geometry.PowerSeriesArcTangency.derivationVector_mem_zariskiTangentSpace_of_eval₂_eq_zero
      δ I (dehomogenizedPoint q) hbase
    -- Quotient rule: `ρ(δq) = δy`.
    have hquot : rho q (fun a ↦ δ (q a)) = fun i ↦ δ (dehomogenizedPoint q i) := by
      funext i
      rw [rho_apply, dehomogenizedPoint, Derivation.leibniz_div]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    change rho q (fun a ↦ δ (q a)) ∈ tangentSpaceAt q I
    rw [hquot]
    exact htan
  · change rho q q ∈ tangentSpaceAt q I
    have : rho q q = 0 := by
      rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, ker_rho q hq0]
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self q
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _

**Lemma 5.13.** A row vector annihilating `𝒞` has its affine part
`(ℓ_1, …, ℓ_n)` in `span {df_y : f ∈ 𝔭}`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_13.{u, v} {k : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field k] [Field L]
  [Algebra k L] {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (hq0 : q 0 ≠ 0) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))
  (ell : Fin (n + 1) → L) (hell : ∀ v ∈ tangentCone q I, ∑ a, ell a * v a = 0) :
  (Geometry.AffineConormalSpan.coordinateCovector fun i => ell i.succ) ∈

      (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k L)) I)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_13.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.13.** A row vector annihilating `𝒞` has its affine part
`(ℓ_1, …, ℓ_n)` in `span {df_y : f ∈ 𝔭}`. -/
theorem lemma_5_13 (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) (hq0 : q 0 ≠ 0)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (ell : Fin (n + 1) → L)
    (hell : ∀ v ∈ tangentCone q I, ∑ a, ell a * v a = 0) :
    coordinateCovector (fun i : Fin n ↦ ell i.succ) ∈
      equationCovectorSpan (dehomogenizedPoint q)
        (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k L))) := by
  rw [← affineConormalSpace_eq_equationCovectorSpan, affineConormalSpace,
    Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
  intro w hw
  -- `ρ(𝒞) = Θ_y`.
  have hw' : w ∈ (tangentCone q I).map (rho q) := by
    rw [rho_map_tangentCone q hq0]
    exact hw
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hw'
  have hq : q ∈ tangentCone q I := by
    change rho q q ∈ tangentSpaceAt q I
    have : rho q q = 0 := by
      rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, ker_rho q hq0]
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self q
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _
  -- `ℓ(q) = 0` and `ℓ(v) = 0` give `Σ ℓ_i ρ(v)_i = 0`.
  have hellq := hell q hq
  have hellv := hell v hv
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hellq hellv
  rw [coordinateCovector_apply]
  simp only [rho_apply]
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin n, ell i.succ * ((v i.succ * q 0 - q i.succ * v 0) / q 0 ^ 2) =
      (q 0 * ∑ i : Fin n, ell i.succ * v i.succ -
        v 0 * ∑ i : Fin n, ell i.succ * q i.succ) / q 0 ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    ring
  rw [hsum]
  have h1 : ∑ i : Fin n, ell i.succ * v i.succ = -(ell 0 * v 0) := by linear_combination hellv
  have h2 : ∑ i : Fin n, ell i.succ * q i.succ = -(ell 0 * q 0) := by linear_combination hellq
  rw [h1, h2]
  ring_nf

**Lemma 5.9.** If `x̄_1` is transcendental over `K`, there are a valuation
ring `K ⊆ W ⊊ F` with `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_W` and an index `j` with `x̄_i / x̄_j ∈ W` for
all `0 ≤ i ≤ n`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_9.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_9.{u_1, u_2} {k : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [Field k] [Field F]
  [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (htrans : Transcendental k (x i)) :
  ∃ W j,
    (∀ (c : k), (algebraMap k F) c ∈ W) ∧
      W ≠ ⊤ ∧
        (∃ (hx : x i ∈ W), ⟨x i, hx⟩ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥W.toSubring) ∧
          homogeneousCoordinates x j ≠ 0 ∧
            ∀ (a : Fin (n + 1)), homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j ∈ W
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.lemma_5_9.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.9.** If `x̄_1` is transcendental over `K`, there are a valuation
ring `K ⊆ W ⊊ F` with `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_W` and an index `j` with `x̄_i / x̄_j ∈ W` for
all `0 ≤ i ≤ n`. -/
theorem lemma_5_9 {k F : Type*} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] {n : ℕ}
    (x : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (htrans : Transcendental k (x i)) :
    ∃ (W : ValuationSubring F) (j : Fin (n + 1)),
      (∀ c : k, algebraMap k F c ∈ W) ∧ W ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (∃ hx : x i ∈ W, (⟨x i, hx⟩ : W.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal W.toSubring) ∧
      homogeneousCoordinates x j ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ a, homogeneousCoordinates x a / homogeneousCoordinates x j ∈ W := by
  classical
  -- `W` dominates `K[x̄_1]` localized at `x̄_1` (Stacks, Tag 00IA).
  obtain ⟨W, hkW, hxW, hxinvW⟩ := stage1_exists_valuationSubring_of_transcendental (x i) htrans
  have hx0 : x i ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htrans (h ▸ isAlgebraic_zero)
  -- Definition 5.3(a): `𝔪_W = W ∖ W^×`
  have hxmax : (⟨x i, hxW⟩ : W.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal W.toSubring := by
    rw [(definition_5_3.2.1 W).2]
    rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    apply hxinvW
    have hmul : x i * ((u⁻¹ : W.toSubringˣ) : W.toSubring) = 1 := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val (Units.mul_inv u)
      simpa [hu] using this
    have : (x i)⁻¹ = ((u⁻¹ : W.toSubringˣ) : W.toSubring) :=
      (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul).symm
    rw [this]
    exact ((u⁻¹ : W.toSubringˣ) : W.toSubring).2
  have hWtop : W ≠ ⊤ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hxinvW (ValuationSubring.mem_top _)
  -- Among the nonzero `x̄_i` choose one that is maximal for `a ≼ b ↔ x̄_a / x̄_b ∈ W`.
  let Y := homogeneousCoordinates x
  let S : Set (Fin (n + 1)) := {a | Y a ≠ 0}
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [S, Y]⟩
  letI : LE (Fin (n + 1)) := ⟨fun a b ↦ Y b ≠ 0 ∧ Y a / Y b ∈ W⟩
  have htr : IsTrans (Fin (n + 1)) LE.le := by
    constructor
    intro a b c hab hbc
    rcases hab with ⟨hb, hab⟩
    rcases hbc with ⟨hc, hbc⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    have := W.toSubring.mul_mem hab hbc
    rwa [div_mul_div_cancel₀ hb] at this
  letI : IsTrans (Fin (n + 1)) LE.le := htr
  obtain ⟨j, hjS, hjmax⟩ := S.toFinite.exists_maximalFor id S hS
  refine ⟨W, j, hkW, hWtop, ⟨hxW, hxmax⟩, hjS, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases ha : Y a = 0
  · change Y a / Y j ∈ W
    rw [ha, zero_div]
    exact W.zero_mem
  -- Definition 5.3(a): `a/b ∈ W` or `b/a ∈ W` for nonzero `a, b`
  rcases (definition_5_3.1 W.toSubring).2 ⟨W, rfl⟩ (Y a / Y j) (div_ne_zero ha hjS) with h | h
  · exact h
  · rw [inv_div] at h
    exact (hjmax (show a ∈ S from ha) ⟨ha, h⟩).2

/-- The paper's `ρ : L^{n+1} → L^n`, `ρ(v)_i = (v_i q_0 - q_i v_0) / q_0²`. -/
def rho (q : Fin (n + 1) → L) : (Fin (n + 1) → L) →ₗ[L] (Fin n → L) where
  toFun v i := (v i.succ * q 0 - q i.succ * v 0) / q 0 ^ 2
  map_add' v w := by
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  map_smul' c v := by
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

/-- **Paragraph "`M(0)` has full column rank".**  For
`M = (q, Z_{•1}, …, Z_{•d'}, τ)`: `M(0)` has full column rank (row `j`, the
identity block on the rows `i_l`, and `τ(0) ≠ 0`); so some
`(d'+2) × (d'+2)` minor `M_ι(0)` is nonzero, the corresponding minor of `M(t)`
is a unit of `κ[[t]]`, and the columns of `M(t)` are linearly independent over
`κ((t))`.  Every column of `M(0)` has vanishing `1`-coordinate. -/
theorem step_M_minor {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (Z : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin d) (PowerSeries κ))
    (tau : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (rows : Fin d ↪ Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 1))
    (b : ℕ) (u₁ : PowerSeries κ)
    (hqj : q j = 1) (hZj : ∀ k', Z j k' = 0) (htauj : tau j = 0)
    (htaurows : ∀ l, tau (rows l) = 0)
    (hminor : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (selectedMinor Z rows).det = 1)
    (hprim : ∃ i, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tau i) ≠ 0) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hq1 : q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ b * u₁)
    (hZ1 : ∀ k', ∃ w : PowerSeries κ,
      Z (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) k' = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ b * w)
    (htau1 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tau (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)) = 0) :
    Function.Injective (residueMatrix (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau)).mulVec ∧
      (∃ rowsι : FormalTangentColumn (Fin d) ↪ Fin (m + 1),
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff (selectedMinor (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau) rowsι).det ≠ 0 ∧
        IsUnit (selectedMinor (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau) rowsι).det) ∧
      LinearIndependent (LaurentSeries κ)
        (fun col i ↦ algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)
          (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)) ∧
      ∀ col, PowerSeries.constantCoeff
        (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) col) = 0 := by
  classical
  have hinj := residue_formalTangentMatrix_mulVec_injective q Z tau rows j hqj hZj htauj
    htaurows (by rw [hminor]; exact one_ne_zero) hprim
  obtain ⟨rowsι, hρ⟩ :=
    powerSeries_exists_selectedMinor_constantCoeff_ne_zero_of_residue_mulVec_injective _ hinj
  obtain ⟨hunit, hli⟩ := linearIndependent_laurent_of_selectedMinor _ rowsι hρ
  exact ⟨hinj, ⟨rowsι, hρ, hunit⟩, hli,
    constantCoeff_formalTangentMatrix_axis_eq_zero q Z tau _ b u₁ hb hq1 hZ1 htau1⟩

∀ {κ : Type u} [inst : Field κ] [CharZero κ] {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (Z : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin d) (PowerSeries κ))
  (tau : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (rows : Fin d ↪ Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (b : ℕ)
  (u₁ : PowerSeries κ),
  q j = 1 →
    (∀ (k' : Fin d), Z j k' = 0) →
      tau j = 0 →
        (∀ (l : Fin d), tau (rows l) = 0) →
          PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Matrix.det fun a b => Z (rows a) b) = 1 →
            (∃ i, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tau i) ≠ 0) →
              0 < b →
                q ⟨0, hm⟩.succ = PowerSeries.X ^ b * u₁ →
                  (∀ (k' : Fin d), ∃ w, Z ⟨0, hm⟩.succ k' = PowerSeries.X ^ b * w) →
                    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tau ⟨0, hm⟩.succ) = 0 →
                      Function.Injective
                          (Matrix.mulVec fun i j =>
                            PowerSeries.constantCoeff
                              (Sum.casesOn j (fun val => q i) fun val =>
                                Sum.casesOn val (fun val => Z i val) fun val => tau i)) ∧
                        (∃ rowsι,
                            PowerSeries.constantCoeff
                                  (Matrix.det fun a b =>
                                    Sum.casesOn b (fun val => q (rowsι a)) fun val =>
                                      Sum.casesOn val (fun val => Z (rowsι a) val) fun val =>
                                        tau (rowsι a)) ≠
                                0 ∧
                              IsUnit
                                (Matrix.det fun a b =>
                                  Sum.casesOn b (fun val => q (rowsι a)) fun val =>
                                    Sum.casesOn val (fun val => Z (rowsι a) val) fun val =>
                                      tau (rowsι a))) ∧
                          (LinearIndependent (LaurentSeries κ) fun col i =>
                              (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ))
                                (Sum.casesOn col (fun val => q i) fun val =>
                                  Sum.casesOn val (fun val => Z i val) fun val => tau i)) ∧
                            ∀ (col : Unit ⊕ Fin d ⊕ Unit),
                              PowerSeries.constantCoeff
                                  (Sum.casesOn col (fun val => q ⟨0, hm⟩.succ) fun val =>
                                    Sum.casesOn val (fun val => Z ⟨0, hm⟩.succ val) fun val =>
                                      tau ⟨0, hm⟩.succ) =
                                0

and `q'` have the form `δq` for `K`-derivations `δ` of `κ((t))` (the `D_k`
extended coefficientwise, and `d/dt`), so they lie in `𝒞` by Lemma 5.12(b);

`dim 𝒞 = dim Θ_y + 1` (Lemma 5.12(a)) and `dim Θ_y ≤ d' + 1`, the `d' + 2`
independent columns of `M` span `𝒞`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_M_spans_c.source:
/-- **Paragraph "the columns of `M` span `𝒞`".**  The columns `q`, `Z_{•k}`
and `q'` have the form `δq` for `K`-derivations `δ` of `κ((t))` (the `D_k`
extended coefficientwise, and `d/dt`), so they lie in `𝒞` by Lemma 5.12(b);
`τ = t^{-c}(q' − Zλ)` is a `κ((t))`-combination of them.  With
`dim 𝒞 = dim Θ_y + 1` (Lemma 5.12(a)) and `dim Θ_y ≤ d' + 1`, the `d' + 2`
independent columns of `M` span `𝒞`. -/
theorem step_M_spans_cone {m d : ℕ}
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (hq0 : q 0 ≠ 0)
    (hbase : ∀ f ∈ I, MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ))
      (dehomogenizedPoint (laurentColumn q)) f = 0)
    (D : Fin d → Derivation k κ κ) (Z : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin d) (PowerSeries κ))
    (hZ : Z = coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D)
    (lambda : Fin d → PowerSeries κ) (c : ℕ) (tau : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ)
    (hfactor : ∀ i, PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q i) - Z.mulVec lambda i =
      (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ c * tau i)
    (hli : LinearIndependent (LaurentSeries κ)
      (fun col i ↦ algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)
        (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)))
    (hbound : Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ) (tangentSpaceAt (laurentColumn q) I) ≤ d + 1) :
    (∀ col, (fun i ↦ algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)
        (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)) ∈ tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I) ∧
      Submodule.span (LaurentSeries κ) (Set.range fun col i ↦
        algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ) (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)) =
        tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I := by
  classical
  let L := LaurentSeries κ
  let f := algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) L
  let qL := laurentColumn q
  let 𝒞 := tangentCone qL I
  have hq0L : qL 0 ≠ 0 := laurentColumn_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q hq0
  -- Lemma 5.12(b) at `y = q/q₀`.
  obtain ⟨hδ, hq⟩ := lemma_5_12_b qL hq0L I hbase
  have hder : ∀ δ : Derivation k (PowerSeries κ) (PowerSeries κ),
      laurentColumn (fun i ↦ δ (q i)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    intro δ
    have h := hδ (extendPowerSeriesDerivation δ)
    have hcol : (fun a ↦ extendPowerSeriesDerivation δ (qL a)) =
        laurentColumn (fun i ↦ δ (q i)) := by
      funext a
      exact extendPowerSeriesDerivation_on_powerSeries δ (q a)
    rw [hcol] at h
    exact h
  have hZcol : ∀ l, (fun i ↦ f (Z i l)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    intro l
    have h := hder (coefficientwiseDerivation (D l))
    rw [hZ]
    exact h
  have hq' : (fun i ↦ f (PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q i))) ∈ 𝒞 :=
    hder (uniformizerDerivation (k := k) (K := κ))
  -- `τ = t^{-c} (q' − Σ λ_l Z_{•l})`.
  let Xc : L := f ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ c)
  have hXc : Xc ≠ 0 := by
    simp [Xc, f]
  have htau : (fun i ↦ f (tau i)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    have hcomb := 𝒞.smul_mem Xc⁻¹ (𝒞.sub_mem hq'
      (𝒞.sum_mem fun l (_ : l ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ 𝒞.smul_mem (f (lambda l)) (hZcol l)))
    convert hcomb using 1
    funext i
    have hi := congrArg f (hfactor i)
    simp only [map_sub, map_mul, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, map_sum] at hi
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hXc]
    rw [← hi]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
    ring
  have hcols : ∀ col, (fun i ↦ f (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    intro col
    rcases col with _ | (l | _)
    · exact hq
    · exact hZcol l
    · exact htau
  refine ⟨hcols, ?_⟩
  have hle : Submodule.span L (Set.range fun col i ↦ f (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)) ≤ 𝒞 :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨col, rfl⟩; exact hcols col)
  apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle
  rw [finrank_span_eq_card hli]
  -- Lemma 5.12(a): `dim 𝒞 = dim Θ_y + 1 ≤ d' + 2`.
  have hcone : Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ) (tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I) =
      Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ) (tangentSpaceAt (laurentColumn q) I) + 1 :=
    lemma_5_12_a_cone (laurentColumn q) hq0L I
  change Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ) (tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I) ≤ _
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_unit, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ),
  q 0 ≠ 0 →

                                {
                                  toFun := fun v =>
                                    ∑ i,
                                      (MvPolynomial.eval fun i =>
                                            (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ))

                                              (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)) (q 0))

                                        v i,

                    Submodule.span (LaurentSeries κ)

                          (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ))

/-- Same paragraph: `P`, which depends on `ξ` only, vanishes on `N(Y_0)`
(Definition 5.4(d)). -/
theorem step_P_vanishes_on_conormal_cone
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (h𝔮 : 𝔮 ∈ (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes)
    (s : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (hs𝔮 : s ∉ 𝔮)
    (hs : ∀ h ∈ 𝔮, s * h ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (hPW : ∀ q ∈ W, MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => q (.inr i)) P = 0) :
    P ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (smoothConormalFibreProjection 𝔮) := by
  intro ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hspan⟩ := (definition_5_4_d 𝔮 ξ).1 hξ
  have hyξ := step_conormal_subset W hclosed hcone hinv 𝔮 h𝔮 s hs𝔮 hs y hy ξ
    ((definition_5_4_c 𝔮 y ξ).2 hspan)
  simpa using hPW _ hyξ

                                have hprime := ⋯;
                                { asIdeal := RingHom.ker e.toRingHom, isPrime := hprime } ∈

/-- Paragraph "Lastly": `W ∩ π⁻¹(H) = ∅` gives `Y ∩ H = ∅`. -/
theorem step_Y_avoids_H
    (hm : 0 < m) (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hH : W ∩ {q | q (.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅) :
    ∀ y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W), y ⟨0, hm⟩ ≠ 0 := by
  intro y hy hy0
  have hmem : Sum.elim y (0 : Fin m → k) ∈ W ∩ {q | q (.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} :=
    ⟨step_zero_section W hclosed hcone y hy, hy0⟩
  rw [hH] at hmem
  exact hmem
