Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_a_pos.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (w : Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P)
  (hunit : ∃ g, MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) : ¬IsUnit (w.column.q 0)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_a_pos.source:
/-- **Paragraph "`a = ord q_0`", `a > 0`.**  If `a = 0`, then `q_0` is a unit of
`V`, hence all `x̄_i = q_i/q_0` lie in `V`, so `R ⊆ V` since also `K ⊆ V`,
contradicting Lemma 5.10(a) (`lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le`).  So `q_0 ∉ V^×`. -/
theorem step_a_pos {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (w : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P)
    (hunit : ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k,
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing w.column.W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := w.column.W.ambientAlgebra
    ¬ IsUnit (w.column.q 0) := by
  let C := w.column
  let W := C.W
  let K := ComponentFractionField P
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField) K := W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := W.place.valuation
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V.toSubring := W.place.isDiscrete
  let x : Fin m → K := fun j ↦ componentCoordinate P j
  -- `1 = ḡ x̄_1` with `ḡ ∈ R = K[x̄_1, …, x̄_n]`.
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hunit
  let phi : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k →+* K :=
    (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) K).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal)
  have hphiC : phi.comp MvPolynomial.C = algebraMap k K := by
    ext c
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) K c
  have hpoly : phi g = MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k K) x g := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.map_mvPolynomial_eq_eval₂ phi g]
    change MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (phi.comp MvPolynomial.C) (fun j ↦ phi (MvPolynomial.X j)) g =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap k K) x g
    exact MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_congr hphiC rfl rfl
  have hinverse : x ⟨0, hm⟩ * MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k K) x g = 1 := by
    have hzero : phi (MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1) = 0 := by
      have hmk : Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1) = 0 :=
        Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hg
      simpa [phi] using congrArg (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ P.asIdeal) K) hmk
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, sub_eq_zero, hpoly] at hzero
    exact hzero
  have hgR : MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k K) x g ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x) := by
    rw [← MvPolynomial.aeval_def, Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]
    exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
  -- `x̄_1 = ϖ ∈ 𝔪_V`.
  have hxV : x ⟨0, hm⟩ ∈ V.toSubring := by
    change componentCoordinate P ⟨0, hm⟩ ∈ V.toSubring
    rw [← W.parameter_eq_coordinate]
    exact W.place.parameter.2
  have hxm : (⟨x ⟨0, hm⟩, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal V.toSubring := by
    have : (⟨x ⟨0, hm⟩, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) = W.place.parameter :=
      Subtype.ext W.parameter_eq_coordinate.symm
    rw [this, mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
    exact W.place.parameter_nonunit
  have hR := lemma_5_10_a_not_R_le x ⟨0, hm⟩ V hxV hxm ⟨_, hgR, hinverse⟩
  rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
  apply hR
  -- `q_0 ∈ V^×` puts every `x̄_i = q_i/q_0` in `V`.
  have hq0 : (C.q 0 : K) = C.scale := by
    simpa [componentProjectivePoint] using C.q_commonScale 0
  have hxjV : ∀ j, x j ∈ V.toSubring := by
    intro j
    have hqj : (C.q (Fin.succ j) : K) = C.scale * x j := by
      simpa [componentProjectivePoint] using C.q_commonScale (Fin.succ j)
    have hscale : ((u : V.toSubring) : K) = C.scale := by rw [hu]; exact hq0
    have hu1 : ((u : V.toSubring) : K) * ((↑(u⁻¹) : V.toSubring) : K) = 1 := by
      rw [← Subring.coe_mul, Units.mul_inv]
      rfl
    have : x j = (C.q (Fin.succ j) : K) * ((↑(u⁻¹) : V.toSubring) : K) := by
      rw [hqj, ← hscale, mul_comm ((u : V.toSubring) : K), mul_assoc, hu1, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact V.toSubring.mul_mem (C.q _).2 (↑(u⁻¹) : V.toSubring).2
  intro z hz
  induction hz using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact hxjV j
  | algebraMap c =>
      rw [← C.groundCoeff_commutes]
      exact (C.groundCoeff c).2
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => exact V.toSubring.add_mem ha hb
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb => exact V.toSubring.mul_mem ha hb

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_component.source:
/-- Same paragraph: for a minimal prime `𝔮` of `B`, `Y_0 = V_K(𝔮)` is
nonempty, closed and irreducible (`𝔮` prime), `𝔮 = I(Y_0)`, `Y_0 ⊆ Y` and
`Y_0 ∩ H = ∅`. -/
theorem step_component
    (hm : 0 < m) (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hH : W ∩ {q | q (.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅)
    (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (h𝔮 : 𝔮 ∈ (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes) :
    𝔮.IsPrime ∧ (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮).Nonempty ∧
      MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮) = 𝔮 ∧
      MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮 ⊆
        MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮, y ⟨0, hm⟩ ≠ 0 := by
  have hprime : 𝔮.IsPrime := h𝔮.1.1
  have hI : MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮) = 𝔮 :=
    MvPolynomial.IsPrime.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus 𝔮
  have hsub : MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮 ⊆
      MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W) :=
    MvPolynomial.zeroLocus_anti_mono h𝔮.1.2
  refine ⟨hprime, ?_, hI, hsub, fun y hy =>
    step_Y_avoids_H hm W hclosed hcone hH y (hsub hy)⟩
  rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  intro hempty
  rw [hempty, MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal_empty] at hI
  exact hprime.ne_top hI.symm

/-- Same paragraph: `(y, dh_y) ∈ W` for all `y ∈ Y_0`.  For `g ∈ J`,
`G(x) = g(x, dh_x)` vanishes on `Y_0 ∩ {s ≠ 0}`, so `sG ∈ I(Y_0) = 𝔮`, and
`G ∈ 𝔮` as `s ∉ 𝔮`. -/
theorem step_dh_on_component
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (h𝔮 : 𝔮 ∈ (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes)
    (s : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (hs𝔮 : s ∉ 𝔮)
    (hs : ∀ h ∈ 𝔮, s * h ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W)
    (h : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (hh : h ∈ 𝔮)
    (y : Fin m → k) (hy : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮) :
    Sum.elim y (differentialAt y h) ∈ W := by
  rw [← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_of_algebraic_closed W hclosed]
  intro g hg
  have hG : gradientGraphSubstitution h g ∈ 𝔮 := by
    apply mem_of_vanishes_on_principal_open 𝔮 h𝔮.1.1 hs𝔮
    intro z hz hsz
    rw [eval_gradientGraphSubstitution]
    exact hg _ (step_dh_on_open W hclosed hcone hinv 𝔮 h𝔮 s hs h hh z hz hsz)
  have h0 : MvPolynomial.eval y (gradientGraphSubstitution h g) = 0 := hy _ hG
  rw [eval_gradientGraphSubstitution] at h0
  exact h0

theorem step_dh_on_open
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (h𝔮 : 𝔮 ∈ (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes)
    (s : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (hs : ∀ h ∈ 𝔮, s * h ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W)
    (h : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (hh : h ∈ 𝔮)
    (y : Fin m → k) (hy : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮)
    (hsy : MvPolynomial.eval y s ≠ 0) :
    Sum.elim y (differentialAt y h) ∈ W := by
  have hyY : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W) :=
    MvPolynomial.zeroLocus_anti_mono h𝔮.1.2 hy
  have hhy : MvPolynomial.eval y h = 0 := hy h hh
  have hd : differentialAt y (s * h) = MvPolynomial.eval y s • differentialAt y h := by
    funext i
    simp [differentialAt, hhy]
  have hsh : Sum.elim y (differentialAt y (s * h)) ∈ W :=
    step_span_mem W hclosed hcone hinv y hyY _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨s * h, hs h hh⟩, rfl⟩)
  rw [hd] at hsh
  have := ((definition_5_6 W).1 hcone y _ ⟨hsh, rfl⟩ (MvPolynomial.eval y s)⁻¹
    (inv_ne_zero hsy)).1
  rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hsy, one_smul] at this

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_dir_of_fi.doc:
**Proof of Theorem 5.7(ii) from (i).**  Let every polynomial vanishing on
`N(Y)` vanish at `ξ ≠ 0`, and let `G` be homogeneous of degree `d` and vanish on
all classes `[ξ']` with `0 ≠ ξ' ∈ N(Y)`.  By homogeneity `G` vanishes on every
nonzero `ξ' ∈ N(Y)`, and at `0` if `d > 0`, hence on `N(Y)`; so `G(ξ) = 0`, and
`G` vanishes at every representative `a ξ` of `[ξ]`.  If `d = 0`, `G` is a
constant vanishing at a class of `N(Y)`, so `G = 0`; that such a class exists
follows from the hypothesis itself, applied to a coordinate `ξ_i ≠ 0`.

          (Geometry.ProjectiveConormalDirections.smoothConormalFibreProjection I))) :

    Geometry.ProjectiveConormalDirections.projectiveHomogeneousClosure
      (Geometry.ProjectiveConormalDirections.projectivizedDirectionSet

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_dir_of_fi.source:
/-- **Proof of Theorem 5.7(ii) from (i).**  Let every polynomial vanishing on
`N(Y)` vanish at `ξ ≠ 0`, and let `G` be homogeneous of degree `d` and vanish on
all classes `[ξ']` with `0 ≠ ξ' ∈ N(Y)`.  By homogeneity `G` vanishes on every
nonzero `ξ' ∈ N(Y)`, and at `0` if `d > 0`, hence on `N(Y)`; so `G(ξ) = 0`, and
`G` vanishes at every representative `a ξ` of `[ξ]`.  If `d = 0`, `G` is a
constant vanishing at a class of `N(Y)`, so `G = 0`; that such a class exists
follows from the hypothesis itself, applied to a coordinate `ξ_i ≠ 0`. -/
theorem step_dir_of_fibre {k : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {n : ℕ}
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (ξ : Fin n → k) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0)
    (hvan : ξ ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k
      (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (smoothConormalFibreProjection I))) :
    Projectivization.mk k ξ hξ ∈
      projectiveHomogeneousClosure
        (projectivizedDirectionSet (smoothConormalDirectionSet I)) := by
  intro G d hG hT
  -- `G` vanishes on every nonzero `ξ' ∈ N(Y)`.
  have hnonzero : ∀ v ∈ smoothConormalFibreProjection I, v ≠ 0 →
      MvPolynomial.eval v G = 0 := by
    intro v hv hv0
    rcases hv with ⟨y, hy, hc⟩
    exact hT ⟨v, ⟨y, hy, hv0, hc⟩, hv0, rfl⟩ v hv0 rfl
  have hξG : MvPolynomial.eval ξ G = 0 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with hd | hd
    · -- `d = 0`: `G` is constant, and some nonzero `ξ' ∈ N(Y)` exists.
      subst hd
      have hconst : ∀ x : Fin n → k, MvPolynomial.eval x G = MvPolynomial.eval 0 G := by
        intro x
        have h := eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous G 0 hG 0 x
        rw [zero_smul, pow_zero, one_mul] at h
        exact h.symm
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, ξ i ≠ 0 := by simpa [funext_iff] using hξ
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ : ∃ v ∈ smoothConormalFibreProjection I, v ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hnone
        push Not at hnone
        apply hi
        have hXi : MvPolynomial.X i ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k
            (smoothConormalFibreProjection I) := by
          rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
          intro v hv
          rw [hnone v hv]
          simp
        simpa using (MvPolynomial.mem_zeroLocus_iff.mp hvan) _ hXi
      rw [hconst, ← hconst v]
      exact hnonzero v hv hv0
    · -- `d > 0`: `G(0) = 0` too, so `G` vanishes on `N(Y)`.
      have hGvan : G ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (smoothConormalFibreProjection I) := by
        rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
        intro v hv
        by_cases hv0 : v = 0
        · subst hv0
          have h := eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous G d hG 0 0
          rw [smul_zero, zero_pow hd.ne', zero_mul] at h
          exact h
        · exact hnonzero v hv hv0
      exact (MvPolynomial.mem_zeroLocus_iff.mp hvan) _ hGvan
  -- Every representative `a ξ` of `[ξ]`.
  intro v hv hz
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (Projectivization.mk_eq_mk_iff k ξ v hξ hv).mp hz
  have hscaled := eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous G d hG (a : k) v
  have ha' : (a : k) • v = ξ := by
    rw [← Units.smul_def]
    exact ha
  rw [ha', hξG] at hscaled
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hscaled.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero d (Units.ne_zero a))

differentials `d(q_{i_l}(0))` form a basis of `Ω_{κ/K}`, there are dual
`K`-derivations `D_k` with `D_k(q_{i_l}(0)) = δ_{kl}` (Definition 5.2(c)).  The
matrix `Z_{ik} = Σ_r D_k(c_{ir}) t^r` then has `Z(0)` equal to the identity on
the rows `i_l`, so its selected minor has constant coefficient `1`; `Z_j = 0`;
and rows `0` and `1` are divisible by `t^a` and `t^b`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_dual_deri.source:
/-- **Paragraph after Lemma 5.11 (dual derivations and `Z`).**  If the
differentials `d(q_{i_l}(0))` form a basis of `Ω_{κ/K}`, there are dual
`K`-derivations `D_k` with `D_k(q_{i_l}(0)) = δ_{kl}` (Definition 5.2(c)).  The
matrix `Z_{ik} = Σ_r D_k(c_{ir}) t^r` then has `Z(0)` equal to the identity on
the rows `i_l`, so its selected minor has constant coefficient `1`; `Z_j = 0`;
and rows `0` and `1` are divisible by `t^a` and `t^b`. -/
theorem step_dual_derivations {m d : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (rows : Fin d ↪ Fin (m + 1))
    (hli : LinearIndependent κ
      (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (rows l)))))
    (hspan : Submodule.span κ (Set.range fun l ↦
      KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (rows l)))) = ⊤)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) (hqj : q j = 1) (a b : ℕ) (u₀ u₁ : PowerSeries κ)
    (hq0 : q 0 = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ a * u₀)
    (hq1 : q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ b * u₁) :
    ∃ D : Fin d → Derivation k κ κ,
      (∀ k' l, D k' (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (rows l))) = if k' = l then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ l k', PowerSeries.constantCoeff (coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D (rows l) k') =
        if l = k' then 1 else 0) ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff
        (selectedMinor (coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D) rows).det = 1 ∧
      (∀ k', coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D j k' = 0) ∧
      (∀ k', ∃ w : PowerSeries κ,
        coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D 0 k' = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ a * w) ∧
      (∀ k', ∃ w : PowerSeries κ,
        coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) k' =
          (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ b * w) := by
  classical
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin d) κ (Ω[κ⁄k]) := Module.Basis.mk hli hspan.ge
  -- Definition 5.2(c): the dual derivations `D_k` of the basis `dβ_l`.
  obtain ⟨D, hdual⟩ := definition_5_2_c (K := k) (L := κ)
    (fun l ↦ PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (rows l))) B (fun l ↦ Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _)
  have hentry : ∀ l k', PowerSeries.constantCoeff (coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D (rows l) k') =
      if l = k' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro l k'
    rw [constantCoeff_coefficientwiseTangentMatrix, hdual]
    by_cases h : k' = l
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
  refine ⟨D, hdual, hentry, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [constantCoeff_selectedMinor_det]
    have hone : selectedMinor (residueMatrix (coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D)) rows = 1 := by
      ext l k'
      rw [Matrix.one_apply]
      exact hentry l k'
    rw [hone, Matrix.det_one]
  · intro k'
    rw [coefficientwiseTangentMatrix]
    simp only [hqj]
    exact (coefficientwiseDerivation (D k')).map_one_eq_zero
  · intro k'
    refine ⟨coefficientwiseDerivation (D k') u₀, ?_⟩
    rw [coefficientwiseTangentMatrix, hq0]
    exact coefficientwiseDerivation_X_pow_mul (D k') a u₀
  · intro k'
    refine ⟨coefficientwiseDerivation (D k') u₁, ?_⟩
    rw [coefficientwiseTangentMatrix, hq1]
    exact coefficientwiseDerivation_X_pow_mul (D k') b u₁

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_ell_conor.source:
/-- **Paragraph "`ℓ` annihilates `𝒞`".**  If the columns of `M` span `𝒞` and
`ℓ M = 0`, then `ℓ` annihilates `𝒞`, so by Lemma 5.13 its affine part
`ℓ̃ = (ℓ_1, …, ℓ_n)` lies in `span {df_y : f ∈ 𝔭}`; and `ℓ(0) = u` gives
`ℓ̃(0) = (1, 0, …, 0)`. -/
theorem step_ell_conormal {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (hq0 : q 0 ≠ 0)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) ι (PowerSeries κ))
    (hspan : Submodule.span (LaurentSeries κ) (Set.range fun col i ↦
      algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ) (M i col)) = tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I)
    (ell : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ) (hell : rowMul ell M = 0)
    (hres : residueColumn ell = axisRow (k := κ) (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)) :
    coordinateCovector (fun i : Fin m ↦ laurentColumn ell i.succ) ∈
        equationCovectorSpan (dehomogenizedPoint (laurentColumn q))
          (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ)))) ∧
      residueColumn (fun i : Fin m ↦ ell i.succ) =
        fun i ↦ if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  let L := LaurentSeries κ
  let f := algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) L
  let φ : (Fin (m + 1) → L) →ₗ[L] L :=
    { toFun := fun v ↦ ∑ a, laurentColumn ell a * v a
      map_add' := fun v w ↦ by simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun c v ↦ by
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ by ring }
  have hle : tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
    rw [← hspan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨col, rfl⟩
    have h := congrArg f (congrFun hell col)
    simp only [rowMul, map_sum, map_mul, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hann : ∀ v ∈ tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I, ∑ a, laurentColumn ell a * v a = 0 :=
    fun v hv ↦ hle hv
  refine ⟨lemma_5_13 (laurentColumn q) (laurentColumn_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q hq0) I
    (laurentColumn ell) hann, ?_⟩
  calc
    residueColumn (fun i : Fin m ↦ ell i.succ) =
        (fun i : Fin m ↦ residueColumn ell i.succ) := residueColumn_tail ell
    _ = (fun i : Fin m ↦ axisRow (k := κ) (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) i.succ) := by
      rw [hres]
    _ = (fun i : Fin m ↦ if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = ⟨0, hm⟩
      · subst i
        simp [axisRow]
      · have hne : i.succ ≠ Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩ := fun h ↦ hi (Fin.succ_injective m h)
        rw [axisRow_apply_of_ne hne]
        simp [hi]

  {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ),
  q 0 ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (M : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) ι (PowerSeries κ)),

        ∀ (ell : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ),

            ((fun i => PowerSeries.constantCoeff (ell i)) = fun i =>

              {
                    toFun := fun v =>
                      ∑ i, (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)) (ell i.succ) * v i,
                    map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈
                  Submodule.span (LaurentSeries κ)
                    (Set.range fun f =>
                      {
                        toFun := fun v =>
                          ∑ i,
                            (MvPolynomial.eval fun i =>
                                  (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)) (q i.succ) /

                              v i,
                        map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }) ∧

/-- **Paragraph defining `y` (equation (generic)).**  The affine point
`y = (q_1/q_0, …, q_n/q_0) ∈ κ((t))^n` is the image of `(x̄_1, …, x̄_n)` under
`F ↪ κ((t))`, so `f(y) = 0 ↔ f ∈ 𝔭` for every `f ∈ K[x]`. -/
theorem step_generic_point {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (w : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P) :
    let C := w.column
    let W := C.W
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
    letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
    let κ := ResidueField V
    letI : Algebra k κ := retainedResidueGroundAlgebra P ⟨0, hm⟩ W
    let q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ := fun a ↦ retainedToCompletedPowerSeries W (C.q a)
    ∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ))
        (dehomogenizedPoint (laurentColumn q)) f = 0 ↔ f ∈ P.asIdeal := by
  classical
  intro C W V κ q
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
    (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra k κ := retainedResidueGroundAlgebra P ⟨0, hm⟩ W
  have hground := retainedLaurentLift_comp_algebraMap P ⟨0, hm⟩ W
  have hpoint := retainedLaurentLift_componentCoordinate P ⟨0, hm⟩ W C.q C.scale
    C.q_commonScale C.q0_ne
  have hker := component_generic_kernel_after_point_transport P
    (retainedLaurentLift P ⟨0, hm⟩ W) (RingHom.injective _) hground _ hpoint
  intro f
  rw [← MvPolynomial.eval_map]
  exact hker f

∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (w : Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P),
  let C := w.1;
  let W := C.1;
  let V := W.6.1.toSubring;
  let κ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V;
  have q := fun a =>
    (let V := W.6.1.toSubring;
      (RingEquiv.symm
              (let V := W.6.1.toSubring;
              RingEquiv.ofBijective
                {
                  toFun := fun f =>
                    ⟨fun n =>
                      {
                          toFun := fun f =>
                            Polynomial.eval₂
                              (Nat.casesOn n
                                  (have htop := ⋯;
                                  { toFun := fun x => 0, map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯,
                                    map_zero' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ })
                                  fun n =>
                                  (↑(have h := ⋯;
                                        AlgEquiv.restrictScalars (↥W.1)
                                          (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq (↥V) h).symm)).comp
                                    (Algebra.FormallySmooth.liftOfSurjective
                                      (AlgHom.id (↥W.1) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V))
                                      (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V ^ (n + 1))
                                        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (↥W.1) (↥V)
                                          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V))
                                        ⋯)
                                      ⋯ ⋯)).toRingHom
                              ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V ^ n • ⊤))
                                (Classical.choose ⋯))
                              ((PowerSeries.trunc n) f),
                          map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_zero' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯ }
                        f,
                      ⋯⟩,
                  map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_zero' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯ }
                ⋯)).toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap (↥V) (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V) ↥V)))
      (C.3 a);
  ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ))
          (fun i =>
            (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)) (q i.succ) /
              (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)) (q 0))
          f =
        0 ↔
      f ∈ P.asIdeal

/-- Paragraph "For the next argument": for `f ∈ B`,
`H_f g = Σ_i ∂f/∂x_i ∂g/∂ξ_i = {f, g}` (the bracket of Definition 2.9,
`Section2.poisson`), and involutivity gives `H_f^m g ∈ J`
for all `g ∈ J`, `m ≥ 0`. -/
theorem step_hamiltonian
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (hf : f ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W)
    (g : SymbolRing k m) (hg : g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) :
    Stafford38.Paper.Section2.poisson k (baseLift f) g =
        ∑ i : Fin m, baseLift (MvPolynomial.pderiv i f) *
          MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i : PhaseVar m) g ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, hamiltonIter f j g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · rw [Stafford38.Paper.Section2.poisson_eq]
    simp [poissonBracket, pderiv_baseLift_base, pderiv_baseLift_fibre]
  · induction j with
    | zero => exact hg
    | succ j hj => exact hinv _ hf _ hj

is invertible over `κ[[t]]` and there is a unique `λ` with
`Z̃ λ = (q'_{i_1}, …, q'_{i_{d'}})`.  For `w = q' − Zλ`: `w_{i_l} = 0`;

      (∀ i, (c : ℕ∞) ≤ (PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q i) - Z.mulVec lambda i).order) ∧
      (∃ i, (PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q i) - Z.mulVec lambda i).order = c) ∧
      c ≤ a - 1 ∧
      (∀ i, PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q i) - Z.mulVec lambda i =
        (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ c * tau i) ∧
      (∃ i, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tau i) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ l, tau (rows l) = 0) ∧
      (∃ s : PowerSeries κ,
        tau (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ (b - a) * s) ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tau (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)) = 0 ∧
      tau j = 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨lambda, c, tau, -, -, -, hsel, htauj, htaurows, hc, hfactor, hprim, htau1,
      -, -, -, -⟩ :=
    exists_formalDivisorAxisLift q Z rows j 0 (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) a b u₀ u₁ hqj hZj ha hab
      hq0 hu₀ hZ0 hq1 hZ1 (by rw [hminor]; exact one_ne_zero)
  -- `Z̃(0) = 1`, so `Z̃` is a unit and `Z̃ λ = (q'_{i_l})` has one solution.
  have huniq : ∀ lambda' : Fin d → PowerSeries κ,
      (∀ l, PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q (rows l)) = Z.mulVec lambda' (rows l)) →
        lambda' = lambda := by
    intro lambda' h'
    have hunit : IsUnit (selectedMinor Z rows) :=
      (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr
        (PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by rw [hminor]; exact isUnit_one))
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hunit
    funext l
    change Z.mulVec lambda' (rows l) = Z.mulVec lambda (rows l)
    rw [← h', hsel]
  -- `ord w_0 = a − 1`: the coefficient `a u_0(0)` of `t^{a-1}` is nonzero.
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀c⟩ := derivative_sub_mulVec_eq_X_pow_mul q Z lambda 0 a ha u₀ hq0 hZ0
  have hw0 : (PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q 0) - Z.mulVec lambda 0).order = (a - 1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [hr₀]
    apply order_X_pow_mul_of_constantCoeff_ne_zero
    rw [hr₀c]
    exact mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr ha.ne') hu₀
  -- `ord w_1 ≥ b − 1`, so `ord τ_1 ≥ b − 1 − c ≥ b − a`.
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, -⟩ :=
    derivative_sub_mulVec_eq_X_pow_mul q Z lambda _ b (ha.trans hab) u₁ hq1 hZ1
  have htau1' : tau (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) =
      (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ (b - a) *
        ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ (a - 1 - c) * r₁) := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero c (PowerSeries.X_ne_zero (R := κ)))
    rw [← hfactor, hr₁, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    congr 2
    omega
  refine ⟨lambda, c, tau, hsel, huniq, fun l ↦ sub_eq_zero.mpr (hsel l), hw0, ?_, ?_, hc,
    hfactor, hprim, htaurows, ⟨_, htau1'⟩, htau1, htauj⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hfactor i, PowerSeries.order_mul, PowerSeries.order_X_pow]
    exact le_self_add
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hprim
    exact ⟨i, by rw [hfactor i]; exact order_X_pow_mul_of_constantCoeff_ne_zero c _ hi⟩

`u M(0) = 0`.  There is a set `ι` of row indices with `M_ι(0)` invertible;
then `det M_ι` has nonzero constant term, so `M_ι` is invertible over
`κ[[t]]`, and `ℓ_υ = u_υ`, `ℓ_ι = −u_υ M_υ M_ι⁻¹` satisfies `ℓ M = 0` and

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_lift_ell_.source:
/-- **Paragraph lifting `u`.**  Let `M(0)` have full column rank and
`u M(0) = 0`.  There is a set `ι` of row indices with `M_ι(0)` invertible;
then `det M_ι` has nonzero constant term, so `M_ι` is invertible over
`κ[[t]]`, and `ℓ_υ = u_υ`, `ℓ_ι = −u_υ M_υ M_ι⁻¹` satisfies `ℓ M = 0` and
`ℓ(0) = u`. -/
theorem step_lift_ell_minor {R ι : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq R]
    [DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix R ι (PowerSeries κ))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (residueMatrix M).mulVec) (u : R → κ)
    (hu : rowMul u (residueMatrix M) = 0) :
    ∃ rowsι : ι ↪ R,
      (selectedMinor (residueMatrix M) rowsι).det ≠ 0 ∧
      IsUnit (selectedMinor M rowsι).det ∧
      (∀ i, (¬ ∃ c, rowsι c = i) → liftRow M rowsι u i = PowerSeries.C (u i)) ∧
      (∀ c, liftRow M rowsι u (rowsι c) = liftBlock M rowsι u c) ∧
      rowMul (liftRow M rowsι u) M = 0 ∧
      residueColumn (liftRow M rowsι u) = u := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨rowsι, h0⟩ := exists_selectedMinor_det_ne_zero_of_mulVec_injective _ hinj
  have h0' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (selectedMinor M rowsι).det ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [constantCoeff_selectedMinor_det]
  have hunit : IsUnit (selectedMinor M rowsι).det :=
    PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ h0')
  set ℓ := liftRow M rowsι u
  -- `ℓ M = ℓ_ι M_ι + ℓ_υ M_υ = −u_υ M_υ + u_υ M_υ = 0`.
  have hblock : Matrix.vecMul (liftBlock M rowsι u) (selectedMinor M rowsι) =
      -rowMul (complementRow rowsι u) M := by
    rw [liftBlock, Matrix.neg_vecMul, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hunit, Matrix.vecMul_one]
  have hell : rowMul ℓ M = 0 := by
    funext col
    have h := congrFun hblock col
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, selectedMinor, Pi.neg_apply] at h
    have hsplit : rowMul ℓ M col = rowMul (complementRow rowsι u) M col +
        ∑ c, liftBlock M rowsι u c * M (rowsι c) col := by
      simp only [ℓ, liftRow, rowMul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ ↦ ?_
      simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      simp
    rw [hsplit, h, Pi.zero_apply, add_neg_cancel]
  refine ⟨rowsι, h0, hunit, liftRow_apply_of_not_mem M rowsι u, liftRow_apply_rows M rowsι u,
    hell, ?_⟩
  -- `ℓ(0) − u` vanishes off `ι` and is killed by `M(0)`, hence vanishes on `ι`.
  let δ : R → κ := residueColumn ℓ - u
  have hoff : ∀ i, (¬ ∃ c, rowsι c = i) → δ i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    simp [δ, residueColumn, ℓ, liftRow_apply_of_not_mem M rowsι u i hi]
  have hδ : Matrix.vecMul (fun c ↦ δ (rowsι c)) (selectedMinor (residueMatrix M) rowsι) = 0 := by
    funext col
    have hℓ := congrArg PowerSeries.constantCoeff (congrFun hell col)
    have hu' := congrFun hu col
    simp only [rowMul, map_sum, map_mul, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero] at hℓ hu'
    have hsum : ∑ i, δ i * residueMatrix M i col = 0 := by
      simp only [δ, Pi.sub_apply, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [hu', sub_zero]
      exact hℓ
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, ← hsum]
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, selectedMinor]
    refine Fintype.sum_of_injective rowsι rowsι.injective _ _ ?_ fun c ↦ rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hoff i (by simpa using hi), zero_mul]
  have hA : IsUnit (selectedMinor (residueMatrix M) rowsι) :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ h0)
  have hzero := Matrix.vecMul_injective_of_isUnit hA (hδ.trans (Matrix.zero_vecMul _).symm)
  funext i
  by_cases hi : ∃ c, rowsι c = i
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hi
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (congrFun hzero c)
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hoff i hi)
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_lift_ell_.unfolded:
∀ {κ : Type u} [inst : Field κ] {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype R]
  [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq R] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι]
  (M : Matrix R ι (PowerSeries κ)),
  Function.Injective (Matrix.mulVec fun i j => PowerSeries.constantCoeff (M i j)) →
    ∀ (u : R → κ),
      (fun j => ∑ i, u i * PowerSeries.constantCoeff (M i j)) = 0 →
        ∃ rowsι,
          (Matrix.det fun a b => PowerSeries.constantCoeff (M (rowsι a) b)) ≠ 0 ∧
            IsUnit (Matrix.det fun a b => M (rowsι a) b) ∧
              (∀ (i : R),
                  (¬∃ c, rowsι c = i) →
                    ((if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) +
                        ∑ c,
                          if rowsι c = i then
                            (-Matrix.vecMul
                                  (fun j =>
                                    ∑ i,
                                      (if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) * M i j)
                                  (fun a b => M (rowsι a) b)⁻¹)
                              c
                          else 0) =
                      PowerSeries.C (u i)) ∧
                (∀ (c : ι),
                    ((if ∃ c_1, rowsι c_1 = rowsι c then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u (rowsι c))) +
                        ∑ c_1,
                          if rowsι c_1 = rowsι c then
                            (-Matrix.vecMul
                                  (fun j =>
                                    ∑ i,
                                      (if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) * M i j)
                                  (fun a b => M (rowsι a) b)⁻¹)
                              c_1
                          else 0) =
                      (-Matrix.vecMul
                            (fun j =>
                              ∑ i, (if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) * M i j)
                            (fun a b => M (rowsι a) b)⁻¹)
                        c) ∧
                  (fun j =>
                        ∑ i,
                          ((if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) +
                              ∑ c,
                                if rowsι c = i then
                                  (-Matrix.vecMul
                                        (fun j =>
                                          ∑ i,
                                            (if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) *
                                              M i j)
                                        (fun a b => M (rowsι a) b)⁻¹)
                                    c
                                else 0) *
                            M i j) =
                      0 ∧
                    (fun i =>
                        PowerSeries.constantCoeff
                          ((if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) +
                            ∑ c,
                              if rowsι c = i then
                                (-Matrix.vecMul
                                      (fun j =>
                                        ∑ i,
                                          (if ∃ c, rowsι c = i then 0 else PowerSeries.C (u i)) *
                                            M i j)
                                      (fun a b => M (rowsι a) b)⁻¹)
                                  c
                              else 0)) =
                      u

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_line_mem.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
  {m : ℕ} (W : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar m → k)) (hclosed : ∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
  (hcone : Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical W)
  (hinv : Characteristic.PostScalarExtensionPoisson.IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
  (y : Fin m → k) (hy : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W))

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_line_mem.source:
/-- Same paragraph: since `char K = 0`, `φ^{(j)}(0) = j! c_j = 0` forces
`φ = 0`, so `(y, t df_y) ∈ V_K(J) = W` for every `t ∈ K`. -/
theorem step_line_mem
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (y : Fin m → k) (hy : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (hf : f ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W) (t : k) :
    Sum.elim y (t • differentialAt y f) ∈ W := by
  rw [← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_of_algebraic_closed W hclosed]
  intro g hg
  have hphi : fibreLinePolynomial y (differentialAt y f) g = 0 :=
    polynomial_eq_zero_of_eval_iterate_derivative_zero _
      (step_phi_derivatives W hclosed hcone hinv y hy f hf g hg)
  have h := eval_fibreLinePolynomial y (differentialAt y f) g t
  rw [hphi, Polynomial.eval_zero] at h
  have hpt : Sum.elim y (t • differentialAt y f) =
      Sum.elim y (fun i => t * differentialAt y f i) := rfl
  rw [hpt]
  exact h.symm
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_line_mem.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (W : Set (Fin m ⊕ Fin m → k)),
  (∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L) →
    (∀ q ∈ W,
        ∀ (a : k), a ≠ 0 → (Sum.elim (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) fun i => a * q (Sum.inr i)) ∈ W) →
      (∀ f ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
          ∀ g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
            ∑ i,
                ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) g -
                  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) g) ∈
              MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) →
        ∀
          y ∈
            MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k
              (Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W)),
          ∀ f ∈ Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W),
            ∀ (t : k),
              Sum.elim y (t • fun i => (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f)) ∈ W

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_minimal_p.doc:
Paragraph "Since `V_K(B) = Y = π(W) ≠ ∅`": `B` is radical and proper (by
`step_projection`), has finitely many minimal primes `𝔮_1, …, 𝔮_r`, at least
one, and `B = ⋂ 𝔮_i`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_minimal_p.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_minimal_primes.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
  [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (W : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar m → k))
  (hclosed : ∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
  (hcone : Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical W) (hne : W.Nonempty) :
  (exclusionBaseIdeal W).IsRadical ∧
    (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes.Finite ∧
      sInf (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes = exclusionBaseIdeal W ∧
        (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes.Nonempty
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_minimal_p.source:
/-- Paragraph "Since `V_K(B) = Y = π(W) ≠ ∅`": `B` is radical and proper (by
`step_projection`), has finitely many minimal primes `𝔮_1, …, 𝔮_r`, at least
one, and `B = ⋂ 𝔮_i`. -/
theorem step_minimal_primes
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W) (hne : W.Nonempty) :
    (exclusionBaseIdeal W).IsRadical ∧
      (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes.Finite ∧
      sInf (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes = exclusionBaseIdeal W ∧
      (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes.Nonempty := by
  have hrad : (exclusionBaseIdeal W).IsRadical :=
    (vanishingIdeal_isRadical W).comap _
  have hproper : exclusionBaseIdeal W ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
    have hy : (fun i => q (.inl i)) ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W) := by
      rw [← step_projection W hclosed hcone]
      refine ⟨fun i => q (.inr i), ?_⟩
      have hsplit : Sum.elim (fun i => q (.inl i)) (fun i => q (.inr i)) = q := by
        funext i; cases i <;> rfl
      rwa [hsplit]
    have := hy 1 (htop ▸ trivial)
    simp at this
  refine ⟨hrad, Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing _ _, ?_,
    Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mp (Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes hproper)⟩
  rw [Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes, hrad.radical]

∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (W : Set (Fin m ⊕ Fin m → k)),
  (∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L) →
    (∀ q ∈ W,
        ∀ (a : k), a ≠ 0 → (Sum.elim (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) fun i => a * q (Sum.inr i)) ∈ W) →
      W.Nonempty →
        (Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W)).IsRadical ∧
          (Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl)
                  (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W)).minimalPrimes.Finite ∧
            sInf
                  (Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl)
                      (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W)).minimalPrimes =
                Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) ∧
              (Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl)
                    (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W)).minimalPrimes.Nonempty

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_orders.doc:
**Paragraph "`a = ord q_0`, `b = ord q_1`".**  For the column
`q_i = x̄_i / x̄_j` of the discrete valuation ring of Lemmas 5.9–5.10, read in
`κ[[t]]`: `q_0 = t^a u_0` and `q_1 = t^b u_1` with `u_0(0) ≠ 0 ≠ u_1(0)` and
`0 < a < b` (`a > 0` by `step_a_pos`, from Lemma 5.10(a)); hence `q_j = 1`
forces `j ∉ {0, 1}`.  The hypothesis `hunit` (`x̄_1` is a unit of `R`) is the
consequence of `Y ∩ H = ∅`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_orders.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_orders.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (w : Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P)
  (hunit : ∃ g, MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) :
  let C := w.column;
  let W := C.W;
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring;
  let κ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V;
  have q := fun a =>
    (Geometry.RetainedProjectiveCompletion.retainedToCompletedPowerSeries W) (C.q a);
  ∃ a b u₀ u₁,
    0 < a ∧
      a < b ∧
        q 0 = PowerSeries.X ^ a * u₀ ∧
          PowerSeries.constantCoeff u₀ ≠ 0 ∧
            q ⟨0, hm⟩.succ = PowerSeries.X ^ b * u₁ ∧

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_orders.source:
/-- **Paragraph "`a = ord q_0`, `b = ord q_1`".**  For the column
`q_i = x̄_i / x̄_j` of the discrete valuation ring of Lemmas 5.9–5.10, read in
`κ[[t]]`: `q_0 = t^a u_0` and `q_1 = t^b u_1` with `u_0(0) ≠ 0 ≠ u_1(0)` and
`0 < a < b` (`a > 0` by `step_a_pos`, from Lemma 5.10(a)); hence `q_j = 1`
forces `j ∉ {0, 1}`.  The hypothesis `hunit` (`x̄_1` is a unit of `R`) is the
consequence of `Y ∩ H = ∅`. -/
theorem step_orders {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (w : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P)
    (hunit : ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k,
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) :
    let C := w.column
    let W := C.W
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
    letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
    let κ := ResidueField V
    let q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ := fun a ↦ retainedToCompletedPowerSeries W (C.q a)
    ∃ (a b : ℕ) (u₀ u₁ : PowerSeries κ),
      0 < a ∧ a < b ∧
      q 0 = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ a * u₀ ∧ PowerSeries.constantCoeff u₀ ≠ 0 ∧
      q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ b * u₁ ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff u₁ ≠ 0 ∧
      q C.chart = 1 ∧ C.chart ≠ 0 ∧ C.chart ≠ Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩ := by
  classical
  intro C W V κ q
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
    (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  -- `a > 0` (`step_a_pos`, by Lemma 5.10(a)) and `b - a = ord x̄_1 > 0`.
  have hq₀max : C.q 0 ∈ maximalIdeal V := by
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
    exact step_a_pos hm P w hunit
  have hparammax : W.place.parameter ∈ maximalIdeal V := by
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
    exact W.place.parameter_nonunit
  obtain ⟨a, b', u₀, u₁', ha, hab', hq0, hu₀, hq1'⟩ := completed_order_gap
    (retainedToCompletedPowerSeries W)
    (Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.chosenUniformizer V)
    (retainedToCompletedPowerSeries_chosenUniformizer W)
    (Stafford38.Geometry.CompletedDVRPowerSeries.chosenUniformizer_irreducible V)
    (C.q 0) W.place.parameter (C.q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)) C.q0_ne
    W.place.parameter_ne hq₀max hparammax C.q_parameter
  have hqj : q C.chart = 1 :=
    (congrArg (retainedToCompletedPowerSeries W) C.chart_one).trans (map_one _)
  -- `q_1 = q_0 x̄_1 ≠ 0`, so `b = ord q_1` is finite.
  have hq1ne : q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hV : C.q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0 :=
      retainedToCompletedPowerSeries_injective W (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    rw [C.q_parameter] at hV
    exact mul_ne_zero C.q0_ne W.place.parameter_ne hV
  have hu₁ : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)).divXPowOrder ≠ 0 :=
    fun h ↦ hq1ne (PowerSeries.constantCoeff_divXPowOrder_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  have hq1'' : q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ b' * u₁' := hq1'
  have hb : b' ≤ (q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)).order.toNat := by
    by_contra hlt
    apply hu₁
    rw [PowerSeries.constantCoeff_divXPowOrder]
    generalize (q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)).order.toNat = n at hlt ⊢
    rw [hq1'', PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul']
    exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h ↦ absurd h (by omega)
  have hconst : ∀ i, q i = (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ a * u₀ → i ≠ C.chart := by
    intro i hi hij
    have hi1 : q i = 1 := by rw [hij]; exact hqj
    have h1 := congrArg PowerSeries.constantCoeff (hi1.symm.trans hi)
    simp [ha.ne'] at h1
  have hconst1 : C.chart ≠ Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩ := by
    intro hij
    have hi1 : q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩) = 1 := by rw [← hij]; exact hqj
    have h1 := congrArg PowerSeries.constantCoeff (hi1.symm.trans hq1'')
    simp [(ha.trans hab').ne'] at h1
  exact ⟨a, (q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)).order.toNat, u₀, (q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)).divXPowOrder,
    ha, hab'.trans_le hb, hq0, hu₀, PowerSeries.X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder.symm, hu₁, hqj,
    fun h ↦ hconst 0 hq0 h.symm, hconst1⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_orders.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (w : Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P),
  (∃ g, MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) →
    let C := w.1;
    let W := C.1;
    let V := W.6.1.toSubring;
    let κ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V;
    have q := fun a =>
      (let V := W.6.1.toSubring;
        (RingEquiv.symm
                (let V := W.6.1.toSubring;
                RingEquiv.ofBijective
                  {
                    toFun := fun f =>
                      ⟨fun n =>
                        {
                            toFun := fun f =>
                              Polynomial.eval₂
                                (Nat.casesOn n
                                    (have htop := ⋯;
                                    { toFun := fun x => 0, map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯,
                                      map_zero' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ })
                                    fun n =>
                                    (↑(have h := ⋯;
                                          AlgEquiv.restrictScalars (↥W.1)
                                            (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq (↥V) h).symm)).comp
                                      (Algebra.FormallySmooth.liftOfSurjective
                                        (AlgHom.id (↥W.1) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V))
                                        (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ
                                          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V ^ (n + 1))
                                          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (↥W.1) (↥V)
                                            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V))
                                          ⋯)
                                        ⋯ ⋯)).toRingHom
                                ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V ^ n • ⊤))
                                  (Classical.choose ⋯))
                                ((PowerSeries.trunc n) f),
                            map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_zero' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯ }
                          f,
                        ⋯⟩,
                    map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_zero' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯ }
                  ⋯)).toRingHom.comp
          (algebraMap (↥V) (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥V) ↥V)))
        (C.3 a);
    ∃ a b u₀ u₁,
      0 < a ∧
        a < b ∧
          q 0 = PowerSeries.X ^ a * u₀ ∧
            PowerSeries.constantCoeff u₀ ≠ 0 ∧
              q ⟨0, hm⟩.succ = PowerSeries.X ^ b * u₁ ∧
                PowerSeries.constantCoeff u₁ ≠ 0 ∧ q C.2 = 1 ∧ C.2 ≠ 0 ∧ C.2 ≠ ⟨0, hm⟩.succ

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_phi_deriv.source:
/-- Same paragraph: for `y ∈ Y`, `f ∈ B`, `g ∈ J`, the polynomial
`φ(t) = g(y, t df_y)` satisfies `φ^{(j)}(0) = H_f^j g(y, 0) = 0` for all `j`. -/
theorem step_phi_derivatives
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (y : Fin m → k) (hy : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (hf : f ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W)
    (g : SymbolRing k m) (hg : g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) (j : ℕ) :
    Polynomial.eval 0 ((Polynomial.derivative^[j])
      (fibreLinePolynomial y (differentialAt y f) g)) = 0 := by
  rw [iterate_derivative_fibreLinePolynomial, eval_zero_fibreLinePolynomial]
  have hpoint : zeroSectionPoint y = Sum.elim y (0 : Fin m → k) := by
    funext i; rcases i with i | i <;> rfl
  rw [hpoint]
  exact (step_hamiltonian W hinv f hf g hg).2 j _
    (step_zero_section W hclosed hcone y hy)

∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (W : Set (Fin m ⊕ Fin m → k)),
  (∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L) →
    (∀ q ∈ W,
        ∀ (a : k), a ≠ 0 → (Sum.elim (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) fun i => a * q (Sum.inr i)) ∈ W) →
      (∀ f ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
          ∀ g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
            ∑ i,
                ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) g -
                  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) g) ∈
              MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) →
        ∀
          y ∈
            MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k
              (Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W)),
          ∀ f ∈ Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W),
            ∀ g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
              ∀ (j : ℕ),
                Polynomial.eval 0
                    ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[j]
                      ((MvPolynomial.aeval
                          (Sum.elim (fun i => Polynomial.C (y i)) fun i =>
                            Polynomial.C 0 +
                              Polynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f)) *
                                Polynomial.X))
                        g)) =
                  0

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_polynomia.source:
/-- **Final paragraph.**  Let `P ∈ K[ξ]` vanish on `N(Y)`, let the equations
of `Y` vanish at the generic point `y ∈ κ((t))^n`, and let
`ℓ̃(t) ∈ κ[[t]]^n` lie in the `κ((t))`-span of `{dg_y : g ∈ 𝔭}`.  Then
`P(ℓ̃(0)) = 0`. -/
theorem step_polynomial_limit
    {k κ : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] {m : ℕ}
    (I : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (Pol : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (hPol : Pol ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (smoothConormalFibreProjection I.asIdeal))
    (y : Fin m → LaurentSeries κ)
    (hbase : ∀ f ∈ I.asIdeal, MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ)) y f = 0)
    (ell : Fin m → PowerSeries κ)
    (hell : coordinateCovector (fun i ↦ algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ) (ell i)) ∈
      equationCovectorSpan y
        (I.asIdeal.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ))))) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k κ) (residueColumn ell) Pol = 0 := by
  apply eval_residue_eq_zero_of_mem_groundEquationConormalLocus I Pol hPol y ell
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hker : I.asIdeal.map (groundPolynomialMap (k := k) (K := κ) (Fin m)) ≤
        RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.eval y) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
      intro f hf
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
      change MvPolynomial.eval y (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ)) f) = 0
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval_map]
      exact hbase f hf
    intro f hf
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (hker hf)
  · change coordinateCovector (fun i ↦ algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ) (ell i)) ∈
      affineConormalSpace y (I.asIdeal.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ))))
    rw [affineConormalSpace_eq_equationCovectorSpan]
    exact hell

  (I : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)),
  ∀
    Pol ∈
      MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k
        {ξ |
          ∃ y,
            (∃ e,
                (∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),

                    Algebra.smoothLocus k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ I.asIdeal)) ∧
              { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, ξ i * v i, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈
                (Submodule.span k

      (∀ f ∈ I.asIdeal, MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ)) y f = 0) →
        ∀ (ell : Fin m → PowerSeries κ),
          { toFun := fun v => ∑ i, (algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) (LaurentSeries κ)) (ell i) * v i,
                map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ } ∈

/-- Same paragraph: `Y = π(W)`. -/
theorem step_projection
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W) :
    {y : Fin m → k | ∃ ξ : Fin m → k, Sum.elim y ξ ∈ W} =
      MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W) := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ f hf
    have h := hf (Sum.elim y ξ) hξ
    simpa [baseLift, MvPolynomial.eval_rename, Function.comp_def] using h
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨0, step_zero_section W hclosed hcone y hy⟩

    (∀ q ∈ W,
        ∀ (a : k), a ≠ 0 → (Sum.elim (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) fun i => a * q (Sum.inr i)) ∈ W) →
      {y | ∃ ξ, Sum.elim y ξ ∈ W} =
        MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k
          (Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_separator.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_separator.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] {m : ℕ}
  (W : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar m → k)) (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (hrad : (exclusionBaseIdeal W).IsRadical) (h𝔮 : 𝔮 ∈ (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes) :
  ∃ s ∉ 𝔮, ∀ h ∈ 𝔮, s * h ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.step_separator.source:
/-- Paragraph "Furthermore": there is a separator `s ∉ 𝔮` with `s𝔮 ⊆ B`,
`s = s_2 ⋯ s_r` with `s_i ∈ 𝔮_i ∖ 𝔮`. -/
theorem step_separator
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (hrad : (exclusionBaseIdeal W).IsRadical)
    (h𝔮 : 𝔮 ∈ (exclusionBaseIdeal W).minimalPrimes) :
    ∃ s ∉ 𝔮, ∀ h ∈ 𝔮, s * h ∈ exclusionBaseIdeal W := by
  classical
  set B := exclusionBaseIdeal W
  have hfin := Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing
    (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) B
  set T := hfin.toFinset.erase 𝔮 with hT
  have hchoice : ∀ Q ∈ T, ∃ s ∈ Q, s ∉ 𝔮 := by
    intro Q hQ
    rw [hT, Finset.mem_erase, hfin.mem_toFinset] at hQ
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    exact hQ.1 (le_antisymm hcon (h𝔮.2 hQ.2.1 hcon))
  choose s hsQ hsP using hchoice
  refine ⟨∏ Q ∈ T.attach, s Q.1 Q.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨Q, -, hQ⟩ := (h𝔮.1.1.prod_mem_iff).1 hs
    exact hsP Q.1 Q.2 hQ
  · intro h hh
    rw [← hrad.radical, ← Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes, Ideal.mem_sInf]
    intro Q hQ
    by_cases hQP : Q = 𝔮
    · subst hQP
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hh
    · have hQT : Q ∈ T := by
        rw [hT, Finset.mem_erase, hfin.mem_toFinset]
        exact ⟨hQP, hQ⟩

        (hsQ Q hQT)

/-- Final sentence: `Y_0` is nonempty, closed, irreducible (Definition 5.4(a),
`I(Y_0) = 𝔮` prime) and avoids `H`, and `P` vanishes on `N(Y_0)`, so Theorem 5.7(i)
gives `P(1, 0, …, 0) = 0`. -/
theorem step_theorem_5_7_applies
    (hm : 0 < m) (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)) (hprime : 𝔮.IsPrime)
    (havoid : ∀ y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k 𝔮, y ⟨0, hm⟩ ≠ 0)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (hP : ∀ ξ ∈ conormalCone ⟨𝔮, hprime⟩, MvPolynomial.eval ξ P = 0) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i : Fin m => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then (1 : k) else 0) P = 0 := by
  -- `Y_0 = V_K(𝔮)` is nonempty, closed and irreducible, with `I(Y_0) = 𝔮`
  obtain ⟨hne, hY, hpt⟩ := irreducibleClosed_zeroLocus_of_isPrime (k := k) 𝔮
  refine theorem_5_7_i_printed hm _ hne hY ?_ P (hpt ▸ hP)
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
  exact fun hy h0 => havoid y hy h0

/-- Same paragraph: `g_0 ∈ B`, hence `g(y, 0) = g_0(y) = 0` for `y ∈ Y = V_K(B)`,
and `Y × {0} ⊆ V_K(J) = W` because `W` is closed. -/
theorem step_zero_section
    (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W) :
    ∀ y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (exclusionBaseIdeal W),
      Sum.elim y (0 : Fin m → k) ∈ W := by
  intro y hy
  have hhom : (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W).IsHomogeneous
      (orderDecomposition (k := k) (n := m)) :=
    fun d _ hg => step_homogeneous_components W hcone _ hg d
  have hzero := zeroSection_commonZero_of_isHomogeneous
    (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) hhom y hy
  have hpoint : Sum.elim y (0 : Fin m → k) = zeroSectionPoint y := by
    funext i; rcases i with i | i <;> rfl
  rw [← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_of_algebraic_closed W hclosed, hpoint]
  exact hzero

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_7_i_.doc:
**Theorem 5.7(i), along the paper's proof.**  If `Y = V(𝔭)` is nonempty,
irreducible and avoids `H = {x_1 = 0}`, every polynomial vanishing on the
conormal cone `N(Y)` over the smooth locus vanishes at `(1, 0, …, 0)`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_7_i_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_7_i_paper.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
  [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (I : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (havoid : ∀ y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k I.asIdeal, y ⟨0, hm⟩ ≠ 0) :
  (fun i => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) ∈
    MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k
      (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k
        (Geometry.ProjectiveConormalDirections.smoothConormalFibreProjection I.asIdeal))
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_7_i_.source:
/-- **Theorem 5.7(i), along the paper's proof.**  If `Y = V(𝔭)` is nonempty,
irreducible and avoids `H = {x_1 = 0}`, every polynomial vanishing on the
conormal cone `N(Y)` over the smooth locus vanishes at `(1, 0, …, 0)`. -/
theorem theorem_5_7_i_paper
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (I : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (havoid : ∀ y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k I.asIdeal, y ⟨0, hm⟩ ≠ 0) :
    (fun i : Fin m => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then (1 : k) else 0) ∈
      MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k
        (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (smoothConormalFibreProjection I.asIdeal)) := by
  classical
  intro Pol hPol
  by_cases halg : IsAlgebraic k (componentCoordinate I ⟨0, hm⟩)
  · -- First paragraph: `x̄_1` algebraic, so `x_1 − c ∈ 𝔭` and
    -- `(1, 0, …, 0) = dx_1` is conormal at points of `Y`.
    obtain ⟨c, y, -, -, hmem⟩ := exists_constant_coordinate_equation_and_pure_axis hm I halg
    have h := fibreLift_mem_vanishingIdeal_equationConormal I.asIdeal I.isPrime Pol hPol _ hmem
    simpa [fibreLift, MvPolynomial.eval_rename, Function.comp_def] using h
  -- `x̄_1` transcendental.  `Y ∩ H = ∅` makes `x̄_1` a unit of `R`.
  have hunit := exists_coordinate_inverse_of_avoidance I.asIdeal ⟨0, hm⟩ havoid
  -- Lemmas 5.9–5.10: the discrete valuation ring `V` of `F` at infinity, the
  -- column `q_i = x̄_i / x̄_j` and `κ = V/𝔪_V`, read in `V̂ ≅ κ[[t]]`.
  obtain ⟨w, hfin⟩ :=
    Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.generalDivisorialVisibleFrameWithKaehlerFinite
      hm I hunit halg
  let C := w.column
  let W := C.W
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
    (ComponentFractionField I) := W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : IsLocalRing V := W.place.isDiscrete.toIsLocalRing
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  let κ := ResidueField V
  letI : Algebra k κ := retainedResidueGroundAlgebra I ⟨0, hm⟩ W
  letI : CharZero κ :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective k κ)
  -- Paragraph "`V̂ ≅ κ[[t]]`": `F ↪ κ((t))`, and the residue is the constant term.
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hres, -, -, -⟩ := step_completion hm I w
  let q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ := fun a ↦ retainedToCompletedPowerSeries W (C.q a)
  let axis : Fin (m + 1) := Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩
  -- Paragraph "`a = ord q_0`, `b = ord q_1`": `0 < a < b`, `j ∉ {0, 1}`.
  obtain ⟨a, b, u₀, u₁, ha, hab, hq0, hu₀, hq1, -, hqj, -, -⟩ := step_orders hm I w hunit
  have hq0ne : q 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hu₀
    have h' : (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ a * u₀ = 0 := hq0.symm.trans h
    rw [mul_eq_zero] at h'
    rcases h' with h' | h'
    · exact absurd h' (pow_ne_zero a PowerSeries.X_ne_zero)
    · rw [h', map_zero]
  -- Paragraph defining `y`, equation (generic): `f(y) = 0` for `f ∈ 𝔭`.
  have hbase : ∀ f ∈ I.asIdeal, MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ))
      (dehomogenizedPoint (laurentColumn q)) f = 0 :=
    fun f hf ↦ (step_generic_point hm I w f).2 hf
  -- Lemma 5.11: `d(q_{i_l}(0))`, `i_l ∉ {0, 1, j}`, form a basis of `Ω_{κ/K}`.
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, d, rows, hinj, -, hli, hspan, hd⟩ := witness_lemma_5_11 hm I w hunit
  have hresRows : (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (rows l)))) =
      fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (residue V (C.q (rows l))) := by
    funext l
    rw [hres]
  rw [← hresRows] at hli hspan
  let rowsE : Fin d ↪ Fin (m + 1) := ⟨rows, hinj⟩
  -- Paragraph after Lemma 5.11: dual derivations `D_k` and the matrix `Z(t)`.
  obtain ⟨D, -, -, hminor, hZj, hZ0, hZ1⟩ :=
    step_dual_derivations (k := k) hm q rowsE hli hspan C.chart hqj a b u₀ u₁ hq0 hq1
  let Z := coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D
  -- Paragraph defining `λ` (unique), `w = q' − Zλ`, `c ≤ a − 1` and `τ = t^{-c} w`.
  obtain ⟨lambda, c, tau, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hfactor, hprim, htaurows, -, htau1, htauj⟩ :=
    step_lambda_w_tau hm q Z rowsE C.chart a b u₀ u₁ hqj hZj ha hab hq0 hu₀ hZ0 hq1 hZ1 hminor
  -- Paragraph "`M(0)` has full column rank" for `M = (q, Z, τ)`: a unit minor
  -- `M_ι`, independent columns over `κ((t))`, vanishing `1`-coordinates of `M(0)`.
  obtain ⟨hinjM, -, hliM, haxis⟩ :=
    step_M_minor hm q Z tau rowsE C.chart b u₁ hqj hZj htauj htaurows hminor hprim
      (ha.trans hab) hq1 hZ1 htau1
  -- Lemma 5.12(a): `dim Θ_y = dim_F Ω_{F/K} ≤ d' + 1`, the bound by Lemma 5.10(c),
  -- the second fundamental exact sequence for `V → κ` and Nakayama.
  obtain ⟨⟨hdim, -, hfieldRank, -⟩, -, -⟩ := witness_lemma_5_12_5_13_paper hm I w hfin
  have hbound : Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ)
      (tangentSpaceAt (laurentColumn q) I.asIdeal) ≤ d + 1 := by
    rw [hd]
    exact hdim.trans_le hfieldRank
  -- Paragraph "the columns of `M` span `𝒞`" (Lemmas 5.12(a), 5.12(b)).
  obtain ⟨-, hspanC⟩ :=
    step_M_spans_cone I.asIdeal q hq0ne hbase D Z rfl lambda c tau hfactor hliM hbound
  -- Paragraph lifting `u = (0, 1, 0, …, 0)`: `uM(0) = 0`, an invertible `M_ι`,
  -- and `ℓ_υ = u_υ`, `ℓ_ι = −u_υ M_υ M_ι⁻¹` with `ℓM = 0`, `ℓ(0) = u`.
  have hu : rowMul (axisRow (k := κ) axis) (residueMatrix (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau)) = 0 := by
    funext col
    simp only [rowMul, axisRow, residueMatrix, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Pi.zero_apply]
    exact haxis col
  obtain ⟨rowsι, -, -, -, -, hell, hellres⟩ :=
    step_lift_ell_minor (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau) hinjM (axisRow (k := κ) axis) hu
  -- Paragraph "`ℓ` annihilates `𝒞`" (Lemma 5.13): `ℓ̃ ∈ span {df_y}`.
  obtain ⟨hconormal, htail⟩ :=
    step_ell_conormal hm I.asIdeal q hq0ne _ hspanC _ hell hellres
  -- Final paragraph: `P(ℓ̃(0)) = 0` with `ℓ̃(0) = (1, 0, …, 0)`.
  have hzero := step_polynomial_limit I Pol hPol _ hbase _ hconormal
  rw [htail, eval₂_extensionAxis_eq_algebraMap_eval_axis (K := κ) hm Pol] at hzero
  exact (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective k κ) (hzero.trans (map_zero _).symm)

Derived from `theorem_5_7_i_prime` with `𝔭 = I(Y)`. -/
theorem theorem_5_7_i_printed
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (Y : Set (Fin m → k)) (hne : Y.Nonempty) (hY : IsIrreducibleClosed Y)
    (hH : Y ∩ {y | y ⟨0, hm⟩ = 0} = ∅)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (hP : ∀ ξ ∈ conormalCone (idealPoint Y hne hY), MvPolynomial.eval ξ P = 0) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i : Fin m => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then (1 : k) else 0) P = 0 := by
  refine theorem_5_7_i_prime hm (idealPoint Y hne hY) (fun y hy h0 => ?_) P hP
  change y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k Y) at hy
  rw [zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_of_isZariskiClosed hY.1] at hy
  exact (Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mp hH) y ⟨hy, h0⟩

**Theorem 5.8.** Let `K` be algebraically closed of characteristic zero and
`W ⊆ T*X` Zariski closed, fibre-conical and involutive.  If
`P ∈ K[ξ_1, …, ξ_n]` with `P(1, 0, …, 0) ≠ 0` vanishes on `W` and
`W ∩ π⁻¹(H) = ∅`, then `W = ∅`.  Proved along Subsection 5.3.

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
  {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (W : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar m → k))
  (hclosed : ∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
  (hcone : Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical W)
  (hinv : Characteristic.PostScalarExtensionPoisson.IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
  (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
  (haxis : (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) P ≠ 0)
  (hPW : ∀ q ∈ W, (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inr i)) P = 0)
  (hH : W ∩ {q | q (Sum.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅) : W = ∅
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.source:
/-- **Theorem 5.8.** Let `K` be algebraically closed of characteristic zero and
`W ⊆ T*X` Zariski closed, fibre-conical and involutive.  If
`P ∈ K[ξ_1, …, ξ_n]` with `P(1, 0, …, 0) ≠ 0` vanishes on `W` and
`W ∩ π⁻¹(H) = ∅`, then `W = ∅`.  Proved along Subsection 5.3. -/
theorem theorem_5_8
    (hm : 0 < m) (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (haxis : MvPolynomial.eval
      (fun i : Fin m => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then (1 : k) else 0) P ≠ 0)
    (hPW : ∀ q ∈ W, MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => q (.inr i)) P = 0)
    (hH : W ∩ {q | q (.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅) :
    W = ∅ := by
  -- Suppose `W ≠ ∅`.
  by_contra hne
  have hW : W.Nonempty := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hne
  -- `B` is radical with a minimal prime `𝔮`; `Y_0 = V_K(𝔮)`.
  obtain ⟨hrad, -, -, 𝔮, h𝔮⟩ := step_minimal_primes W hclosed hcone hW
  obtain ⟨hprime, -, -, -, havoid⟩ := step_component hm W hclosed hcone hH 𝔮 h𝔮
  -- The separator `s`, then `P` vanishes on `N(Y_0)`.
  obtain ⟨s, hs𝔮, hs⟩ := step_separator W 𝔮 hrad h𝔮
  have hPN := step_P_vanishes_on_conormal_cone W hclosed hcone hinv 𝔮 h𝔮 s hs𝔮 hs P hPW
  -- Theorem 5.7(i) contradicts `P(1, 0, …, 0) ≠ 0`.
  exact haxis (step_theorem_5_7_applies hm 𝔮 hprime havoid P
    (step_P_vanishes_on_N 𝔮 hprime P hPN))
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (W : Set (Fin m ⊕ Fin m → k)),
  (∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L) →
    (∀ q ∈ W,
        ∀ (a : k), a ≠ 0 → (Sum.elim (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) fun i => a * q (Sum.inr i)) ∈ W) →
      (∀ f ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
          ∀ g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
            ∑ i,
                ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) g -
                  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) g) ∈
              MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) →
        ∀ (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
          (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) P ≠ 0 →
            (∀ q ∈ W, (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inr i)) P = 0) →
              W ∩ {q | q (Sum.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅ → W = ∅

**Lemma 5.11 for the valuation ring of the formal proof.**  The residues
`res q_i` of its normalized column satisfy `res q_0 = res q_1 = 0`,
`res q_j = 1`, and some `res q_i` with `i ∉ {0, 1, j}` have differentials
forming a basis of `Ω_{κ/K}`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.witness_lemma_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.witness_lemma_5_11.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ}
  (hm : 0 < m) (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (w : Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P)
  (hunit : ∃ g, MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) :
  let C := w.column;
  let W := C.W;
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring;
  let κ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V;
  (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (C.q 0) = 0 ∧
    (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (C.q ⟨0, hm⟩.succ) = 0 ∧
      (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (C.q C.chart) = 1 ∧
        ∃ d' rows,
          Function.Injective rows ∧
            (∀ (l : Fin d'), rows l ≠ 0 ∧ rows l ≠ ⟨0, hm⟩.succ ∧ rows l ≠ C.chart) ∧
              (LinearIndependent κ fun l =>
                  (KaehlerDifferential.D k κ) ((IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (C.q (rows l)))) ∧
                Submodule.span κ
                      (Set.range fun l =>
                        (KaehlerDifferential.D k κ) ((IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (C.q (rows l)))) =
                    ⊤ ∧
                  d' = Module.finrank κ Ω[κ⁄k]
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.witness_lemma_.source:
/-- **Lemma 5.11 for the valuation ring of the formal proof.**  The residues
`res q_i` of its normalized column satisfy `res q_0 = res q_1 = 0`,
`res q_j = 1`, and some `res q_i` with `i ∉ {0, 1, j}` have differentials
forming a basis of `Ω_{κ/K}`. -/
theorem witness_lemma_5_11
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (w : GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P)
    (hunit : ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k,
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) :
    let C := w.column
    let W := C.W
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
      (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
    let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
    letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
      (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
    let κ := ResidueField V
    letI : Algebra k κ := retainedResidueGroundAlgebra P ⟨0, hm⟩ W
    residue V (C.q 0) = 0 ∧ residue V (C.q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)) = 0 ∧
      residue V (C.q C.chart) = 1 ∧
      ∃ (d' : ℕ) (rows : Fin d' → Fin (m + 1)),
        Function.Injective rows ∧
        (∀ l, rows l ≠ 0 ∧ rows l ≠ Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩ ∧ rows l ≠ C.chart) ∧
        LinearIndependent κ
          (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (residue V (C.q (rows l)))) ∧
        Submodule.span κ
          (Set.range fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (residue V (C.q (rows l)))) = ⊤ ∧
        d' = Module.finrank κ (Ω[κ⁄k]) := by
  classical
  let C := w.column
  let W := C.W
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
    (ComponentFractionField P) := W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  let κ := ResidueField V
  letI : Algebra k κ := retainedResidueGroundAlgebra P ⟨0, hm⟩ W
  letI : IsLocalRing V := W.place.isDiscrete.toIsLocalRing
  obtain ⟨a, b, u₀, u₁, ha, hab, hq0, -, hq1⟩ := order_gap_of_actual_witness hm P w hunit
  have hres := constantCoeff_retainedToCompleted_eq_residue (k := k) W
  have hr0 : residue V (C.q 0) = 0 := by
    rw [← hres, hq0]
    simp [ha.ne']
  have hr1 : residue V (C.q (Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩)) = 0 := by
    rw [← hres, hq1]
    simp [(ha.trans hab).ne']
  have hrj : residue V (C.q C.chart) = 1 := by
    rw [C.chart_one, map_one]
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun a ↦ residue V (C.q a)) :
        IntermediateField k κ) κ := by
    have h := w.halg
    have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin k
          (Set.range fun j : Fin m ↦ residue V (C.q (Fin.succ j))) ≤
        IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun a ↦ residue V (C.q a)) :=
      IntermediateField.adjoin.mono _ _ _ (by rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    exact ⟨fun z ↦ IsAlgebraic.tower_top_of_subalgebra_le
      (IntermediateField.toSubalgebra_le_toSubalgebra.mpr hle) (h.isAlgebraic z)⟩
  exact ⟨hr0, hr1, hrj,
    lemma_5_11 hm (fun a ↦ residue V (C.q a)) C.chart hr0 hr1 hrj halg⟩

∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  (w : Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrameWitness hm P),
  (∃ g, MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, hm⟩ * g - 1 ∈ P.asIdeal) →
    let C := w.1;
    let W := C.1;
    let V := W.6.1.toSubring;
    let κ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V;
    (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (C.3 0) = 0 ∧
      (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (C.3 ⟨0, hm⟩.succ) = 0 ∧

/-- A valuation subring of a field `K` is a subring `A` such that for every `x : K`,

This is equivalent to being maximal in the domination order

minpoly.doc:
Suppose `x : B`, where `B` is an `A`-algebra.

The minimal polynomial `minpoly A x` of `x`
is a monic polynomial with coefficients in `A` of smallest degree that has `x` as its root,
if such exists (`IsIntegral A x`) or zero otherwise.

For example, if `V` is a `𝕜`-vector space for some field `𝕜` and `f : V →ₗ[𝕜] V` then
the minimal polynomial of `f` is `minpoly 𝕜 f`.
minpoly.signature:
minpoly.{u_1, u_2} (A : Type u_1) {B : Type u_2} [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra A B] (x : B) :
  Polynomial A
minpoly.source:
/-- Suppose `x : B`, where `B` is an `A`-algebra.

The minimal polynomial `minpoly A x` of `x`
is a monic polynomial with coefficients in `A` of smallest degree that has `x` as its root,
if such exists (`IsIntegral A x`) or zero otherwise.

For example, if `V` is a `𝕜`-vector space for some field `𝕜` and `f : V →ₗ[𝕜] V` then
the minimal polynomial of `f` is `minpoly 𝕜 f`.
-/
@[stacks 09GM]
noncomputable def minpoly (x : B) : A[X] :=
  if hx : IsIntegral A x then degree_lt_wf.min _ hx else 0

steps.text:
classical
  let J := I ⊔ Ideal.span ({MvPolynomial.X i} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
  have htop : J = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨M, hM, hJM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal J hne
    obtain ⟨y, hMy⟩ :=
      MvPolynomial.isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton.mp hM
    have hy : y ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k I := by
      intro p hp
      have hpM := hJM (show p ∈ J from Ideal.mem_sup_left hp)
      rw [hMy, MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff] at hpM
      exact hpM
    have hxM : MvPolynomial.X i ∈ M :=
      hJM (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
    rw [hMy, MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff] at hxM
    exact havoid y hy (by simpa using hxM)
  have hone : (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) ∈ J := by simp [htop]
  obtain ⟨b, hb, z, hz, hbz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hone
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have heq : MvPolynomial.X i * g - 1 = -b := by
    rw [← hg]
    rw [← hbz]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact I.neg_mem hb

    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro ψ hψ

    (linearIndependent_algebraMap_comp_iff (R := F) (S := E)
      (ι' := Fin m)).2 hliF

      (fun i ↦ algebraMap F E (z j i)) ∈ zariskiTangentSpace yE IE := by
    let D : Derivation k F F := (b j).compDer (KaehlerDifferential.D k F)
    have hzD : ∀ i, z j i = D (yF i) := fun i ↦ rfl
    have hcomp : algebraMap k E = (algebraMap F E).comp (algebraMap k F) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k F E
    have hevalE : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k,

      intro p

have htan (j : Fin (Module.finrank F (Ω[F⁄k]))) :
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap F E (z j i)) ∈ zariskiTangentSpace yE IE := by
    let D : Derivation k F F := (b j).compDer (KaehlerDifferential.D k F)
    have hzD : ∀ i, z j i = D (yF i) := fun i ↦ rfl
    have hcomp : algebraMap k E = (algebraMap F E).comp (algebraMap k F) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k F E
    have hevalE : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k E) yE p =
          algebraMap F E (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k F) yF p) := by
      intro p
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp_left, ← hcomp]
      rfl
    apply mem_zariskiTangentSpace_map_of_forall_mem
    · intro g hg
      rw [hevalE, eval₂_genericPoint_eq_zero hg, map_zero]
    · intro g hg
      have hchain :=
        Stafford38.Geometry.PowerSeriesArcTangency.derivation_eval₂ D g yF
      rw [show yF = GenericPointKaehlerConormal.genericPoint I F from rfl,
        eval₂_genericPoint_eq_zero hg, map_zero] at hchain
      simp_rw [hevalE, hzD, ← map_mul, ← map_sum]
      rw [← hchain, map_zero]
