steps.text:
classical
  let Y := homogeneousCoordinates x
  obtain ⟨hxiW, hxmW⟩ := hxW
  have hy0 : x i ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htrans (h ▸ isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hxiInvW : (x i)⁻¹ ∉ W := by
    intro h
    rw [(definition_5_3.2.1 W).2] at hxmW
    apply hxmW
    refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (⟨(x i)⁻¹, h⟩ : W.toSubring) ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [hy0]
  let s : F := (Y j)⁻¹
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hj
  have hjs : Y j * s = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hj
  have hYsW : ∀ a, Y a * s ∈ W := fun a ↦ by simpa [s, div_eq_mul_inv] using hqW a
  -- `C_0 = K[q_0, …, q_n, x̄_1] ⊆ W`, and `A` is its integral closure in `F`.
  let C₀ : Subalgebra k F :=
    Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i})
  let SW : Subalgebra k F := { W.toSubring with algebraMap_mem' := hkW }
  have hC₀W : C₀ ≤ SW := by
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro z (⟨a, rfl⟩ | hz)
    · exact hYsW a
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz]
      exact hxiW
  have htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i}) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hgen]
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.2
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    apply IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_iff_div.mpr
    refine ⟨Y (Fin.succ a) * s, ?_, s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (R := k) (A := F)
        (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self _))
    · have h0 : Y 0 * s ∈ C₀ := Algebra.subset_adjoin (R := k) (A := F)
        (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self (0 : Fin (n + 1))))
      simpa only [Y, homogeneousCoordinates, Fin.cases_zero, one_mul] using h0
    · simp only [Y, Fin.cases_succ]
      exact (eq_div_iff hs).2 rfl
  letI : IsFractionRing C₀ F := IsFractionRing.of_field C₀ F fun z ↦ by
    have hz : z ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i}) := by
      rw [htop]
      exact Set.mem_univ z
    rw [IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_iff_div] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, hab⟩
  let A₀ : Subalgebra C₀ F := integralClosure C₀ F
  let A : Subalgebra k F := A₀.restrictScalars k
  have hC₀A : C₀ ≤ A := fun z hz ↦ A₀.algebraMap_mem ⟨z, hz⟩
  -- `W` is integrally closed, so `A ⊆ W` (Atiyah–Macdonald, Prop. 5.18).
  letI : IsIntegrallyClosedIn W.toSubring F := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn W F)
  have hA₀W : A₀.toSubring ≤ W.toSubring := by
    change (integralClosure C₀ F).toSubring ≤ W.toSubring
    apply (Subring.integralClosure_subring_le_iff (S := C₀) (T := W.toSubring)).2
    exact hC₀W
  have hyA : x i ∈ A := A₀.algebraMap_mem
    ⟨x i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton _))⟩
  have hnormA : ∀ a, Y a * s ∈ A := fun a ↦ A₀.algebraMap_mem
    ⟨Y a * s, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self a))⟩
  have hinvA : (x i)⁻¹ ∉ A := fun h ↦ hxiInvW (hA₀W h)
  -- `A` is a finite `C_0`-module (Hartshorne, Thm. I.3.9A).
  haveI hC₀ft : Algebra.FiniteType k C₀ := Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite
    (Set.Finite.union (Set.finite_range _) (Set.finite_singleton _))
  let D : Subalgebra C₀ (FractionRing C₀) := integralClosure C₀ (FractionRing C₀)
  haveI : Module.Finite C₀ D := finite_normalization_of_fg_domain k C₀ D
  let e : FractionRing C₀ ≃ₐ[C₀] F := IsLocalization.algEquiv C₀⁰ (FractionRing C₀) F
  haveI : Module.Finite C₀ A₀ := Module.Finite.equiv e.mapIntegralClosure.toLinearEquiv
  have hsub : A.toSubring = A₀.toSubring := rfl
  let er : A ≃+* A₀ := RingEquiv.subringCongr hsub
  letI : Algebra C₀ A := (er.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap C₀ A₀)).toAlgebra
  let ea : A₀ ≃ₐ[C₀] A := AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := er.symm) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  letI : IsScalarTower k C₀ A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  letI : IsScalarTower C₀ A F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  haveI : Module.Finite C₀ A := Module.Finite.equiv ea.toLinearEquiv
  haveI hAft : Algebra.FiniteType k A :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans hC₀ft (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType C₀ A)
  have hAic : IsIntegrallyClosedIn A F := by
    apply Subring.isIntegrallyClosedIn_iff.mpr
    intro z hz
    change z ∈ integralClosure C₀ F
    exact isIntegral_trans (R := C₀) (A := A) z hz
  letI : IsFractionRing A F := IsFractionRing.of_field A F fun z ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective C₀ z
    refine ⟨⟨a, hC₀A a.2⟩, ⟨b, hC₀A b.2⟩, ?_⟩
    change z = (a : F) / (b : F)
    exact hab.symm
  have haint : ∀ a : A, IsIntegral C₀ (a : F) := fun a ↦ a.2
  letI : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k A
  letI : IsIntegrallyClosed A := (isIntegrallyClosed_iff_isIntegrallyClosedIn F).mpr hAic
  -- `x̄_1` is a nonzero nonunit of `A`; a minimal prime over it has height one (Krull).
  let xA : A := ⟨x i, hyA⟩
  have hxA0 : xA ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hy0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hxAu : ¬ IsUnit xA := by
    intro hu
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mp hu
    have hzK : x i * (z : F) = 1 := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    apply hinvA
    rw [show (x i)⁻¹ = (z : F) by simpa using congrArg Inv.inv (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hzK)]
    exact z.2
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpheight, hxp, hplace⟩ := stage3_exists_height_one_prime_valuation A xA hxA0 hxAu
  letI : p.IsPrime := hp
  let V : ValuationSubring F := placeValuationSubring A p hplace
  letI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (placeSubalgebra A p) p := by
    unfold placeSubalgebra
    infer_instance
  have hAV : ∀ a : A, (a : F) ∈ V.toSubring := fun a ↦ ofField_mem_algebraMap_v A p hplace a
  have hpV : ∀ a : A, (⟨a, hAV a⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal V.toSubring ↔ a ∈ p :=
    fun a ↦ ofField_mem_maximalIdeal_iff_v A p hplace a
  have hsurj : ∀ z : ResidueField V.toSubring, ∃ (a b : A), b ∉ p ∧
      z = residue V.toSubring ⟨a, hAV a⟩ / residue V.toSubring ⟨b, hAV b⟩ :=
    fun z ↦ ofField_residue_surjective_v A p hplace z
  have hkV : ∀ c : k, algebraMap k F c ∈ V.toSubring := fun c ↦ by
    rw [show algebraMap k F c = algebraMap A F (algebraMap k A c) from
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k A F c)]
    exact hAV (algebraMap k A c)
  have hqV : ∀ a, Y a / Y j ∈ V.toSubring := fun a ↦ by
    simpa [s, div_eq_mul_inv] using hAV ⟨Y a * s, hnormA a⟩
  letI : Algebra k V.toSubring := ((algebraMap k F).codRestrict V.toSubring hkV).toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k V.toSubring F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hxV : x i ∈ V.toSubring := hAV xA
  have hxm : (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal V.toSubring := (hpV xA).2 hxp
  -- `V = A_{𝔭_D}` is a Noetherian valuation ring, and `V ≠ F` because `x̄_1 ∈ 𝔪_V`;
  -- by Definition 5.3(b) it is a discrete valuation ring.
  have hVdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing V.toSubring := by
    have hN : IsNoetherianRing (placeSubalgebra A p) :=
      IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing p.primeCompl (placeSubalgebra A p) inferInstance
    refine (definition_5_3.2.2.1 V).2 ⟨hN, fun htop => ?_⟩
    have hinvV : (x i)⁻¹ ∈ V.toSubring := by
      change (x i)⁻¹ ∈ V
      rw [htop]
      exact ValuationSubring.mem_top _
    rw [(definition_5_3.2.1 V).2] at hxm
    apply hxm
    refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (⟨(x i)⁻¹, hinvV⟩ : V.toSubring) ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [hy0]
  have hqA : ∀ a, Y a / Y j ∈ A := fun a ↦ by simpa [s, div_eq_mul_inv] using hnormA a
  refine ⟨Lemma510Place.mk A p hplace hVdvr hqA hyA hxp ?_ ?_⟩
  · -- (b) `A/𝔭_D` is integral over the image of `C_0`, whose residues are `res q_i`.
    let c' : (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Unit) → F := fun a ↦
      match a with
      | Sum.inl b => Y b * s
      | Sum.inr _ => x i
    have hc'A : ∀ a, c' a ∈ A := fun a ↦ by
      cases a with
      | inl b => exact hnormA b
      | inr _ => exact hyA
    have hset : Set.range c' = Set.range (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Y a * s) ∪ {x i} := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
        cases a with
        | inl b => exact Or.inl ⟨b, rfl⟩
        | inr u => exact Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton _)
      · rintro (⟨b, rfl⟩ | hz)
        · exact ⟨Sum.inl b, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨Sum.inr (), (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz).symm⟩
    have hBig := Stafford38.Geometry.DivisorialVisibleFrameStage4.stage4_residueField_isAlgebraic_of_isIntegral
      A p V hAV hpV hsurj c' hc'A (fun a ↦ by
      rw [hset]
      exact haint a)
    have hyres : residue V.toSubring (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) = 0 :=
      (residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hxm
    have hEq : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun a ↦
          residue V.toSubring ⟨c' a, hAV ⟨c' a, hc'A a⟩⟩) =
        IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun a ↦
          residue V.toSubring ⟨Y a / Y j, hqV a⟩) := by
      have hcoord : ∀ b, (⟨c' (Sum.inl b), hAV ⟨c' (Sum.inl b), hc'A (Sum.inl b)⟩⟩ :
          V.toSubring) = ⟨Y b / Y j, hqV b⟩ := fun b ↦
        Subtype.ext (by simp [c', s, div_eq_mul_inv])
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
        rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
        cases a with
        | inl b =>
          dsimp only
          rw [hcoord b]
          exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
        | inr _ =>
          change residue V.toSubring (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ _
          rw [hyres]
          exact zero_mem _
      · apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
        rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
        dsimp only
        rw [← hcoord b]
        exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl b, rfl⟩
    rw [← hEq]
    convert hBig using 3
  · -- (c) `Ω_{A/K}` is finite and localizes to `Ω_{V/K}` (Hartshorne, Prop. II.8.2A).
    exact stage7_kaehler_finite_ofField A p hkV

      have hcoord : ∀ b, (⟨c' (Sum.inl b), hAV ⟨c' (Sum.inl b), hc'A (Sum.inl b)⟩⟩ :

          dsimp only
          rw [hcoord b]
          exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨b, rfl⟩

          change residue V.toSubring (⟨x i, hxV⟩ : V.toSubring) ∈ _
          rw [hyres]
          exact zero_mem _
      · apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
        rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
        dsimp only
        rw [← hcoord b]
        exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl b, rfl⟩

  let good : Set (Fin (m + 1)) := {a | a ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ axis ∧ a ≠ j}
  let S : Set κ := r '' good
  -- The excluded residues are `0` and `1`, so `L` is generated by `S`.
  have hL : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range r) = IntermediateField.adjoin k S := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
      rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
      by_cases ha : a ∈ good
      · exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k S ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      · simp only [good, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_and_or, not_not] at ha
        rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · rw [hr0]; exact zero_mem _
        · rw [hr1]; exact zero_mem _
        · rw [hrj]; exact one_mem _
    · apply IntermediateField.adjoin.mono
      rintro _ ⟨a, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  -- `L` is generated by the finite set `S`, which therefore contains a transcendence
  -- basis `B` of `L/K` (Definition 5.1, closing sentence; Lang, Thm. VIII.1.1).
  let SL : Set (IntermediateField.adjoin k S) := Subtype.val ⁻¹' S
  have hSL : IntermediateField.adjoin k SL = ⊤ := by
    apply IntermediateField.lift_injective (IntermediateField.adjoin k S)
    rw [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin, IntermediateField.lift_top]
    congr 1
    change Subtype.val '' (Subtype.val ⁻¹' S) = S
    ext z
    refine ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ => hwz ▸ hw, fun hz => ?_⟩
    exact ⟨⟨z, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k S hz⟩, hz, rfl⟩
  have hSLfin : SL.Finite :=
    ((Set.toFinite good).image r).preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  obtain ⟨BL, hBLS, hBL⟩ := (definition_5_1_closing (K := k)
    (L := IntermediateField.adjoin k S)).2 SL hSLfin hSL
  -- `κ/L` is algebraic (Lemma 5.10(b)), so `B` is a transcendence basis of `κ/K`.
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin k S) κ := hL ▸ halg
  let t : Set κ := Set.range (algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k S) κ ∘ ((↑) : BL → _))
  have ht : IsTranscendenceBasis k ((↑) : t → κ) := hBL.algebraMap_comp.to_subtype_range
  have htS : t ⊆ S := by
    rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hBLS b.2
  have htfin : t.Finite := (Set.toFinite good |>.image r).subset htS
  let : Fintype t := htfin.fintype

  have hrank : Module.finrank κ (Ω[κ⁄k]) = Fintype.card t :=
    Stafford38.Geometry.kaehlerFinrankOfTranscendenceBasis k κ t (↑) ht
  have hspanT : Submodule.span κ
      (Set.range fun x : t ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (x : κ)) = ⊤ :=

  have hfam : (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) =

    simp [hrows]
  have hspan : Submodule.span κ
      (Set.range fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hfam, Set.range_comp, e.symm.surjective.range_eq, Set.image_univ, hspanT]
  have hli : LinearIndependent κ (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (r (rows l))) :=
    linearIndependent_of_top_le_span_of_card_eq_finrank hspan.ge

  refine ⟨Fintype.card t, rows, ?_, fun l ↦ hidx _, hli, hspan, hrank.symm⟩

steps.text:
classical
  -- `W` dominates `K[x̄_1]` localized at `x̄_1` (Stacks, Tag 00IA).
  obtain ⟨W, hkW, hxW, hxinvW⟩ := stage1_exists_valuationSubring_of_transcendental (x i) htrans
  have hx0 : x i ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htrans (h ▸ isAlgebraic_zero)
  -- Definition 5.3(a): `𝔪_W = W ∖ W^×`
  have hxmax : (⟨x i, hxW⟩ : W.toSubring) ∈ maximalIdeal W.toSubring := by
    rw [(definition_5_3.2.1 W).2]
    rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    apply hxinvW
    have hmul : x i * ((u⁻¹ : W.toSubringˣ) : W.toSubring) = 1 := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val (Units.mul_inv u)
      simpa [hu] using this
    have : (x i)⁻¹ = ((u⁻¹ : W.toSubringˣ) : W.toSubring) :=
      (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul).symm
    rw [this]
    exact ((u⁻¹ : W.toSubringˣ) : W.toSubring).2
  have hWtop : W ≠ ⊤ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hxinvW (ValuationSubring.mem_top _)
  -- Among the nonzero `x̄_i` choose one that is maximal for `a ≼ b ↔ x̄_a / x̄_b ∈ W`.
  let Y := homogeneousCoordinates x
  let S : Set (Fin (n + 1)) := {a | Y a ≠ 0}
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [S, Y]⟩
  letI : LE (Fin (n + 1)) := ⟨fun a b ↦ Y b ≠ 0 ∧ Y a / Y b ∈ W⟩
  have htr : IsTrans (Fin (n + 1)) LE.le := by
    constructor
    intro a b c hab hbc
    rcases hab with ⟨hb, hab⟩
    rcases hbc with ⟨hc, hbc⟩
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    have := W.toSubring.mul_mem hab hbc
    rwa [div_mul_div_cancel₀ hb] at this
  letI : IsTrans (Fin (n + 1)) LE.le := htr
  obtain ⟨j, hjS, hjmax⟩ := S.toFinite.exists_maximalFor id S hS
  refine ⟨W, j, hkW, hWtop, ⟨hxW, hxmax⟩, hjS, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases ha : Y a = 0
  · change Y a / Y j ∈ W
    rw [ha, zero_div]
    exact W.zero_mem
  -- Definition 5.3(a): `a/b ∈ W` or `b/a ∈ W` for nonzero `a, b`
  rcases (definition_5_3.1 W.toSubring).2 ⟨W, rfl⟩ (Y a / Y j) (div_ne_zero ha hjS) with h | h
  · exact h
  · rw [inv_div] at h
    exact (hjmax (show a ∈ S from ha) ⟨ha, h⟩).2

steps.text:
classical
  let L := LaurentSeries κ
  let f := algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) L
  let qL := laurentColumn q
  let 𝒞 := tangentCone qL I
  have hq0L : qL 0 ≠ 0 := laurentColumn_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q hq0
  -- Lemma 5.12(b) at `y = q/q₀`.
  obtain ⟨hδ, hq⟩ := lemma_5_12_b qL hq0L I hbase
  have hder : ∀ δ : Derivation k (PowerSeries κ) (PowerSeries κ),
      laurentColumn (fun i ↦ δ (q i)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    intro δ
    have h := hδ (extendPowerSeriesDerivation δ)
    have hcol : (fun a ↦ extendPowerSeriesDerivation δ (qL a)) =
        laurentColumn (fun i ↦ δ (q i)) := by
      funext a
      exact extendPowerSeriesDerivation_on_powerSeries δ (q a)
    rw [hcol] at h
    exact h
  have hZcol : ∀ l, (fun i ↦ f (Z i l)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    intro l
    have h := hder (coefficientwiseDerivation (D l))
    rw [hZ]
    exact h
  have hq' : (fun i ↦ f (PowerSeries.derivative (R := κ) (q i))) ∈ 𝒞 :=
    hder (uniformizerDerivation (k := k) (K := κ))
  -- `τ = t^{-c} (q' − Σ λ_l Z_{•l})`.
  let Xc : L := f ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ c)
  have hXc : Xc ≠ 0 := by
    simp [Xc, f]
  have htau : (fun i ↦ f (tau i)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    have hcomb := 𝒞.smul_mem Xc⁻¹ (𝒞.sub_mem hq'
      (𝒞.sum_mem fun l (_ : l ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ 𝒞.smul_mem (f (lambda l)) (hZcol l)))
    convert hcomb using 1
    funext i
    have hi := congrArg f (hfactor i)
    simp only [map_sub, map_mul, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, map_sum] at hi
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hXc]
    rw [← hi]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
    ring
  have hcols : ∀ col, (fun i ↦ f (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)) ∈ 𝒞 := by
    intro col
    rcases col with _ | (l | _)
    · exact hq
    · exact hZcol l
    · exact htau
  refine ⟨hcols, ?_⟩
  have hle : Submodule.span L (Set.range fun col i ↦ f (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau i col)) ≤ 𝒞 :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨col, rfl⟩; exact hcols col)
  apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle
  rw [finrank_span_eq_card hli]
  -- Lemma 5.12(a): `dim 𝒞 = dim Θ_y + 1 ≤ d' + 2`.
  have hcone : Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ) (tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I) =
      Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ) (tangentSpaceAt (laurentColumn q) I) + 1 :=
    lemma_5_12_a_cone (laurentColumn q) hq0L I
  change Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ) (tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I) ≤ _
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_unit, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

    have hcomb := 𝒞.smul_mem Xc⁻¹ (𝒞.sub_mem hq'
      (𝒞.sum_mem fun l (_ : l ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ 𝒞.smul_mem (f (lambda l)) (hZcol l)))
    convert hcomb using 1
    funext i
    have hi := congrArg f (hfactor i)
    simp only [map_sub, map_mul, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, map_sum] at hi
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hXc]
    rw [← hi]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ ?_
    ring

steps.text:
have hξG : MvPolynomial.eval ξ G = 0 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with hd | hd
    · -- `d = 0`: `G` is constant, and some nonzero `ξ' ∈ N(Y)` exists.
      subst hd
      have hconst : ∀ x : Fin n → k, MvPolynomial.eval x G = MvPolynomial.eval 0 G := by
        intro x
        have h := eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous G 0 hG 0 x
        rw [zero_smul, pow_zero, one_mul] at h
        exact h.symm
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, ξ i ≠ 0 := by simpa [funext_iff] using hξ
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ : ∃ v ∈ smoothConormalFibreProjection I, v ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hnone
        push Not at hnone
        apply hi
        have hXi : MvPolynomial.X i ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k
            (smoothConormalFibreProjection I) := by
          rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
          intro v hv
          rw [hnone v hv]
          simp
        simpa using (MvPolynomial.mem_zeroLocus_iff.mp hvan) _ hXi
      rw [hconst, ← hconst v]
      exact hnonzero v hv hv0
    · -- `d > 0`: `G(0) = 0` too, so `G` vanishes on `N(Y)`.
      have hGvan : G ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (smoothConormalFibreProjection I) := by
        rw [MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
        intro v hv
        by_cases hv0 : v = 0
        · subst hv0
          have h := eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous G d hG 0 0
          rw [smul_zero, zero_pow hd.ne', zero_mul] at h
          exact h
        · exact hnonzero v hv hv0
      exact (MvPolynomial.mem_zeroLocus_iff.mp hvan) _ hGvan

steps.text:
classical
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin d) κ (Ω[κ⁄k]) := Module.Basis.mk hli hspan.ge
  -- Definition 5.2(c): the dual derivations `D_k` of the basis `dβ_l`.
  obtain ⟨D, hdual⟩ := definition_5_2_c (K := k) (L := κ)
    (fun l ↦ PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (rows l))) B (fun l ↦ Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _)
  have hentry : ∀ l k', PowerSeries.constantCoeff (coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D (rows l) k') =
      if l = k' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro l k'
    rw [constantCoeff_coefficientwiseTangentMatrix, hdual]
    by_cases h : k' = l
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
  refine ⟨D, hdual, hentry, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [constantCoeff_selectedMinor_det]
    have hone : selectedMinor (residueMatrix (coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D)) rows = 1 := by
      ext l k'
      rw [Matrix.one_apply]
      exact hentry l k'
    rw [hone, Matrix.det_one]
  · intro k'
    rw [coefficientwiseTangentMatrix]
    simp only [hqj]
    exact (coefficientwiseDerivation (D k')).map_one_eq_zero
  · intro k'
    refine ⟨coefficientwiseDerivation (D k') u₀, ?_⟩
    rw [coefficientwiseTangentMatrix, hq0]
    exact coefficientwiseDerivation_X_pow_mul (D k') a u₀
  · intro k'
    refine ⟨coefficientwiseDerivation (D k') u₁, ?_⟩
    rw [coefficientwiseTangentMatrix, hq1]
    exact coefficientwiseDerivation_X_pow_mul (D k') b u₁

classical
  let L := LaurentSeries κ
  let f := algebraMap (PowerSeries κ) L
  let φ : (Fin (m + 1) → L) →ₗ[L] L :=
    { toFun := fun v ↦ ∑ a, laurentColumn ell a * v a
      map_add' := fun v w ↦ by simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun c v ↦ by
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ by ring }
  have hle : tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
    rw [← hspan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨col, rfl⟩
    have h := congrArg f (congrFun hell col)
    simp only [rowMul, map_sum, map_mul, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hann : ∀ v ∈ tangentCone (laurentColumn q) I, ∑ a, laurentColumn ell a * v a = 0 :=
    fun v hv ↦ hle hv
  refine ⟨lemma_5_13 (laurentColumn q) (laurentColumn_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q hq0) I
    (laurentColumn ell) hann, ?_⟩
  calc

classical
  obtain ⟨rowsι, h0⟩ := exists_selectedMinor_det_ne_zero_of_mulVec_injective _ hinj
  have h0' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (selectedMinor M rowsι).det ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [constantCoeff_selectedMinor_det]
  have hunit : IsUnit (selectedMinor M rowsι).det :=
    PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ h0')
  set ℓ := liftRow M rowsι u
  -- `ℓ M = ℓ_ι M_ι + ℓ_υ M_υ = −u_υ M_υ + u_υ M_υ = 0`.
  have hblock : Matrix.vecMul (liftBlock M rowsι u) (selectedMinor M rowsι) =
      -rowMul (complementRow rowsι u) M := by
    rw [liftBlock, Matrix.neg_vecMul, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hunit, Matrix.vecMul_one]
  have hell : rowMul ℓ M = 0 := by
    funext col
    have h := congrFun hblock col
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, selectedMinor, Pi.neg_apply] at h
    have hsplit : rowMul ℓ M col = rowMul (complementRow rowsι u) M col +
        ∑ c, liftBlock M rowsι u c * M (rowsι c) col := by
      simp only [ℓ, liftRow, rowMul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ ↦ ?_
      simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      simp
    rw [hsplit, h, Pi.zero_apply, add_neg_cancel]
  refine ⟨rowsι, h0, hunit, liftRow_apply_of_not_mem M rowsι u, liftRow_apply_rows M rowsι u,
    hell, ?_⟩
  -- `ℓ(0) − u` vanishes off `ι` and is killed by `M(0)`, hence vanishes on `ι`.
  let δ : R → κ := residueColumn ℓ - u
  have hoff : ∀ i, (¬ ∃ c, rowsι c = i) → δ i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    simp [δ, residueColumn, ℓ, liftRow_apply_of_not_mem M rowsι u i hi]
  have hδ : Matrix.vecMul (fun c ↦ δ (rowsι c)) (selectedMinor (residueMatrix M) rowsι) = 0 := by
    funext col
    have hℓ := congrArg PowerSeries.constantCoeff (congrFun hell col)
    have hu' := congrFun hu col
    simp only [rowMul, map_sum, map_mul, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero] at hℓ hu'
    have hsum : ∑ i, δ i * residueMatrix M i col = 0 := by
      simp only [δ, Pi.sub_apply, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [hu', sub_zero]
      exact hℓ
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, ← hsum]
    simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, selectedMinor]
    refine Fintype.sum_of_injective rowsι rowsι.injective _ _ ?_ fun c ↦ rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hoff i (by simpa using hi), zero_mul]
  have hA : IsUnit (selectedMinor (residueMatrix M) rowsι) :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ h0)
  have hzero := Matrix.vecMul_injective_of_isUnit hA (hδ.trans (Matrix.zero_vecMul _).symm)

  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hoff i hi)

steps.text:
classical
  intro Pol hPol
  by_cases halg : IsAlgebraic k (componentCoordinate I ⟨0, hm⟩)
  · -- First paragraph: `x̄_1` algebraic, so `x_1 − c ∈ 𝔭` and
    -- `(1, 0, …, 0) = dx_1` is conormal at points of `Y`.
    obtain ⟨c, y, -, -, hmem⟩ := exists_constant_coordinate_equation_and_pure_axis hm I halg
    have h := fibreLift_mem_vanishingIdeal_equationConormal I.asIdeal I.isPrime Pol hPol _ hmem
    simpa [fibreLift, MvPolynomial.eval_rename, Function.comp_def] using h
  -- `x̄_1` transcendental.  `Y ∩ H = ∅` makes `x̄_1` a unit of `R`.
  have hunit := exists_coordinate_inverse_of_avoidance I.asIdeal ⟨0, hm⟩ havoid
  -- Lemmas 5.9–5.10: the discrete valuation ring `V` of `F` at infinity, the
  -- column `q_i = x̄_i / x̄_j` and `κ = V/𝔪_V`, read in `V̂ ≅ κ[[t]]`.
  obtain ⟨w, hfin⟩ :=
    Stafford38.Geometry.GeneralDivisorialVisibleFrame.generalDivisorialVisibleFrameWithKaehlerFinite
      hm I hunit halg
  let C := w.column
  let W := C.W
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateZeroLocalRing W.coefficientField)
    (ComponentFractionField I) := W.ambientAlgebra
  let V := W.place.valuation.toSubring
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := W.place.isDiscrete
  letI : IsLocalRing V := W.place.isDiscrete.toIsLocalRing
  letI : Algebra W.coefficientField V :=
    (relativeCoefficientMap W.coefficientField W.place).toAlgebra
  let κ := ResidueField V
  letI : Algebra k κ := retainedResidueGroundAlgebra I ⟨0, hm⟩ W
  letI : CharZero κ :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective k κ)
  -- Paragraph "`V̂ ≅ κ[[t]]`": `F ↪ κ((t))`, and the residue is the constant term.
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hres, -, -, -⟩ := step_completion hm I w
  let q : Fin (m + 1) → PowerSeries κ := fun a ↦ retainedToCompletedPowerSeries W (C.q a)
  let axis : Fin (m + 1) := Fin.succ ⟨0, hm⟩
  -- Paragraph "`a = ord q_0`, `b = ord q_1`": `0 < a < b`, `j ∉ {0, 1}`.
  obtain ⟨a, b, u₀, u₁, ha, hab, hq0, hu₀, hq1, -, hqj, -, -⟩ := step_orders hm I w hunit
  have hq0ne : q 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hu₀
    have h' : (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries κ) ^ a * u₀ = 0 := hq0.symm.trans h
    rw [mul_eq_zero] at h'
    rcases h' with h' | h'
    · exact absurd h' (pow_ne_zero a PowerSeries.X_ne_zero)
    · rw [h', map_zero]
  -- Paragraph defining `y`, equation (generic): `f(y) = 0` for `f ∈ 𝔭`.
  have hbase : ∀ f ∈ I.asIdeal, MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k (LaurentSeries κ))
      (dehomogenizedPoint (laurentColumn q)) f = 0 :=
    fun f hf ↦ (step_generic_point hm I w f).2 hf
  -- Lemma 5.11: `d(q_{i_l}(0))`, `i_l ∉ {0, 1, j}`, form a basis of `Ω_{κ/K}`.
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, d, rows, hinj, -, hli, hspan, hd⟩ := witness_lemma_5_11 hm I w hunit
  have hresRows : (fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (q (rows l)))) =
      fun l ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D k κ (residue V (C.q (rows l))) := by
    funext l
    rw [hres]
  rw [← hresRows] at hli hspan
  let rowsE : Fin d ↪ Fin (m + 1) := ⟨rows, hinj⟩
  -- Paragraph after Lemma 5.11: dual derivations `D_k` and the matrix `Z(t)`.
  obtain ⟨D, -, -, hminor, hZj, hZ0, hZ1⟩ :=
    step_dual_derivations (k := k) hm q rowsE hli hspan C.chart hqj a b u₀ u₁ hq0 hq1
  let Z := coefficientwiseTangentMatrix q D
  -- Paragraph defining `λ` (unique), `w = q' − Zλ`, `c ≤ a − 1` and `τ = t^{-c} w`.
  obtain ⟨lambda, c, tau, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hfactor, hprim, htaurows, -, htau1, htauj⟩ :=
    step_lambda_w_tau hm q Z rowsE C.chart a b u₀ u₁ hqj hZj ha hab hq0 hu₀ hZ0 hq1 hZ1 hminor
  -- Paragraph "`M(0)` has full column rank" for `M = (q, Z, τ)`: a unit minor
  -- `M_ι`, independent columns over `κ((t))`, vanishing `1`-coordinates of `M(0)`.
  obtain ⟨hinjM, -, hliM, haxis⟩ :=
    step_M_minor hm q Z tau rowsE C.chart b u₁ hqj hZj htauj htaurows hminor hprim
      (ha.trans hab) hq1 hZ1 htau1
  -- Lemma 5.12(a): `dim Θ_y = dim_F Ω_{F/K} ≤ d' + 1`, the bound by Lemma 5.10(c),
  -- the second fundamental exact sequence for `V → κ` and Nakayama.
  obtain ⟨⟨hdim, -, hfieldRank, -⟩, -, -⟩ := witness_lemma_5_12_5_13_paper hm I w hfin
  have hbound : Module.finrank (LaurentSeries κ)
      (tangentSpaceAt (laurentColumn q) I.asIdeal) ≤ d + 1 := by
    rw [hd]
    exact hdim.trans_le hfieldRank
  -- Paragraph "the columns of `M` span `𝒞`" (Lemmas 5.12(a), 5.12(b)).
  obtain ⟨-, hspanC⟩ :=
    step_M_spans_cone I.asIdeal q hq0ne hbase D Z rfl lambda c tau hfactor hliM hbound
  -- Paragraph lifting `u = (0, 1, 0, …, 0)`: `uM(0) = 0`, an invertible `M_ι`,
  -- and `ℓ_υ = u_υ`, `ℓ_ι = −u_υ M_υ M_ι⁻¹` with `ℓM = 0`, `ℓ(0) = u`.
  have hu : rowMul (axisRow (k := κ) axis) (residueMatrix (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau)) = 0 := by
    funext col
    simp only [rowMul, axisRow, residueMatrix, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Pi.zero_apply]
    exact haxis col
  obtain ⟨rowsι, -, -, -, -, hell, hellres⟩ :=
    step_lift_ell_minor (formalTangentMatrix q Z tau) hinjM (axisRow (k := κ) axis) hu
  -- Paragraph "`ℓ` annihilates `𝒞`" (Lemma 5.13): `ℓ̃ ∈ span {df_y}`.
  obtain ⟨hconormal, htail⟩ :=
    step_ell_conormal hm I.asIdeal q hq0ne _ hspanC _ hell hellres
  -- Final paragraph: `P(ℓ̃(0)) = 0` with `ℓ̃(0) = (1, 0, …, 0)`.
  have hzero := step_polynomial_limit I Pol hPol _ hbase _ hconormal
  rw [htail, eval₂_extensionAxis_eq_algebraMap_eval_axis (K := κ) hm Pol] at hzero
  exact (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective k κ) (hzero.trans (map_zero _).symm)
